questions.explain: तृप्यतः बृंहणैः अपि = of one who is being satiated with nourishing means, even.

questions.q: Which means of the riches, made like बलानाम् (of strengths)?
optionExplain: This is the nominative or accusative plural.
This is the instrumental singular.
Right: The genitive plural of a neuter a-stem ends in -आनाम्: धन → धनानाम्.
This is the nominative or accusative singular.
questions.explain: तेजोवर्णबलानाम् is a genitive plural of a-stem words; धन (wealth) gives धनानाम्.
questions.teaches: The genitive plural of an a-stem noun ends in -आनाम् (बलानाम्, धनानाम्); a loss (प्रणाश) 'of' things takes this case.

questions.q: What does line 1 say about suitable foods (उचिताः आहाराः)?
options: Suitable foods make everything increase at once
Suitable foods are the only thing that increases
Even with them, they do not increase in him
optionExplain: The line has न: they do not increase.
The line does not say to avoid them.
The line does not say that.
Right: उचितैः अपि आहारैः ... वर्धन्ति न = even with suitable foods they do not increase.
questions.explain: The line has अपि (even) and न (not): the increase does not happen even with suitable foods.

questions.q: Match each word of line 1 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These four words build the clause.
questions.rule: उचितैः = suitable; यस्मात् = since; अस्य = of him; वर्धन्ति = they increase.

questions.q: What does अपि do in उचितैरपि आहारैः?
options: It means 'because': foods are the cause
optionExplain: Right: अपि after उचितैः gives 'even with suitable'.
अपि does not mean 'only'.
'Because' would be यस्मात् or यतः.
The foods are present: they are suitable.
questions.explain: उचितैः आहारैः अपि = even with suitable foods.
questions.teaches: अपि after a word gives 'even' or 'also': उचितैरपि आहारैः = even with suitable foods.

questions.q: Why is there र् in आहारैर्यस्मात्?
options: आहारैः + यस्मात्: the visarga becomes ओ
Visarga after ऐ becomes र् before य
optionExplain: ओ comes only after अ, not after ऐ.
Right: After any vowel except अ and आ, a visarga before a voiced sound becomes र्.
It is आहारैः, the instrumental plural, with sandhi.
A visarga drops after आ, not after ऐ.
questions.explain: आहारैः (by foods) + यस्मात् (since): the visarga becomes र् before a voiced य.
questions.rule: Visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ + voiced → र्.

questions.q: Put these words of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Line 2 runs: with mouths smeared by doṣas, rasa, rasa-carrying, vessels.

questions.q: Which means by the physicians (वैद्य, m.), made like आहारैः?
optionExplain: This is the accusative plural, 'the physicians'.
This is the genitive plural, 'of the physicians'.
Right: The instrumental plural of a masculine a-stem ends in -ऐः.
This is the locative plural, 'among the physicians'.
questions.explain: आहारैः, उचितैः are instrumental plural of a-stem words, 'by foods', 'by suitable'.
questions.teaches: The instrumental plural of an a-stem noun ends in -ऐः (आहारैः, वैद्यैः) and means 'by ...'.

questions.q: Which doṣas does line 2 say sometimes become provoked?
options: Those that were never present at all
Those conquered by fasting and pācana
optionExplain: Purifying measures are not named in this unit; unit 35 speaks of 'those who' are purified.
Nothing in the line speaks of absent doṣas.
The line names fasting and digestive measures, not nourishing ones.
Right: जिताः लंघनपाचनैः = conquered by laṅghana and pācana.
questions.explain: दोषाः कदाचित् कुप्यंति, जिताः लंघनपाचनैः: the doṣas conquered by those two measures.
questions.rule: जिताः लंघनपाचनैः = conquered by fasting and digestive measures.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Words from both lines, with their plain meanings.
questions.rule: कदाचित् = sometimes; कुप्यंति = become provoked; जिताः = conquered; यथाविधि = according to rule; स्वस्थस्य = of a healthy person.

questions.q: Which is the right split of स्वस्थस्यैव?
optionExplain: Right: अ + ए joins as ऐ: स्वस्थस्य + एव = स्वस्थस्यैव.
स्यैव is not a word.
व is not a word here.
ऐव is not a word; the word is एव.
questions.explain: स्वस्थस्य (of a healthy person) + एव (even, only).
questions.teaches: When a word ending in -अ meets a word beginning with ए, they join as ऐ (स्वस्थस्य + एव = स्वस्थस्यैव).

questions.q: Why is the first part of जितालंघनपाचनैः written जिता- without a visarga?
options: It is a spelling mistake that must be corrected
It is जिताः; after आ a visarga before a voiced sound drops
It is a different word, जित
The visarga becomes ओ before ल
optionExplain: It is regular sandhi, not a mistake.
Right: जिताः + लंघन: the visarga after आ drops before the voiced ल.
The card reads it as जिताः (conquered), nominative plural.
ओ comes after अ, not after आ.
questions.explain: जिताः (conquered) + लंघनपाचनैः: the visarga after आ drops before a voiced sound.
questions.rule: Visarga after आ + voiced consonant → dropped.

questions.q: Put these words of line 1 in the order of the verse (leaving out the object).
questions.explain: Line 1 runs: therefore, one should employ, of a healthy person, even, according to rule.

questions.q: Which means one should go (√गम्), an optative like युंज्यात् (one should employ)?
optionExplain: This is the present, 'goes'.
This is the past participle, 'gone'.
Right: The third singular optative active ends in -एत् for many verbs: गच्छेत्.
This is the noun 'going'.
questions.explain: युंज्यात् (should employ) is a 3rd singular optative form; गच्छेत् is the same kind.
questions.teaches: The 3rd singular optative active means 'should ...' and ends in -एत् (भवेत्, गच्छेत्) or -यात् (युंज्यात्).

questions.q: What does line 1 say about those purified by purifying measures?
options: They must be purified again each time
There is no re-arising for them
optionExplain: The line does not say this.
That is said of the conquered doṣas in unit 34, not here.
Nothing about avoiding foods is in this unit.
Right: न तेषां पुनरुद्भवः = for them there is no re-arising.
questions.explain: संशोधनैः शुद्धाः = purified by purifying measures; न ... पुनरुद्भवः = no re-arising.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words from the two lines.
questions.rule: संशोधनैः = by purifying measures; शुद्धाः = purified; पुनरुद्भवः = re-arising; यथाक्रमम् = in due order; यथायोगम् = as suitable.

questions.q: प्रयोजयेत् ('one should apply') is formed from प्र + which root?
optionExplain: Right: प्रयोजयेत् is the causative of प्र + युज्, 'to join, to apply'.
जि means 'to conquer'; that is the root of जिताः in unit 34.
शुध् means 'to be pure'; that is the root of शुद्धाः.
कुप् means 'to be angry, to be provoked'; that is the root of कुप्यंति.
questions.explain: प्रयोजयेत् = प्र + युज् in the causative, 3rd singular optative.
questions.teaches: प्रयोजयेत् is a causative optative of प्र + युज्, related to युञ्जीत and युंज्यात् of earlier units; the causative stem has -अय- (प्रयोजय-).

questions.q: Which is the right split of पुनरुद्भवः?
optionExplain: रुद्भवः is not a word.
Right: The final र् of पुनर् stays and joins the vowel उ: पुनर् + उद्भवः.
रुद्भवः is not a word; the second word is उद्भवः.
आ + उ would give पुनोद्भवः, not पुनरुद्भवः.
questions.explain: पुनर् (again) + उद्भवः (arising): a compound 'again-arising'.
questions.rule: Final र् + vowel: the र् joins the vowel.

questions.q: Put these words of line 2 in the order of the verse (leaving out अतऊर्ध्वम्).
questions.explain: Line 2 runs: in due order, as suitable, ... one should apply.

questions.q: Which means awakened (past participle of √बुध्), made like शुद्ध from √शुध्?
optionExplain: This is not the form the root takes.
This is the noun 'awakening'.
Right: A root ending in -ध् with the past ending -त gives -द्ध: शुध् → शुद्ध, बुध् → बुद्ध.
This is the agent noun 'one who awakens or knows'.
questions.explain: शुद्धाः (purified) is the past participle of √शुध्; √बुध् forms its past participle the same way.
questions.teaches: A past participle from a root in -ध् takes the form -द्ध (शुध् → शुद्ध 'purified', बुध् → बुद्ध 'awakened').

questions.q: In line 1, who applies the rasāyana preparations and vṛṣya formulations?
options: The one who has been purified
optionExplain: That is unit 35's शुद्धाः, not the applier.
That person is in line 2, where a nourishing regimen is meant for him.
स्वस्थ is in unit 34, not here.
Right: कालवित् is the subject: the knower of time.
questions.explain: कालवित् (knower of time) is nominative and is the one who applies.
questions.rule: कालवित् = the knower of the right time.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words that carry the two lines.
questions.rule: कालवित् = knower of time; भेषजक्षपिते = in one depleted by medicines; पथ्यम् = wholesome; आहारैः = by foods; रसायनानि = rasāyana preparations.

questions.q: The word for step by step, gradually, ending line 2 is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: क्रमात् is the ablative of क्रम (order, sequence) used as 'step by step'.
questions.teaches: क्रमात् = step by step, gradually.

questions.q: Which is the right split of वृष्ययोगांश्च?
optionExplain: Right: न् before च becomes ंश्: वृष्ययोगान् + च = वृष्ययोगांश्च.
श्च is not a word; the word is च.
A visarga before च would give श्च without an anusvara.
श is not a word here.
questions.explain: वृष्ययोगान् (vṛṣya formulations, accusative plural) + च (and).

questions.q: Put these words of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Line 2 runs: in one depleted by medicines, wholesome, by foods, nourishing, step by step.

questions.q: Which means knower of the Veda, made like कालवित् (knower of time)?
optionExplain: -कृत् means 'maker of'.
Right: -वित् at the end of a compound means 'knower of' what comes before.
-दः means 'giver of'.
-भृत् means 'bearer of'.
questions.explain: कालवित् = काल (time) + वित् (knower). In the same way वेद + वित् = knower of the Veda.
questions.teaches: A compound ending in -वित् means 'knower of' the first part (कालवित्, वेदवित्).

questions.q: What does line 1 of this unit list?
options: Kinds of enema, massage and bathing of the body
Signs by which a disease is known in a patient
Foods such as rice, wheat, mung, meat and ghee
Names of the seasons and the months of the year
optionExplain: Massage and enemas come in the next unit.
No sign of any disease is named here.
Right: Line 1 names शालि, षष्टिक, गोधूम, मुद्ग, मांस and घृत.
No season is named in this unit.
questions.explain: Line 1 is a list of foods, ending with आदि, 'and the like'.
questions.rule: शालि · षष्टिक · गोधूम · मुद्ग · मांस · घृत · आदि.

questions.q: Put the foods of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The line runs शालि, षष्टिक, गोधूम, मुद्ग, मांस, घृत and then आदि.
questions.rule: शालि · षष्टिक · गोधूम · मुद्ग · मांस · घृत.

questions.q: Match each food name of line 1 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These four names stand inside the long joined word of line 1.
questions.rule: गोधूम = wheat; मुद्ग = mung; मांस = meat; घृत = ghee.
questions.teaches: A list of foods can be joined into one long word that ends in आदिभिः, 'with these and the like'.

questions.q: Which is the right split of संयोगाद्रुचि-?
optionExplain: A visarga here would give संयोगा रुचि, not द्.
द्रुचि is not a word on the card.
A final म् would stay म् or become a dot, not द्.
Right: A final त् before a voiced sound such as र becomes द्.
questions.explain: संयोगात् (from the combination, ablative) + रुचि (relish) join as संयोगाद्रुचि.
questions.rule: त् + voiced sound → द्: संयोगात् + रुचि = संयोगाद्रुचि.

questions.q: What does the ending -भिः of ...घृतादिभिः show?
optionExplain: Right: The ending -भिः marks the instrumental plural.
The genitive plural ends in -आम् (-ईनाम्), not -भिः.
The locative plural ends in -षु, not -भिः.
The nominative plural has no -भिः; -भिः is the instrumental sign.
questions.explain: The foods are the means: the ending -भिः says 'with ... and the like'.

questions.q: Following रुचिपक्तिदैः, what does the invented word सुखदैः mean?
optionExplain: -द does not mean free from.
Right: A compound ending in -द gives 'giving' the first part, here happiness.
The idea is 'giving' happiness, not being happy.
The ending -ऐः is instrumental, not 'of'.
questions.explain: In रुचिपक्तिदैः the end -द means 'giving' relish and digestion; सुखदैः works the same way.
questions.rule: X-द (from दा, to give) = giving X.
questions.teaches: A compound ending in -द means 'giving' the first part: रुचिपक्तिद = giving relish and digestion; सुखद = giving happiness.

questions.q: What does the person obtain, as the second line of this unit puts it?
options: Wealth, children and a large household
Victory in war and lasting fame abroad
Comfort and keenness of all the fires
Sweet speech and bodily beauty at all times
optionExplain: None of these is named in this unit.
Neither is named in this unit.
Right: The line says शर्म and सर्वपावकपाटवम्.
Neither is named in this unit.
questions.explain: लभते शर्म सर्वपावकपाटवम्: he obtains comfort and keenness of all the fires.
questions.rule: लभते = obtains; शर्म = comfort; सर्वपावकपाटवम् = keenness of all fires.

questions.q: Put the words of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The line runs: with massage, rubbing, bathing, then nirūha, sneha and basti.
questions.rule: साभ्यंग · उद्वर्तन · स्नान · निरूह · स्नेह · बस्ति.

questions.q: Which is the right split of साभ्यंगोद्वर्तन-?
optionExplain: भ्यंग is not a word.
A visarga would not disappear like this before उ.
None of these parts is a word.
Right: स + अ gives आ; and अभ्यंग + उ gives ओ.
questions.explain: स (with) + अभ्यंग (oil massage) + उद्वर्तन (rubbing) join as साभ्यंगोद्वर्तन.
questions.rule: अ + अ → आ; अ + उ → ओ.
questions.teaches: Two short a-sounds join into आ (स + अभ्यंग = साभ्यंग), and अ + उ joins into ओ (अभ्यंग + उद्वर्तन = अभ्यंगोद्वर्तन).

questions.q: Match each word of line 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These four words carry the result of the verse.
questions.rule: शर्म = comfort; पावक = fire; पाटव = keenness; लभते = obtains.

questions.q: Which of these are named in line 1?
optionExplain: Right: it opens the list, inside साभ्यंग.
Right: it is the third item.
Right: it closes the list.
Not in line 1.
Not in line 1.
questions.explain: Line 1 names massage, rubbing, bathing and the two kinds of basti; emesis and nasal drops are not in it.
questions.rule: Line 1: अभ्यंग, उद्वर्तन, स्नान, निरूह, स्नेह, बस्ति.

questions.q: By the pattern of साभ्यंग, what does the invented word सपुत्रः mean?
optionExplain: Right: स- in a compound can mean 'together with' the rest.
'Without' would be अ- or निः-, not स-.
Nothing in स- means 'born of'.
That would be पुत्रस्य.
questions.explain: साभ्यंग = स + अभ्यंग, 'together with massage'; सपुत्र = 'together with a son'.
questions.teaches: In a compound the prefix स- (sa-) can mean 'together with' the rest: साभ्यंग = with oil massage; सपुत्र = with a son.

questions.q: Line 2 lists bhūtas, poison, wind, fire, wounds and fractures. What do they share?
options: Each is a remedy that something removes
Each is a source from which something arises
Each is a food that something is eaten with
Each is a season in which something occurs
optionExplain: Nothing in the line calls them remedies.
Right: संभवाः means 'arising from': the list gives the sources.
None of the six is a food here.
None of the six is a season.
questions.explain: भूतविषवाय्वग्निक्षतभंगादिसंभवाः = arising from bhūtas, poison, wind, fire, wounds, fractures and the like.
questions.rule: -संभव = arising from; the list gives the sources.

questions.q: Put the sources of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The line runs भूत, विष, वायु, अग्नि, क्षत, भंग and then आदि.
questions.rule: भूत · विष · वायु · अग्नि · क्षत · भंग.

questions.q: Match each source of line 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These four words stand in the long joined word of line 2.
questions.rule: भूत = beings or spirits; विष = poison; क्षत = wound; भंग = fracture.
questions.teaches: In this list भूत means beings or spirits, and the other nouns are plain words for poison, wound and fracture.

questions.q: Which is the right split of धीवर्णेंद्रिय-?
optionExplain: न्द्रिय is not a word.
एन्द्रिय is not a word; the ए comes from joining.
Right: अ + इ joins as ए: वर्ण + इन्द्रिय = वर्णेन्द्रिय.
Neither part is a word.
questions.explain: धी (intellect), वर्ण (complexion) and इन्द्रिय (sense) are joined; अ + इ became ए.
questions.rule: अ + इ → ए: वर्ण + इन्द्रिय = वर्णेन्द्रिय.

questions.q: Which of these are named in line 2 as sources?
optionExplain: Right: it is the second item.
Right: it is the fourth item.
Right: it is the sixth item.
Not in line 2.
Not in line 2.
questions.explain: Poison, fire and fractures are in the list; cold and hunger are not.
questions.rule: Line 2: भूत, विष, वायु, अग्नि, क्षत, भंग, आदि.

questions.q: By the pattern of ...संभवाः, what does the invented word जलसंभवाः mean?
optionExplain: Dwelling would be a different ending, such as -स्थ.
'Leading to' is not what -संभव says.
Nothing in -संभव means protecting.
Right: -संभव at the end means 'arising from' the first part.
questions.explain: In भूतविष...संभवाः the end -संभव means 'arising from'; जलसंभवाः works the same.
questions.teaches: A compound ending in -संभव means 'arising from' the first part: भंगादिसंभव = arising from fractures and the like; जलसंभव = arising from water.

questions.q: What does line 1 call the diseases coming from desire, anger, fear and the like?
options: Diseases of the body alone, by any cause
optionExplain: Right: The line says तेस्युरागंतवो गदाः: they would be the adventitious diseases.
The verse does not use निज in this unit.
Nothing in the line is about a season.
The line gives no such name.
questions.explain: आगन्तु means adventitious; गद means disease; the line calls the diseases from desire, anger and fear by that name.

questions.q: Put the three named causes of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The line runs काम, क्रोध, भय and then आद्याः, 'and the like'.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two words come from line 1 and two from line 2.
questions.rule: आगन्तु = adventitious; गद = disease; त्याग = abandonment; उपशम = calming.
questions.teaches: The nouns त्यागः and इन्द्रियोपशमः of line 2 are single words; त्याग means abandonment and उपशम means calming.

questions.q: Which is the right split of तेस्युरागंतवो?
optionExplain: रागंतवः is not a word.
Right: A visarga after उ before a vowel becomes र्: स्युः + आ = स्युरा.
None of these parts is a word.
A र् would not be written twice here.
questions.explain: ते (they) + स्युः (would be) + आगंतवः (adventitious); the printed तेस्युरागंतवो joins स्युः + आगंतवः; the final visarga of आगंतवः shows as ओ before the voiced ग of गदाः.
questions.rule: उः + vowel → उर् + vowel: स्युः + आगंतवः = स्युरागंतवः.

questions.q: The word for 'diseases' in line 1 is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: गदाः is the plural of गद, disease.
questions.teaches: गदाः (diseases) ends the clause of line 1.

questions.q: By the pattern of कामक्रोधभयाद्याः, what does the invented word रूपरसगंधाद्याः mean?
options: The end of form, taste and smell
Form, taste, smell and the like
The best among form, taste and smell
optionExplain: आद्य means first, not end.
'Without' would use a negating अ-.
Right: -आद्याः means 'having these as the first', that is 'and the like'.
आद्य here gives 'first of a group', not 'best'.
questions.explain: In कामक्रोधभयाद्याः the end -आद्याः turns the list into 'desire, anger, fear and the like'.
questions.rule: X-Y-आद्याः = X, Y and the like.
questions.teaches: A list ending in -आद्याः means 'these and the like': कामक्रोधभयाद्याः = desire, anger, fear and the like.

questions.q: Which rite does line 2 name first, and where is it said to be prescribed?
options: A fire sacrifice prescribed in the hymns of the Ṛgveda
A penance prescribed in the old books of sacred law
A purifying bath prescribed in the Yajurveda texts
A pacificatory rite prescribed in the Atharva (Veda)
optionExplain: The line names the Atharva, not the Ṛgveda.
The line names the Atharva.
The line names the Atharva, and a pacificatory rite.
Right: अथर्वविहिता शान्तिः is the first item of line 2.
questions.explain: अथर्वविहिता शान्तिः = the pacificatory rite prescribed in the Atharva (Veda).
questions.rule: अथर्वविहिता शान्तिः = pacificatory rite prescribed in the Atharva.

questions.q: Put the three things whose knowledge opens line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The word runs देश, काल, आत्म and then विज्ञानम्, 'knowledge'.

questions.q: Match each word of line 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These four words build the two items of line 2.
questions.rule: प्रतिकूल = unfavourable; अर्चन = worship; शान्ति = pacificatory rite; विहित = prescribed.
questions.teaches: विहित means 'prescribed': अथर्वविहिता is 'prescribed in the Atharva'.

questions.q: Which is the right split of प्रतिकूलग्रहार्चनं?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ joins as आ: ग्रह + अर्चन = ग्रहार्चन.
आर्चनं is not a word.
ग्रहार् and चनं are not words.
Neither part is a word.
questions.explain: प्रतिकूल (unfavourable) + ग्रह (graha) + अर्चनं (worship) make one word.
questions.rule: अ + अ → आ: ग्रह + अर्चन = ग्रहार्चन.

questions.q: Which of these are named in this unit?
optionExplain: Right: देश opens line 1.
Right: काल is next.
Right: it closes line 2.
Massage is in unit 38.
Bathing is in unit 38.
questions.explain: Place, time and the worship of unfavourable grahas are in the unit; massage and bathing belong to unit 38.
questions.rule: Unit 41: देश, काल, आत्मा; अथर्वविहिता शान्तिः; प्रतिकूलग्रहार्चनम्.

questions.q: By the pattern of अथर्वविहिता, what does the invented phrase वेदविहितं कर्म mean?
options: An action rejected by the Veda
An action prescribed in the Veda
An action done before the Veda
An action that is the Veda itself
optionExplain: विहित does not mean rejected.
Right: -विहित means 'prescribed in' the first part.
Nothing in विहित gives 'before'.
विहित says 'prescribed', not 'identical with'.
questions.explain: In अथर्वविहिता the first part says where, the second says 'prescribed'; वेदविहित is built the same.
questions.teaches: A compound X-विहित means 'prescribed in X': अथर्वविहिता = prescribed in the Atharva; वेदविहित = prescribed in the Veda.

questions.q: What does the unit say has been shown in brief?
options: A cure for each single disease
A rule for the seasons of the year
optionExplain: No cure for single diseases is named.
No list of medicines is named here.
Right: विधिरेषः प्रदर्शितः with अनुत्पत्त्यै and समासेन.
No season is named here.
questions.explain: The second line says: for non-arising, this procedure has been shown in brief.

questions.q: Put the parts of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The line runs अनुत्पत्त्यै, समासेन, विधिः एषः, प्रदर्शितः.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: These four words carry the two statements of the unit.
questions.rule: पृथक्पृथक् = separately; समासेन = in brief; अनुत्पत्त्यै = for non-arising; प्रदर्शितः = shown.
questions.teaches: Words such as पृथक्पृथक् (doubled for 'each separately') and समासेन ('in brief') tell how a matter has been treated.

questions.q: Which is the right split of विधिरेषः?
optionExplain: रेषः is not a word.
षः is not a word.
अषः is not a word on the card.
Right: A visarga after इ before a vowel becomes र्.
questions.explain: विधिः (procedure) + एषः (this) join as विधिरेषः.
questions.rule: इः + vowel → इर् + vowel: विधिः + एषः = विधिरेषः.

questions.q: How does line 1 say the means of not being touched by bhūtas has been indicated?
optionExplain: Right: पृथक्पृथक् means separately.
The line says the opposite: separately.
The line says it has been indicated already.
The line says a means has been indicated.
questions.explain: निर्दिष्टश्च पृथक्पृथक्: and indicated, each separately.

questions.q: By the pattern of अनुत्पत्त्यै, what does the invented रक्षायै in विधिः रक्षायै mean?
optionExplain: 'By' would be रक्षया.
Right: A feminine word in -आ has the dative singular -आयै, and it says 'for'.
'In' would be रक्षायाम्.
'From' would be रक्षायाः.
questions.explain: अनुत्पत्त्यै is the dative of अनुत्पत्ति: 'for non-arising'; रक्षायै is the dative of रक्षा.
questions.teaches: The dative singular of a feminine word in -आ ends in -आयै (रक्षायै); a feminine -इ word can end in -त्यै (अनुत्पत्त्यै) or -तये: it says 'for ...', purpose.

questions.q: For what does this line say, regarding disorders that have already arisen?
optionExplain: The word is शान्तये, pacification.
The line says pacification.
Right: उत्पन्नानां च शान्तये: and for the pacification of those arisen.
The line says pacification.
questions.explain: उत्पन्नानां are those that have arisen; शान्तये is 'for pacification'.
questions.rule: उत्पन्नानां च शान्तये = for the pacification of those arisen.

questions.q: Put the parts of the line in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The line runs निजागंतुविकाराणाम्, उत्पन्नानाम्, च, शान्तये.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: These four words make up the whole line.
questions.rule: निज = innate; आगन्तु = adventitious; विकार = disorder; शान्ति = pacification.
questions.teaches: निज (innate) and आगन्तु (adventitious) are the two kinds of disorder the line names; शान्ति is the aim for those that have arisen.

questions.q: Which is the right split of निजागंतुविकाराणां?
optionExplain: The card splits निज + आगंतु (adventitious); निजा + गंतु leaves a stray आ and breaks the compound.
Neither part is a word.
A visarga would not vanish like this.
Right: अ + आ joins as आ: निज + आगंतु = निजागंतु.
questions.explain: निज (innate) + आगंतु (adventitious) + विकाराणां (of disorders) join into one word.
questions.rule: अ + आ → आ: निज + आगंतु = निजागंतु.

questions.q: The word for 'for pacification' is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: शान्तये is the dative singular of शान्ति: 'for pacification'.
questions.teaches: शान्तये ends the line and gives the purpose.

questions.q: By the pattern of शान्तये, what does the invented word शुद्धये mean?
optionExplain: Right: The dative singular of a word in -इ ends in -अये and says 'for'.
'By' would be शुद्ध्या.
'In' would be शुद्धौ.
The subject would be शुद्धिः.
questions.explain: शान्तये is the dative of शान्ति; शुद्धये is the dative of शुद्धि.
questions.teaches: A feminine word in -इ can take the dative singular in -अये: शान्ति → शान्तये, 'for pacification'; शुद्धि → शुद्धये, 'for purification'.

questions.q: Which accumulation does the verse say is purified in spring?
options: The doṣa accumulation of the rainy season
The doṣa accumulation born of winter
The accumulation of poison in a wound
optionExplain: That one is purified at the passing of the clouds.
Right: शीतोद्भवं दोषचयं वसंते विशोधयन्.
Nothing like this is in the verse.
Nothing like this is in the verse.
questions.explain: In spring, the accumulation of doṣa born of winter is purified.
questions.rule: वसंते = in spring; शीतोद्भवं दोषचयं = the winter-born doṣa accumulation.

questions.q: Put the three accumulations purified in the verse in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The verse runs: born of winter, born of summer, then that of the rainy season.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
pairs: at the passing of the clouds
questions.explain: These four words say when and how the purifying is done.
questions.rule: वसंते = in spring; घनात्यये = at the passing of the clouds; आशु = quickly; सम्यक् = properly.
questions.teaches: घनात्यये is घन (cloud) + अत्यये (at the passing): a locative that says 'when'.

questions.q: Which is the right split of रोगानृतुजान्न?
optionExplain: A visarga before ऋ would give रोगा ऋ..., not रोगान्.
आनृतुजान् is not a word.
Right: रोगान् + ऋतुजान्: final न् is kept before a vowel and written joined (रोगानृतुजान्); ऋतुजान् + न is written ऋतुजान्न with no change.
तुजान् is not a word.
questions.explain: रोगान् (diseases) + ऋतुजान् (born of seasons) + न (not) join as रोगानृतुजान्न.
questions.rule: Final न् + vowel stay joined: रोगान् + ऋतुजान् = रोगानृतुजान्.

questions.q: What does the verse say the one who purifies in this way does not incur?
optionExplain: Wounds are not named in this verse.
Fear is not named in this verse.
Poison is not named in this verse.
Right: रोगानृतुजान्न जातु: never the diseases born of seasons.
questions.explain: प्राप्नोति रोगानृतुजान्न जातु = he never incurs the diseases born of seasons.
questions.rule: ऋतुजान् रोगान् न जातु = never the season-born diseases.

questions.q: By the pattern of ग्रीष्मजम्, what does the invented phrase मेघजं जलम् mean?
optionExplain: Right: -ज at the end means 'born of' the first part.
That would be जलजो मेघः, the order reversed.
-ज says 'born of', not 'filling'.
Nothing in -ज says 'going to'.
questions.explain: ग्रीष्मज = born of summer, शीतोद्भव = born of winter, ऋतुज = born of seasons; मेघज = born of the cloud.
questions.teaches: A compound ending in -ज (or -उद्भव) means 'born of' the first part: ग्रीष्मज = born of summer; ऋतुज = born of seasons; मेघज = born of the cloud.

questions.q: What does the verse say the person with these habits becomes?
optionExplain: Debt is not mentioned.
Right: भवत्यरोगः closes the verse.
Fame is not mentioned.
Learning is not mentioned.
questions.explain: The last words are भवत्यरोगः: he becomes free from disease.
questions.rule: भवति अरोगः = becomes free from disease.

questions.q: Put these habits in the order of the verse (leaving out दातासमः).
questions.explain: The verse runs: follower of wholesome food and conduct, acts after consideration, unattached, devoted to truth, forbearing, attends upon the trustworthy.
questions.rule: हिताहारविहारसेवी · समीक्ष्यकारी · विषयेष्वसक्तः · सत्यपरः · क्षमावान् · आप्तोपसेवी.

questions.q: Which is the right split of विषयेष्वसक्तः?
optionExplain: ओ + अ would give विषयेषोऽसक्तः.
वसक्तः is not a word.
Right: A final उ before a different vowel becomes व्: विषयेषु + अ = विषयेष्वसक्तः.
That would give विषयेषु सक्तः, 'attached', without the व.
questions.explain: विषयेषु (in sense-objects) + असक्तः (unattached); उ + अ became व् + अ.
questions.rule: उ + different vowel → व् + vowel: विषयेषु + असक्तः.
questions.teaches: A final उ before a different vowel becomes व् and the vowel joins it: विषयेषु + असक्तः = विषयेष्वसक्तः.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: These four words are four of the habits of the verse.
questions.rule: समीक्ष्यकारी = acting after consideration; असक्तः = unattached; सत्यपरः = devoted to truth; क्षमावान् = forbearing.

questions.q: Which of these does the verse say of the person?
optionExplain: Right: समीक्ष्यकारी.
Right: विषयेष्वसक्तः.
Right: आप्तोपसेवी.
The verse speaks of wholesome food, not of giving it up.
The verse says he attends upon trustworthy persons.
questions.explain: The first three are in the verse; the last two say the opposite of what it states.

questions.q: By the pattern of आप्तोपसेवी, what does the invented गुरुसेवी mean?
options: One who is served by a teacher
The teacher of one who serves
One who attends upon a teacher
optionExplain: The teacher is the one attended, not the server.
-सेवी does not mean leaving.
-सेवी names the one who serves.
Right: -सेवी names one who follows or attends the first part.
questions.explain: हिताहारविहारसेवी = one who follows wholesome food and conduct; आप्तोपसेवी = one who attends upon the trustworthy.
questions.rule: X-सेवी = one who follows or attends X.
questions.teaches: A compound ending in -सेवी names one who follows or attends the first part: हिताहारविहारसेवी; आप्तोपसेवी; गुरुसेवी.

questions.q: Which word of line 1 means 'unobtainable'?
optionExplain: Right: अलभ्य = unobtainable (a-labhya).
This means 'in those having means'.
This means 'showing regard'.
This means 'in objects'.
questions.explain: अर्थेषु अलभ्येषु: in unobtainable objects.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
pairs: one who has conquered the senses
questions.explain: Three words come from line 1 and one (जितेन्द्रिय) from line 2; these are the plain compounds.
questions.rule: अलभ्य = unobtainable; अकृतप्रयत्न = making no effort; कृतादर = showing regard; जितेन्द्रिय = one who has conquered the senses.

questions.q: Put the three phrases of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The line runs: in unobtainable objects making no effort, showing regard, always in those having means.
questions.teaches: A line can be read in three phrases: the first with no effort, the second 'showing regard', the third 'always in those having means'.

questions.q: Which is the right split of अर्थेष्वलभ्येष्वकृतप्रयत्नं?
optionExplain: वलभ्येष is not a word.
Right: A final उ before a different vowel becomes व्.
ओ + अ would give ओऽ.
That would drop the negating अ- and change the meaning.
questions.explain: अर्थेषु + अलभ्येषु + अकृतप्रयत्नं: उ + अ became व्, so the words are joined.

questions.q: Which words of line 1 begin with the negating अ-?
optionExplain: Right: a-labhya, unobtainable.
Right: a-kṛta-prayatna, effort not made.
कृत + आदर: the आ comes from joining, not from a negation.
It begins with उ, not a negation.
questions.explain: Only अलभ्येषु and अकृतप्रयत्नं carry the negating अ-.

questions.q: By the pattern of उपायवत्सु, what does the invented धनवत्सु mean?
optionExplain: 'Without' would use a negating अ-.
That would be a dative, धनाय.
Right: -वत् means 'having' the first part.
That would be धनात्.
questions.explain: उपायवत्सु = in those having means (upāya); धनवत्सु = among those having wealth.
questions.teaches: A word in -वत् means 'having' the first part: उपायवत् = having means; धनवत् = having wealth.

questions.q: For whom does the verse say these are for happiness?
optionExplain: No king is mentioned.
No physician is mentioned.
No student is mentioned.
Right: धीरस्य सदासुखाय names the steadfast person.
questions.explain: भवंति धीरस्य सदासुखाय = they are always for the happiness of the steadfast person.
questions.rule: धीरस्य सदा सुखाय = for the steadfast, always for happiness.

questions.q: Put these items in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The verse runs: favourable time, agreeable sense-objects, righteous acts and happy action, controllable mind, clear intellect.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: These four words describe time, objects, mind and intellect.
questions.rule: अनुकूल = favourable; मनोज्ञ = agreeable; विधेय = controllable; विशद = clear.
questions.teaches: Each item of the verse gets one describing word: time is अनुकूल, objects मनोज्ञ, mind विधेय, intellect विशद.

questions.q: The printed word विषया ends in -आ. What is the full form?
options: विषयाः, with the visarga dropped before a voiced sound
विषयः, a single object, which would need a singular verb
विषयाम्, an object as the one acted on
optionExplain: Right: A trailing -आ can be -आः with the visarga dropped before a voiced consonant.
One object would be विषयः, not विषया.
The verb भवंति is plural and needs a plural subject.
This would end in -ए, not -आ.
questions.explain: विषयाः मनोज्ञाः: sense-objects, agreeable; the next word starts with the voiced म.
questions.rule: -आ for -आः before a voiced sound: not a typo.

questions.q: Which of these does the verse list as being for the steadfast person's happiness?
optionExplain: Right: सत्त्वं विधेयम्.
Right: विशदा च बुद्धिः.
Right: कालोऽनुकूलः.
Not in the verse.
Not in the verse.
questions.explain: A controllable mind, a clear intellect and a favourable time are listed; unrestrained senses and great wealth are not.
questions.rule: कालः · विषयाः · क्रियाः · कर्म · सत्त्वं · बुद्धिः.

questions.q: By the pattern of सुखानुबंधि, what does the invented लाभानुबंधि कर्म mean?
optionExplain: 'Without' would use a negating अ-.
Right: -अनुबंधि at the end means 'followed by' the first part.
-अनुबंधि means 'followed by' the first part (the gain comes after the action); the option reverses that order.
The word is built on 'followed by', not 'born of'.
questions.explain: सुखानुबंधि कर्म = action followed by happiness; लाभानुबंधि कर्म = action followed by gain.
questions.teaches: A compound ending in -अनुबंधि means 'followed by' the first part: सुखानुबंधि = followed by happiness; लाभानुबंधि = followed by gain.

questions.q: What is the name of the fifth chapter, as this closing line gives it?
optionExplain: That is the name of chapter 3.
That is the name of chapter 4.
Right: रोगानुत्पादनीयो नाम पंचमोऽध्यायः.
That is the name of chapter 2.
questions.explain: The line names the chapter रोगानुत्पादनीय.

questions.q: Put the words of the closing line in the order of the line.
questions.explain: The line runs इति, रोगानुत्पादनीयः, नाम, पंचमः, अध्यायः.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: These three words are the frame of the closing line.
questions.rule: इति = thus; नाम = by name; पंचम = fifth.
questions.teaches: In this closing line the frame is इति + title + नाम + number + अध्यायः.

questions.q: Which is the right split of रोगानुत्पादनीयो नाम?
optionExplain: म् before न would stay as म् or a dot, not ओ.
आः before a voiced sound drops to आ, not ओ.
ए stays ए, it does not become ओ.
Right: अः before a voiced sound such as न becomes ओ.
questions.explain: The title word ends in -अः; before नाम it became -ओ.

questions.q: The word for 'chapter' in the closing line is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: अध्यायः means chapter.
questions.teaches: अध्यायः ends the line.

questions.q: Following पंचमोऽध्यायः, how is षष्ठः (sixth) before the word अध्यायः written in sandhi, as two words?
optionExplain: Right: षष्ठः + अध्यायः: अः + अ becomes ओऽ.
ए would be the locative, 'in the sixth chapter'.
That is a single compound word, not the two-word sandhi of the pattern.
The visarga before अ becomes ओऽ here, not a gap.
questions.explain: पंचमः + अध्यायः gives पंचमोऽध्यायः; षष्ठः + अध्यायः gives षष्ठोऽध्यायः.
questions.teaches: The masculine ordinal ends in -अः; before अध्यायः it joins as ओऽ: पंचमोऽध्यायः, षष्ठोऽध्यायः.

questions.q: To whom does the opening line श्रीगणेशाय नमः offer salutation?
optionExplain: Ātreya is named in unit 3 as a speaker, not saluted here.
Right: गणेशाय = to Gaṇeśa; श्री = revered.
No student is named in the line.
The madana fruit appears from unit 4 on, not in this line.
questions.explain: श्रीगणेशाय नमः = salutation to the revered Gaṇeśa.
questions.rule: Dative name + नमः = salutation to that one.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Match each word of the opening line to its meaning.
questions.explain: Three words: a mark of respect, the one honoured (dative), and the salutation.
questions.rule: श्री = revered; गणेशाय = to Gaṇeśa; नमः = salutation.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: What does the ending -आय in गणेशाय show here?
optionExplain: The genitive would be गणेशस्य.
The locative would be गणेशे.
Right: Masculine -अ stems take -आय in the dative singular; with नमः it names the one honoured.
The subject form would be गणेशः.
questions.explain: गणेशाय is m. dat. sg.: the salutation is offered to Gaṇeśa.
questions.rule: With नमः the one honoured stands in the dative.
questions.teaches: With नमः the one honoured stands in the dative: गणेशाय = to Gaṇeśa.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Which English rendering of श्रीगणेशाय नमः has one wrong word?
optionExplain: Correct: this is the card's rendering.
Correct: नमः can be rendered 'homage'.
Correct: only the word order differs.
Right: Wrong: गणेशाय is dative, 'to', not 'from'.
questions.explain: The dative गणेशाय means 'to Gaṇeśa'; 'from' would need another case.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: The word of the line that means 'salutation' is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: नमः = salutation, homage; it closes the line श्रीगणेशाय नमः.
questions.teaches: नमः means salutation; the one saluted stands before it in the dative.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: On the pattern of गणेशाय नमः, which phrase means salutation to Śiva?
optionExplain: Right: शिव is an -अ stem like गणेश; its dative is शिवाय.
शिवस्य is the genitive, 'of Śiva'.
शिवे is the locative, 'in Śiva'.
शिवः is the subject form, not 'to Śiva'.
questions.explain: Same pattern: dative of the name + नमः.
questions.teaches: The dative singular of an -अ stem ends in -आय: गणेशाय, शिवाय; it goes with नमः.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: What topic does the opening formula of this chapter announce?
options: The rules of the daily routine
The signs of the six seasons
optionExplain: Purgation is not named; वमन is emesis.
Right: वमनकल्पम् = the Vamanakalpa, formulations (कल्प) for emesis (वमन).
The daily routine is not the topic named here.
No season is named in this line.
questions.explain: अथातो वमनकल्पं व्याख्यास्यामः = now, therefore, we shall explain the Vamanakalpa.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Put these words of the formula in the order of the line.
questions.explain: The line runs: now, therefore, the Vamanakalpa, we shall explain.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Match each word of the formula to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two particles, the topic (object) and the verb.
questions.rule: अथ = now; अतः = therefore; वमनकल्पम् = emesis formulations; व्याख्यास्यामः = we shall explain.
questions.teaches: The opening formula has four parts: अथ (now), अतः (therefore), the topic, and व्याख्यास्यामः (we shall explain).
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Which is the right split of अथातो, standing before वमनकल्पम्?
optionExplain: Neither अथा nor तः is a word of the card.
A final -अ would stay -अ; the ओ comes from -अः.
Right: अ + अ → आ (अथात-), and अः before a voiced consonant (व) becomes ओ.
These pieces are not the words अथ and अतः.
questions.explain: अथ (now) + अतः (therefore) = अथातः, written अथातो before व.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Which English rendering fits the form of व्याख्यास्यामः?
optionExplain: The -स्य- marks the future, not the present.
The ending -आमः is 1st person plural, 'we'.
An optative would end in -एत्.
Right: The data label is 1 pl. fut. of वि-आ-√ख्या: future, 1st person plural.
questions.explain: व्याख्यास्यामः = we shall explain (future, 1st person plural).
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Join a new example, ततः + वदति (then he speaks). Which is right?
optionExplain: Right: -अः before a voiced consonant (व) becomes -ओ, as in अथातो वमन-.
The visarga after अ does not stay before a voiced consonant.
The visarga becomes र् only after vowels other than अ/आ.
श् comes before च, छ or श, not before व.
questions.explain: Same rule as अतः + वमन- = अतो वमन-.
questions.teaches: -अः before a voiced consonant becomes -ओ: अतः + वमन- = अतो वमन-; ततः + वदति = ततो वदति.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Whom does the line name as having said this?
options: Ātreya and the other great sages
The kings of an earlier age
optionExplain: Gaṇeśa is saluted in unit 1; he is not the speaker here.
Right: आत्रेयादयो महर्षयः = Ātreya and the other great sages.
No pupils are named in the line.
No king is named in the line.
questions.explain: इति ह स्माहुः = thus indeed (they) said; the speakers are Ātreya and the other great sages.
questions.rule: आत्रेय-आदयः महर्षयः = Ātreya and the other great sages.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Match each word of the line to its meaning.
questions.explain: इति and ह frame the report; आहुः is the verb; महर्षयः the speakers.
questions.rule: इति = thus; ह = indeed; आहुः = said; महर्षयः = great sages.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Put these words in the order of the line.
questions.explain: The line runs: thus, indeed, (past), said, Ātreya and others, great sages.
questions.rule: इति · ह · स्म · आहुः · आत्रेयादयः · महर्षयः.
questions.teaches: The formula is इति ह स्म आहुः followed by the speakers: Ātreya and the other great sages.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Which is the right split of स्माहुरात्रेय-?
optionExplain: स्मा and हुः are not words of the card.
The name is आत्रेय; the र् is the visarga of आहुः.
Right: अ + आ → आ (स्माहु-); the visarga after उ becomes र् before a vowel.
स्म is a particle with no visarga.
questions.explain: स्म (past sense) + आहुः (said) + आत्रेय (the sage's name).
questions.rule: Visarga after इ/उ before a vowel → र्.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: What does the particle स्म add to आहुः in this line?
optionExplain: A command would need an imperative form.
स्म points to the past, not the future.
Negation would need न.
Right: The data glosses स्म as a particle with past sense.
questions.explain: ह स्म आहुः is a narrative formula: 'indeed (they) said'.
questions.rule: स्म with a verb = past sense.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Join a new example, देव + ऋषिः (divine sage), as one word. Which is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ/आ + ऋ → अर्, as in महा + ऋषयः = महर्षयः.
The two vowels are not left side by side.
अ + ऋ does not give a long आर्.
ओ is not made from अ + ऋ.
questions.explain: Same rule as महा + ऋषयः = महर्षयः.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before ऋ becomes अर्: महा + ऋषयः = महर्षयः; देव + ऋषिः = देवर्षिः.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Which part of the named plants does unit 4 call best for emesis?
optionExplain: Roots are not named in the unit.
Right: The long compound ends in -फलानि: the fruits of these plants.
Leaves are not named in the unit.
Bark is not named in the unit.
questions.explain: मदन…कुटजफलानि च श्रेष्ठानि = the fruits of madana … kuṭaja are the best.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Match each word of unit 4 to its meaning or identification on the card.
questions.explain: Two firm identifications, one probable, and the predicate 'best'.
questions.rule: मदन = emetic nut; कुटज = kurchi; जीमूतक = Luffa echinata (probable); श्रेष्ठानि = best.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Put these clear words of unit 4 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: The unit opens 'among emetic substances', lists madana first and kuṭaja last, and ends with 'best'.
questions.teaches: The list of best emetic fruits begins with madana (then jīmūtaka) and ends with kuṭaja.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Which two identifications does the card mark as standard (firm)?
optionExplain: Right: tagged standard.
Not standard: tagged probable.
Right: tagged standard.
Wrong: the emetic nut is madana; kuṭaja is kurchi.
questions.explain: Only madana and kuṭaja are firm; jīmūtaka is probable, ikṣvāku disputed, kukkṛtikā and śātakī unidentified.
questions.rule: Standard: madana, kuṭaja. Probable: jīmūtaka. Disputed: ikṣvāku.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: A student says unit 4 gives the dose of each fruit. What does the unit state?
options: The dose of each fruit, in pala
The month for gathering each fruit
That these fruits are the best emetics
How to dry the fruits in the sun
optionExplain: No measure appears in the unit.
Gathering is described later (unit 9), not here.
Right: The unit only ranks them: श्रेष्ठानि, the best.
Drying comes in unit 10, not here.
questions.explain: Unit 4 is a ranking: the best emetic fruits. Doses and methods are not in it.
questions.rule: X-द्रव्याणाम् … श्रेष्ठानि = among X substances, these are the best.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: In an invented sentence पुष्पाणां कमलं श्रेष्ठम्, what does पुष्पाणाम् mean, as वमनद्रव्याणाम् does here?
optionExplain: 'With' would need the instrumental (पुष्पैः).
'For' would need the dative (पुष्पेभ्यः).
'From' would need the ablative (पुष्पेभ्यः).
Right: A genitive plural with श्रेष्ठ picks the best out of a group.
questions.explain: वमनद्रव्याणाम् = among emetic substances; पुष्पाणाम् = among flowers.
questions.rule: Genitive plural + श्रेष्ठ = the best among …
questions.teaches: A genitive plural beside श्रेष्ठ means 'among': वमनद्रव्याणाम् … श्रेष्ठानि = the best among emetic substances.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Which fruit does unit 5 single out from the best emetic fruits?
optionExplain: Right: मदनफलम् = the madana fruit.
Kuṭaja closes the list of unit 4; unit 5 names madana.
Jīmūtaka is in the list, but unit 5 names madana.
Śātakī is a doubtful name of unit 4, not picked here.
questions.explain: तेष्वपि मदनफलम् = among these too, the madana fruit.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Match each word of unit 5 to its meaning.
questions.explain: तेषु points back to the list of unit 4; अपि marks 'even among them'.
questions.rule: तेषु = among these; अपि = too; मदनफलम् = madana fruit.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: तेषु + अपि join in unit 5 as ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: Final उ before a different vowel becomes व्: तेषु + अपि = तेष्वपि.
questions.teaches: Final उ before a different vowel becomes व्: तेषु + अपि = तेष्वपि.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: In unit 5, what does तेषु (among these) point back to?
options: The best emetic fruits of unit 4
The grains of the drying heap
optionExplain: तेषु is neuter here (n. loc. pl.); it points to the fruits, not the sages.
Right: तेषु takes up the list of unit 4, which ends with श्रेष्ठानि.
Unit 6 comes after; तेषु points back to unit 4.
The grain heap is in unit 10, later.
questions.explain: तेष्वपि मदनफलम् = among these (the best emetic fruits of unit 4) too, the madana fruit.
questions.rule: तेषु (n. loc. pl.) = among these: the fruits just listed.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Unit 5 has no verb. What sense does the data carry over from unit 4?
options: That madana fruit must be boiled
That madana fruit is the best
That madana fruit is hard to find
optionExplain: Harm is not mentioned in either unit.
Boiling is not mentioned in either unit.
Right: Unit 4 ends with श्रेष्ठानि, the best; unit 5 narrows it to madana.
Rarity is not mentioned in either unit.
questions.explain: The predicate 'best' of unit 4 is understood: among the best, madana fruit (is best).
questions.rule: An elliptical unit takes its predicate from the unit before.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Join a new example, गुरुषु + अपि (even among teachers). Which is right?
optionExplain: The उ cannot simply drop.
That would need -ओ, not -उ, before अपि.
उ + अ does not give ऊ.
Right: उ before a different vowel becomes व्, as in तेष्वपि.
questions.explain: Same rule as तेषु + अपि = तेष्वपि.
questions.teaches: Final उ before a different vowel becomes व्: तेषु + अपि = तेष्वपि; गुरुषु + अपि = गुरुष्वपि.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: According to unit 6, what decides the precedence among these drugs and preparations?
optionExplain: Right: दोष-…-आदि-वशात् = by the sway of doṣa and the like (the second word is a proofread reading, see the note).
Price is not mentioned.
Colour is not mentioned in this unit.
The age of the plant is not mentioned.
questions.explain: …वशात् … प्राधान्यम् = the precedence is by the sway of doṣa, dūṣya and the like.
questions.rule: Precedence follows doṣa, dūṣya and the like.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Match each word of unit 6 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The unit says whose precedence (of these, of preparations) and by what (the sway of doṣa etc.).
questions.rule: प्राधान्यम् = precedence; वशात् = by the sway of; एषाम् = of these; कल्पनानाम् = of preparations.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Put these words of unit 6 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: The cause comes first (…वशात्), then whose precedence, then the word प्राधान्यम्.
questions.teaches: Unit 6 puts the deciding factor first (…वशात्) and ends with प्राधान्यम्, precedence.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Which is the right split of वशाच्चैषाम्?
optionExplain: च्च is not a word.
Right: त् before च becomes च् (च्च); अ + ए → ऐ (चैषाम्).
चै and षाम् are not words of the card.
A visarga before च would become श्: वशश्च.
questions.explain: वशात् (by the sway of) + च (and) + एषाम् (of these).
questions.rule: त् + च → च्च; अ + ए → ऐ.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: A physician must choose between two emetic preparations. By unit 6, what should guide the choice?
options: Madana in every case, whatever the doṣa
The doṣa and the like in the case
Whichever drug comes first in a list
optionExplain: Unit 6 makes precedence depend on doṣa etc., not fixed.
Cost is not mentioned.
Right: Precedence is by the sway of doṣa and the like.
List order is not given as the rule.
questions.explain: Unit 6: precedence among drugs and preparations depends on doṣa, dūṣya and the like.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Join a new example, तस्मात् + च (and therefore). Which is right?
optionExplain: त् does not stay before च.
द् comes before voiced sounds, not before च.
न् comes before a nasal, not before च.
Right: त् before च becomes च्, as in वशात् + च = वशाच्च.
questions.explain: Same rule as वशात् + च = वशाच्च.
questions.teaches: त् before च becomes च्: वशात् + च = वशाच्च; तस्मात् + च = तस्माच्च.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: What does unit 7 give as the cause of the innumerable variety?
options: The many differences of state of doṣa and the rest
The many regions where the drugs grow
The many authors who wrote on emesis
The many names given to each drug
optionExplain: Right: अतिबहु-अवस्था-भेदात् = from the very many differences of state.
Regions are not mentioned.
No authors are mentioned.
Names of drugs are not mentioned.
questions.explain: दोषादीनाम् … अवस्थाभेदात् = because of the differences of state of doṣa and the rest.
questions.rule: Many states of doṣa → innumerable formulations, mishaps, means.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Match each word of unit 7 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The cause (differences of state) and two of the three things that are innumerable.
questions.rule: व्यापद् = mishap; साधन = means; असंख्येयत्व = innumerability; अवस्थाभेद = difference of state.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Put these words of unit 7 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Cause first (states of doṣa), then the field (emesis etc.), then the things, then 'innumerability'.
questions.rule: दोषादीनाम् · अवस्थाभेदात् · वमनादिषु · व्यापदाम् · साधनानाम् · असंख्येयत्वम्.
questions.teaches: Unit 7 runs from cause (the many states of doṣa) to field (emesis and the like) to result (innumerable).
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Which is the right split of वमनादिषु?
optionExplain: दिषु is not a word.
Right: अ + आ → आ: वमन + आदिषु = वमनादिषु, 'in emesis and the rest'.
म् before a vowel would stay: वमनमादिषु.
ए before आ would not give -ना-.
questions.explain: वमन (emesis) + आदिषु (in … and the rest, loc. pl.).
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: A reader asks for the full count of the mishaps (व्यापद्) in emesis. By unit 7, what is the answer?
options: Six, one for each best fruit
optionExplain: Unit 7 gives no number; it says they are innumerable.
No number of mishaps is given.
Right: असंख्येयत्वम्: the mishaps and means are innumerable.
Seasons are not mentioned.
questions.explain: Because the states of doṣa differ so much, mishaps and means in emesis are innumerable.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Like असंख्येयत्वम् (innumerability), what does a new word लघुत्वम् mean?
optionExplain: The adjective is लघु, without -त्व.
'Very' would need a word like अति.
That would be a participle, not a -त्व noun.
Right: -त्व makes an abstract noun: लघु (light) + त्व = lightness.
questions.explain: असंख्येय (innumerable) + त्व = innumerability; लघु + त्व = lightness.
questions.teaches: -त्व added to a word makes an abstract noun: असंख्येयत्वम् = innumerability; लघुत्वम् = lightness.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: In what form does unit 8 say the Kalpasiddhi section will be taught?
options: As a complete list of recipes
As a secret for kings alone
As a summary of earlier books
optionExplain: Right: उदाहरण-मात्रम् = a mere example.
The unit says it gives examples, not everything.
Kings are not mentioned.
Earlier books are not mentioned.
questions.explain: उदाहरणमात्रं कल्पसिद्धिस्थानमुपदेक्ष्यते = the Kalpasiddhi section will be taught as a mere example.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Put these words of unit 8 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Therefore · of the intelligent · to show the path of variations · a mere example · the Kalpasiddhi section · will be taught.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Match each word of unit 8 to its meaning.
questions.explain: For whom, to show what, in what form, and the verb.
questions.rule: बुद्धिमताम् = of the intelligent; विकल्पमार्ग = path of variations; उदाहरणमात्रम् = mere example; उपदेक्ष्यते = will be taught.
questions.teaches: The section is taught as examples, to show the intelligent the path of variations.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Which rendering of उदाहरणमात्रं कल्पसिद्धिस्थानमुपदेक्ष्यते has one wrong word?
options: The Kalpasiddhi section will be taught as an example
The Kalpasiddhi section was taught as an example
As an example, the Kalpasiddhi section will be taught
The Kalpasiddhi section will be taught, as a mere example
optionExplain: Correct: future passive.
Right: Wrong: उपदेक्ष्यते is future, 'will be taught', not past.
Correct: only the word order differs.
Correct: मात्र rendered 'mere'.
questions.explain: उपदेक्ष्यते = 3 sg. future passive of उप-√दिश्: will be taught.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: For whom, and to what end, does unit 8 say the section is taught?
options: To give beginners fixed recipes to copy
To show kings the cost of the drugs
To show the intelligent the path of variations
To warn the sick which drugs to avoid
optionExplain: The unit speaks of variations, not fixed recipes.
Kings and cost are not mentioned.
Right: बुद्धिमतां विकल्पमार्गदर्शनार्थम्.
No warning to the sick is given.
questions.explain: -अर्थम् = for the purpose of: to show the path of variations to the intelligent.
questions.rule: बुद्धिमताम् (for the intelligent) · विकल्पमार्गदर्शनार्थम् (to show the path of variations).
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: Like विकल्पमार्गदर्शनार्थम् (for showing the path of variations), what does a new word ज्ञानार्थम् mean?
optionExplain: 'By means of' would need the instrumental (ज्ञानेन).
'Without' would need विना or a negative prefix, not -अर्थम्.
'From' would need the ablative (ज्ञानात्).
Right: -अर्थम् at the end of a compound = 'for the purpose of'.
questions.explain: दर्शन + अर्थम् = for showing; ज्ञान + अर्थम् = for the sake of knowledge.
questions.rule: X-अर्थम् = for the purpose of X.
questions.teaches: -अर्थम् at the end of a compound means 'for the purpose of': विकल्पमार्गदर्शनार्थम्, ज्ञानार्थम्.
questions.section: वमनकल्प का आरम्भ और श्रेष्ठ वमन-द्रव्य

questions.q: When does unit 9 say the madana fruits should be taken?
optionExplain: Right: वसन्त-ग्रीष्मयोः अन्तरे = in the interval of spring and summer.
The rains are not named.
Winter is not named.
Autumn is not named.
questions.explain: वसन्तग्रीष्मयोरन्तरे = between spring and summer.
questions.rule: Collect madana fruits between spring and summer.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 9 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The time words and the verb of the unit.
questions.rule: वसन्त = spring; ग्रीष्म = summer; अन्तरे = in the interval; अहनि = on a day; आददीत = one should take.

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 9 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Season, day, moment, which fruits, then 'one should take madana fruits'.
questions.rule: season · day · muhūrta · kind of fruit · take.
questions.teaches: Unit 9 gives the time (season, day, muhūrta) first, then which fruits, then the verb आददीत.

questions.q: Which is the right split of ग्रीष्मयोरन्तरे?
optionExplain: रन्तरे is not a word; the र् is the visarga.
Right: A visarga after ओ becomes र् before a vowel.
म् before a vowel would stay म्: ग्रीष्मयोमन्तरे.
These pieces are not words of the card.
questions.explain: ग्रीष्मयोः (gen. du., of [spring and] summer) + अन्तरे (in the interval).
questions.rule: Visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ, before a vowel → र्.

questions.q: A collector plans to gather madana fruits in the rainy season. By unit 9, is that the time?
options: Yes, if the day is auspicious
No: the time is between spring and summer
Yes, if he dries them at once
optionExplain: The unit fixes the time: between spring and summer.
An auspicious day is needed, but within the stated season.
Right: वसन्तग्रीष्मयोरन्तरे = in the interval of spring and summer.
Drying (unit 10) does not change the time of collecting.
questions.explain: Unit 9 fixes the collecting time: between spring and summer, on an auspicious day and moment.
questions.rule: वसन्त-ग्रीष्मयोः अन्तरे = between spring and summer.

questions.q: Join a new example, न + अतिदीर्घम् (not very long). Which is right?
optionExplain: The two vowels are not left side by side.
ए comes from अ + इ, not अ + अ.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not अ + अ.
Right: अ + अ → आ, as in न + अति = नाति in नातिहरित.
questions.explain: Same rule as न + अति-हरित = नातिहरित.
questions.teaches: अ + अ → आ: न + अति = नाति (नातिहरित, नातिदीर्घम्).

questions.q: For how long does unit 10 keep the fruits in the grain heap?
optionExplain: Right: अष्टरात्रम् उषितानि = kept for eight nights.
The unit says eight (अष्ट).
No month is mentioned.
No season is named here.
questions.explain: अष्टरात्रम् = for eight nights.
questions.rule: Eight nights in the grain heap.

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 10 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Wipe, tie, smear, keep eight nights, take out, dry in the sun.
questions.rule: प्रमृज्य · बध्वा (छपा रूप) · आलिप्य · अष्टरात्रम् उषितानि · उद्धृत्य · आतपे शोषयेत्.

questions.q: Match each grain named in unit 10 to its English name.
questions.explain: Four of the grains of which the heap may be made (identifications standard in the data).
questions.rule: यव = barley; माष = black gram; कुलत्थ = horse gram; मुद्ग = green gram.
questions.teaches: The heap may be of barley (यव), black gram (माष), horse gram (कुलत्थ) or green gram (मुद्ग), among others.

questions.q: How does the card read …मुद्गान्यतमराशौ, the heap in which the fruits are kept?
options: A heap of all these grains mixed
A heap of any one of these grains
A heap of two of them, in pairs
A heap of each grain in turn
optionExplain: अन्यतम means one of them, not all together.
Right: अन्यतम = any one of them.
Nothing in the unit pairs the grains.
One heap of one grain is meant, not each in turn.
questions.explain: यव…मुद्ग-अन्यतम-राशौ = in a heap of any one of barley … green gram.

questions.q: A helper has these heaps ready. Which may be used for the eight nights, by unit 10?
optionExplain: Right: शालि is named.
Right: मुद्ग is named.
Wrong: sand is not among the items named.
Right: कुलत्थ is named.
questions.explain: Any one of the named grains will do; sand is not named.
questions.rule: The heap: any one of यव, बुस, माष, शालि, व्रीहि, कुलत्थ, मुद्ग.

questions.q: With a prefix the absolutive ends in -य (प्रमृज्य); without one, in -त्वा (e.g. कृत्वा). Which means having brought (आ + √नी)?
optionExplain: With a prefix, -त्वा is replaced by -य.
This is the past participle, 'brought', not 'having brought'.
Right: The root has the prefix आ-, so the ending is -य: आनीय.
This is the present, 'he brings'.
questions.explain: प्र-√मृज् → प्रमृज्य; आ-√लिप् → आलिप्य; उद्-√हृ → उद्धृत्य; but bare √कृ → कृत्वा.
questions.teaches: An absolutive of a root with a prefix ends in -य (प्रमृज्य, आलिप्य, आनीय); of a bare root in -त्वा (कृत्वा).

questions.q: What kind of pot does unit 11 ask for?
options: An old pot once used for ghee
Any pot, left open to the air
A new, dust-free pot, filled to the neck
optionExplain: The pot must be new (नवम्).
Neither copper nor half-filling is mentioned.
It is stored well guarded (सुगुप्तम्).
Right: नवं कलशम् अरजस्कम् आकण्ठं पूरयित्वा.
questions.explain: नवं कलशमरजस्कमाकण्ठं पूरयित्वा = filling a new, dust-free pot up to the neck.

questions.q: Match each substance in which the pieces are rubbed to its meaning.
questions.explain: The four substances of दधिघृतमधुपललविमृदिताः.
questions.rule: दधि = curd; घृत = ghee; मधु = honey; पलल = palala.

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 11 in the order of the text.
items: दही, घी, शहद, पलल में मसलना
questions.explain: Take out, rub, dry again, fill the pot, have it stored.
questions.rule: उद्धृत्य · विमृदिताः · पुनः शोषयित्वा · पूरयित्वा · निधापयेत्.
questions.teaches: Unit 11 runs: take out, rub with four substances, dry again, fill a new pot to the neck, store it guarded.

questions.q: Which is the right split of पिप्पलीरुद्धृत्य?
optionExplain: Right: A visarga after ई becomes र् before a vowel.
रुद्धृत्य is not a word; the र् is the visarga.
The word here is पिप्पलीः, acc. pl. with long ई.
र् is the sandhi result; the word itself ends in -ईः.
questions.explain: पिप्पलीः (f. acc. pl.) + उद्धृत्य (having taken out).
questions.rule: Visarga after ई before a vowel → र्.

questions.q: A helper rubs the pieces with curd, ghee, honey and palala and fills the pot at once. Which step is missing?
optionExplain: Boiling is not a step of this unit.
Right: After rubbing, the unit dries them again before filling the pot.
Kuśa appears in unit 10, not as a step here.
Grinding is not a step of this unit.
questions.explain: The order is rub, dry again (पुनः शोषयित्वा), then fill the pot.

questions.q: आकण्ठम् means up to the neck (आ + कण्ठ). On this pattern, what does a new word आजानु mean?
optionExplain: आ- here marks the limit reached, not 'below'.
'Without' would be a negative like निर्- or अ-.
Right: आ- before a noun, as an indeclinable, can mean 'up to'.
'Away from' would need the ablative.
questions.explain: आ + कण्ठ = up to the neck; आ + जानु = up to the knee.
questions.teaches: आ- joined to a noun as an indeclinable can mean 'up to': आकण्ठम् (up to the neck), आजानु (up to the knee).

questions.q: What is finally done with the crushed fruit-pippalīs in unit 12?
options: They are rubbed on the chest

questions.q: Which is the right split of प्रत्यक्पुष्प्यन्यतम-?

उ + अ would give व (पुष्प्वन्यतम), not य.
अः + अ would give ओऽ (पुष्पोऽन्यतम).

questions.q: पाययेत् is the causative of √पा (drink). What does a new sentence बालं दुग्धं पाययेत् mean?
options: The child should drink the milk itself
One should make the child drink milk
One should drink the milk of the child
One should give the child up for milk
optionExplain: That would be बालः दुग्धं पिबेत्, with the plain verb.
Right: Causative पाययेत् = cause (someone) to drink; बालम् is the one made to drink.
The child would then be in the genitive (बालस्य).
पाययेत् is about drinking, not giving up.
questions.explain: पिबेत् = one should drink; पाययेत् = one should make (another) drink.
questions.teaches: पाययेत् is the causative optative of √पा: 'one should make (someone) drink'; the plain optative is पिबेत्.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: Which is the right split of प्रतिश्यायान्तर्विद्रधिषु?

questions.q: विद्रधिषु is a locative plural, in abscesses. Which form means in fevers (ज्वर, an -अ stem)?

This is the instrumental plural, 'by fevers'.

questions.q: Put the body parts of unit 18 in the order of the text.

questions.teaches: Unit 18 names chest, throat and heart (उरःकण्ठहृदये) as smeared with thin Kapha.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: Which state calls for the milk-film in unit 18?
options: Pitta gone into the seat of Kapha
Pitta aggravated; chest, throat, heart under thin Kapha
Fire overcome by Kapha; body drying up
Raktapitta with burning of the heart
optionExplain: That state belongs to line 05.01.16.
Right: पित्ते प्रकुपिते … तनुकफोपादिग्धे.
That state belongs to line 05.01.20.
Those conditions belong to line 05.01.17.
questions.explain: Two parts: aggravated Pitta, and thin Kapha smeared on chest, throat and heart.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: How much of the milk-film does unit 18 give?
optionExplain: A fist is the measure of line 05.01.12.
The ladle appears in line 05.01.24, not as a measure here.
Right: अञ्जलिम् = a palmful, both hands cupped.
The pot is for storage in line 05.01.11.
questions.explain: सन्तानिकाम् अञ्जलिम् = a palmful of the film; no other measure is given.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: कफ + उपादिग्धे → कफोपादिग्धे. Join a new example, हित + उपदेशः (good advice). Which is right?
optionExplain: औ comes from अ + ओ/औ, not अ + उ.
ऊ comes from उ + उ, not अ + उ.
The two vowels do not stay side by side.
Right: अ + उ → ओ, as in कफ + उपादिग्ध.
questions.explain: Same rule as कफ + उपादिग्धे = कफोपादिग्धे.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before उ or ऊ becomes ओ: कफ + उपादिग्धे = कफोपादिग्धे; हित + उपदेशः = हितोपदेशः.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: What does तज्जम् (born of that) describe in unit 19?
optionExplain: Right: तज्जम् (n. acc. sg.) goes with दधि: curd born of that milk.
The gruel is in line 05.01.17.
Butter comes in line 05.01.20.
No decoction is named in this unit.
questions.explain: तज्जं वा दधि = or the curd born of that.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: Match each word of unit 19 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two preparations joined by वा.
questions.rule: तज्जम् = born of that; दधि = curd; दध्युत्तरम् = upper part of curd; वा = or.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: Which is the right split of दध्युत्तरम्?
optionExplain: अ + उ would give ओ (दध्योत्तरम्).
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: दधि + उत्तरम् → दध्युत्तरम्.
ए + उ would not give यु.
उ + उ would give ऊ (दधूत्तरम्).
questions.explain: दधि (curd) + उत्तरम् (upper part): इ → य्.
questions.teaches: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: दधि + उत्तरम् = दध्युत्तरम्.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: Which English rendering of unit 19's two foods has one wrong word?
options: Curd born of that, or the upper part of curd
Curd made from that, or the upper part of curd
Curd born of that, or the lower part of curd
The curd of that milk, or the curd's upper part
optionExplain: Not faulty: this is the card's rendering.
Not faulty: 'made from' renders तज्ज.
Right: This is the faulty one: उत्तर is 'upper', not 'lower'.
Not faulty: only the wording differs.
questions.explain: दध्युत्तरम् = the upper (उत्तर) part of curd.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: Which two may be given under unit 19?
options: The film of the cold milk
optionExplain: Wrong: fresh butter is the formulation of line 05.01.20.
Wrong: the film is the formulation of line 05.01.18.
Right: तज्जं दधि.
Right: दध्युत्तरम्.
questions.explain: Unit 19 offers curd or its upper part, as alternatives (वा).
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: तत् + जम् → तज्जम्. Join a new example, तत् + जलम् (that water). Which is right?
optionExplain: त् does not stay before ज.
द् would still change to ज् before ज.
च् comes before च/छ, not before ज.
Right: त् before ज becomes ज्: तज्जलम्.
questions.explain: Same rule as तत् + जम् = तज्जम्.
questions.teaches: Final त् before ज becomes ज्: तत् + जम् = तज्जम्; तत् + जलम् = तज्जलम्.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: What is produced from the milk in unit 20?
optionExplain: Right: नवनीतम् उत्पन्नम् = fresh butter produced.
Curd is the formulation of line 05.01.19.
Ghee is not named in this unit.
Whey is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: तस्माद्वा पयसो नवनीतमुत्पन्नम् = or the fresh butter produced from that milk.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: Match each word of unit 20 to its meaning.
questions.explain: What is made, how it is treated, and the fire of the first state.
questions.rule: नवनीत = fresh butter; उत्पन्न = produced; सिद्ध = cooked; अग्नि = fire.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 20 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: The butter; with the decoction; mixed with the powder; cooked; when the fire is overcome by Kapha.
questions.teaches: Unit 20: butter from that milk, cooked with the decoction of the six and mixed with their powder, for fire overcome by Kapha and a drying body.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: Which two states does unit 20 name for this butter?
options: Kapha overcome by fire; body swelling
Fire overcome by Kapha; body drying up
Pitta gone into the seat of Kapha
Pitta aggravated; chest under thin Kapha
optionExplain: The roles are reversed, and swelling is not named.
Right: कफाभिभूतेऽग्नौ शुष्यच्छरीरे च.
That state belongs to line 05.01.16.
That state belongs to line 05.01.18.
questions.explain: Kapha overcomes the fire (कफाभिभूते अग्नौ), and the body is drying (शुष्यच्छरीरे).
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: Which is the right split of कफाभिभूतेऽग्नौ?
optionExplain: अ + अ would give आ (कफाभिभूताग्नौ).
अः + अ would give ओऽ (कफाभिभूतोऽग्नौ).
Right: ए + अ → एऽ: the अ is dropped and marked by ऽ.
ऐ + अ would give आय (कफाभिभूतायग्नौ).
questions.explain: कफाभिभूते (loc. sg.) + अग्नौ (loc. sg.): 'when the fire is overcome by Kapha'.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: कफाभिभूते + अग्नौ → कफाभिभूतेऽग्नौ. Join a new example, वने + अस्मिन् (in this forest). Which is right?
optionExplain: आ would come from अ + अ, not ए + अ.
ओऽ comes from अः + अ, not ए + अ.
ऐ is not made from ए + अ.
Right: ए + अ → एऽ, as in कफाभिभूतेऽग्नौ.
questions.explain: Same rule as कफाभिभूते + अग्नौ.
questions.teaches: A final ए before अ stays, and the अ is dropped and shown by ऽ: कफाभिभूतेऽग्नौ, वनेऽस्मिन्.
questions.section: मदनफल: क्वाथ, चूर्ण, दूध, दही और नवनीत

questions.q: What kind of preparation is made in unit 21?
optionExplain: Right: लेहम् उपयुञ्जीत = one should use a lick.
The modaka comes in line 05.01.22.
The gruel is in line 05.01.17.
Cakes come in line 05.01.23.
questions.explain: लेह = a lick, an electuary.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Match each word of unit 21 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The head of the drug group, the exclusion, the preparation and the verb.
questions.rule: आरग्वध = golden shower tree; वर्ज्य = excluded; लेह = lick; उपयुञ्जीत = one should use.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Put the three excluded drugs of unit 21 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: घोण्टाभूनिम्बबाणवर्ज्यानाम् = excluding ghoṇṭā, bhūnimba and bāṇa.
questions.teaches: Unit 21 leaves three of the āragvadha group out: ghoṇṭā, bhūnimba and bāṇa.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: What does -वर्ज्यानाम् say about ghoṇṭā, bhūnimba and bāṇa?
options: They alone are to be used
They are left out of the group
They are to be used doubled
They are to be added as powder
optionExplain: That would reverse the sense of वर्ज्य.
Right: वर्ज्य = to be avoided, excluded.
Nothing about doubling is said.
The powder added is of the fruit kernel.
questions.explain: आरग्वधादि … घोण्टाभूनिम्बबाणवर्ज्यानाम् = of the āragvadha group, excluding these three.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: A helper cooks the lick in an āragvadha decoction but adds nothing else. What does unit 21 still require?
options: Steeping it in its own decoction
Cooling it in a dust-free pot
optionExplain: Steeping in its own decoction is the step of line 05.01.15.
The dust-free pot is for storage in line 05.01.11.
Right: फलमज्जाचूर्णमिश्रेण = mixed with the powder of the fruit kernel.
Sesame flour belongs to line 05.01.23.
questions.explain: The lick is cooked in one decoction and mixed with the fruit-kernel powder.
questions.rule: Lick = decoction of one of the group + fruit-kernel powder.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: X-वर्ज्य means excluding X. What does a new phrase निम्बवर्ज्यानाम् (with निम्ब = neem) mean?
optionExplain: 'Alone' would need मात्र or एव.
'With' would be स- (सनिम्ब).
'Resembling' would need वत् or सदृश.
Right: निम्ब + वर्ज्य: neem is left out.
questions.explain: Same build as घोण्टाभूनिम्बबाणवर्ज्यानाम्.
questions.rule: X-वर्ज्य = excluding X; स-X = with X.
questions.teaches: -वर्ज्य at the end of a compound means 'excluding': घोण्टाभूनिम्बबाणवर्ज्य, निम्बवर्ज्य.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: What may one eat under unit 22?
optionExplain: Right: उत्कारिकां मोदकं वा भक्षयेत्.
The lick is the formulation of line 05.01.21.
These cakes come in line 05.01.23.
Curd is the formulation of line 05.01.19.
questions.explain: उत्कारिका = a cooked preparation; मोदक = a ball-shaped sweet.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Put these drugs of unit 22's list in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Cardamom, coriander, tagara, costus, agarwood, guggul (other names stand between some of them).
questions.rule: एला · कुस्तुम्बुरु · तगर · कुष्ठ · … · अगुरु · गुग्गुलु.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Match each drug of unit 22 to its identification in the card.
questions.explain: Four clear names of the list; the data calls these identifications standard.
questions.rule: एला = small cardamom; कुस्तुम्बुरु = coriander; अगुरु = agarwood; मांसी = spikenard.
questions.teaches: Among unit 22's drugs: एला (small cardamom), कुस्तुम्बुरु (coriander), अगुरु (agarwood), मांसी (spikenard).
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Which is the right split of रेणुकैला- at the head of the list?
optionExplain: ए + ए would not give ऐ (it gives अ ए or अये).
Right: आ + ए → ऐ: रेणुका + एला → रेणुकैला.
ओ + ए would give अवे (रेणुकवेला).
इ + ए would give ये (रेणुक्येला).
questions.explain: The first two drugs: reṇukā and elā (small cardamom).
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: A modaka is cooked in a decoction of elā alone and mixed with kernel powder. Does this follow unit 22?
options: No: all of the drugs are needed together
No: elā is one of those excluded
Yes: any one of the drugs will do
No: only liquorice may be used
optionExplain: The text asks for any one, not all together.
