Exclusion belongs to line 05.01.21; elā is in this list.
Right: अन्यतरस्य = of any one; elā is named.
Liquorice heads the list of line 05.01.12, not this one.
questions.explain: One decoction, of any one of the named drugs, plus the fruit-kernel powder.
questions.rule: Decoction of any one (अन्यतर) of the list.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: रेणुका + एला → रेणुकैला. Join a new example, सदा + एव (at all times indeed). Which is right?
optionExplain: ए would come from अ/आ + इ, not + ए.
The two vowels do not stay side by side.
ओ comes from अ/आ + उ.
Right: आ + ए → ऐ, as in रेणुका + एला.
questions.explain: Same rule as रेणुका + एला = रेणुकैला.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before ए or ऐ becomes ऐ: रेणुका + एला = रेणुकैला; सदा + एव = सदैव.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Which foods does unit 23 have prepared and eaten?
options: A lick or a mixed drink
optionExplain: Right: शष्कुलीः अपूपान् अन्यं वा भक्ष्यम्.
The lick belongs to line 05.01.21.
These belong to line 05.01.22.
The gruel belongs to line 05.01.17.
questions.explain: शष्कुली and अपूप are cakes; अन्यं भक्ष्यम् = another food.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Match each word of unit 23 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The two grains of the flour and what is made from it.
questions.rule: तिल = sesame; शालि = winter rice; शष्कुली = a cake; भक्ष्य = food.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Put these steps of unit 23 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Flour, mixed with a decoction, made into a food, eaten.
questions.teaches: Unit 23 runs: sesame and rice flour, mixed with a decoction, made into cakes or another food, then eaten.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Which other decoction may the flour be mixed with in unit 23?
options: Of any one of the kovidāra group
Of any one of the surasā group
Of any one of the jīmūtaka group
Of any one of the āragvadha group
optionExplain: The kovidāra group belongs to line 05.01.15.
Right: सुरसादिद्रव्यान्यतमनिर्यूहोपसृष्टैः.
The jīmūtaka group belongs to line 05.01.16.
The āragvadha group belongs to line 05.01.21.
questions.explain: Either its own (fruit-pippalī) decoction, or that of one drug of the surasā group.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: What does साधयित्वा भक्षयेत् tell the cook to do?
optionExplain: The absolutive साधयित्वा comes first: prepare, then eat.
भक्षयेत् says it is eaten.
Right: साधयित्वा = having prepared; भक्षयेत् = one should eat.
साधयित्वा means 'having prepared' (the cook's own act; its causative form is the usual one for √साध्); no other person is named.
questions.explain: An absolutive (-त्वा) names the earlier act; the optative names the main one.
questions.rule: X-त्वा + verb = having done X, one should …
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: पिष्टैः + तत्- → पिष्टैस्तत्-. Join a new example, बालैः + तत्र (by the boys there). Which is right?
optionExplain: र् comes before a voiced sound, not before त.
श् comes before च/छ/श, not before त.
The ending ऐः does not change to औ.
Right: A visarga before त becomes स्.
questions.explain: Same rule as पिष्टैः + तत्कषाय → पिष्टैस्तत्कषाय.
questions.teaches: A visarga before त or थ becomes स्: पिष्टैः + तत् = पिष्टैस्तत्; बालैः + तत्र = बालैस्तत्र.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Until when is the juice cooked in unit 24?
options: Until half of it is left
optionExplain: Right: आदर्वीप्रलेपात् = until it coats the ladle.
No fraction is named in the unit.
No colour is named in the unit.
Froth is not named in the unit.
questions.explain: आ + दर्वी-प्रलेपात् = up to the ladle's coating.
questions.rule: आदर्वीप्रलेपात् = until it coats the ladle.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Match each word of unit 24 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The juice, the test of cooking and the act.
questions.rule: स्वरस = juice; दर्वी = ladle; प्रलेप = coating; पक्त्वा = having cooked.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Put these words of unit 24 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Of the fruit-pippalīs, the juice, until it coats the ladle, having cooked, have it licked.
questions.teaches: Unit 24: the fruit-pippalī juice is cooked until it coats the ladle, and then given to lick.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: What does the causative लेहयेत् say, as against plain लिहेत्?
options: One should not lick it at all
One should mix it into food
optionExplain: That would be the plain लिहेत्.
Right: Causative: someone (the patient) is made to lick.
No negation (न) is present.
Mixing into food is the next line's option.
questions.explain: लेहयेत् = causative optative of √लिह्: have (him) lick.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: A helper stops cooking while the juice is still thin and runs off the ladle. What does unit 24 require?
options: Strain it and give it at once
Cook on until it coats the ladle
Pour it into a new pot
optionExplain: Straining is not a step of this unit.
Honey is not named in this unit.
Right: The end point is आदर्वीप्रलेपात्.
The pot belongs to line 05.01.11.
questions.explain: Cooking ends only when the juice coats the ladle.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: आदर्वीप्रलेपात् uses आ + ablative for until. What does a new word आमरणात् (मरण = death) mean?
optionExplain: आ here marks the limit reached, not a starting point.
'Without' would need a negative like अ- or निर्-.
आ + ablative is the limit, not the cause.
Right: आ + ablative = up to, until.
questions.explain: आ + दर्वीप्रलेपात् = until the ladle-coating; आ + मरणात् = until death.
questions.teaches: आ with an ablative means 'until': आदर्वीप्रलेपात् (until it coats the ladle), आमरणात् (until death).
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Into what does verse 25 have the lick mixed?
optionExplain: Right: अन्नपानेषु … लेहम् अवचारयेत्.
Water is not named in the verse.
Curd is not named in the verse.
No outward use is named.
questions.explain: अन्नपानेषु = in foods and drinks.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Match each word of verse 25 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The two kinds of fare, what they are made with, and the stress word.
questions.rule: अन्न = food; पान = drink; कषाय = decoction; एव = alone.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Put the words of the first line in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: In foods and drinks, or, that, lick, one should mix in.
questions.teaches: Line 1 of verse 25: अन्नपानेषु वा तं लेहमवचारयेत् (or mix that lick into foods and drinks).
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: In line 2, what are the foods and drinks prepared with?
optionExplain: Water is not named in the verse.
Right: तत्कषायैः एव = with its decoctions alone.
Milk and butter are not named in the verse.
Neither honey nor milk is named here.
questions.explain: तत्कषायैरेव च अन्नपानानि कल्पयेत्.
questions.rule: तत्कषायैः एव = with its decoctions alone.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Which is the right split of चान्नपानानि?
optionExplain: अः + अ would give ओऽ (चोऽन्न).
ए + अ would give एऽ (चेऽन्न).
Right: अ + अ → आ: च + अन्न → चान्न.
म् + अ would give म (चमन्न).
questions.explain: च (and) + अन्नपानानि (foods and drinks).
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: लेहम् + अवचारयेत् → लेहमवचारयेत्. Join a new example, फलम् + अश्नाति (he eats the fruit). Which is right?
optionExplain: Anusvara stands before a consonant, not before a vowel.
The म् is not dropped.
ओ is not made from म् + अ.
Right: Final म् before a vowel joins the vowel.
questions.explain: Same rule as लेहम् + अवचारयेत् = लेहमवचारयेत्.
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel → म joined to the vowel.
questions.teaches: A final म् before a vowel stays म् and joins it: लेहमवचारयेत्, फलमश्नाति.
questions.section: मदनफल के लेह, मोदक और भक्ष्य

questions.q: Which ailments does the decoction of unit 26 remove?
optionExplain: Right: सन्तर्पणोत्थ-सर्वश्लेष्मव्याधि-हरम् = removing all Kapha ailments arising from satiation.
Vāta and fasting are not named; the text says Kapha (श्लेष्म) and satiation.
Pitta and heat are not named in this unit.
Neither blood nor injury is named in this unit.
questions.explain: The decoction removes every Kapha ailment that arises from satiation (saṃtarpaṇa).
questions.rule: सन्तर्पण + उत्थ = arising from satiation; श्लेष्मव्याधि = Kapha ailment; हर = removing.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 26 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: The base decoction, its addition, its mixture, and what it removes.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Match each drug of unit 26 to its identification in the card.
questions.explain: Vatsaka is the addition, nimba or arka gives the mixing decoction, and the kernel gives the base decoction.
questions.rule: वत्सक = कुटज; निम्ब = नीम; अर्क = आक; फलमज्जा = fruit kernel.
questions.teaches: In unit 26, vatsaka (वत्सक) = kuṭaja (Holarrhena), nimba (निम्ब) = neem, arka (अर्क) = Calotropis (madar).
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Which is the right split of सन्तर्पणोत्थ-?
optionExplain: There is no word ओत्थ; the second member is उत्थ (arising).
Right: अ + उ → ओ: सन्तर्पण + उत्थ → सन्तर्पणोत्थ.
अः + उ would give अ उ with a gap (सन्तर्पण उत्थ), not ओ.
इ + उ would give यु (सन्तर्पण्युत्थ), not ओ.
questions.explain: Inside the compound, सन्तर्पण (satiation) + उत्थ (arising): अ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: A helper has no nimba. With what may the kernel decoction of unit 26 still be mixed?
optionExplain: Paṭolī is named in line 05.01.38, not in this unit.
Triphalā is not named in this unit.
Right: निम्ब-अर्क-अन्यतर = either nimba or arka; one of the two is enough.
Vatsaka is the addition (प्रतिवाप), not the mixing decoction.
questions.explain: अन्यतर = either of the two: nimba or arka.
questions.rule: निम्बार्कान्यतरकषाय = the decoction of either nimba or arka.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: निम्बार्कान्यतर means either of nimba and arka. What does a new phrase मधुघृतयोरन्यतरम् mean?
optionExplain: Both would be उभे, not अन्यतर.
'Neither' needs a negative; अन्यतर has none.
That is अन्यतम (one of many); अन्यतर is one of two.
Right: अन्यतर = one of two: either honey or ghee.
questions.explain: अन्यतर picks one of two; अन्यतम picks one of three or more.
questions.rule: अन्यतर = either of two; अन्यतम = any one of many.
questions.teaches: अन्यतर means 'either of two' (निम्ब or अर्क; मधु or घृत); अन्यतम means 'any one of many'.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: For which patient is the fragrant method of unit 27 meant?
options: A delicate one who hates medicine
A strong one with old fever
A child with a cough and cold
An old man with weak digestion
optionExplain: Right: सुकुमारः … भेषजद्वेषी च = a delicate person who hates medicine.
Neither strength nor fever is named in this unit.
No child, cough or cold is named in this unit.
Old age and digestion are not named in this unit.
questions.explain: The method suits a delicate person who hates medicine: fragrance makes him vomit easily.
questions.rule: सुकुमार = delicate; भेषजद्वेषी = one who hates medicine.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Put these steps of unit 27 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Steep, dust, keep a night, powder again and take out, drink to the neck while smelling, vomit easily.
questions.rule: भावित → अवचूर्णयेत् → रात्रिमुषितम् → प्रभाते उद्धृत्य → पीतवान् उपजिघ्रन् → छर्दयति.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Match each word of unit 27 to its meaning.
questions.explain: How often it is steeped, how fine the powder is, how much is drunk, and what the patient does.
questions.rule: एकविंशतिकृत्वः = 21 times; कुसुमरजःसदृश = pollen-like; आकण्ठम् = to the neck; उपजिघ्रन् = smelling.
questions.teaches: Unit 27: steeped twenty-one times (एकविंशतिकृत्वः), a pollen-fine powder, drunk up to the neck (आकण्ठम्), while smelling (उपजिघ्रन्).
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Which two of these additions does unit 27 name for the drink?
optionExplain: Right: सैन्धवगुडफाणितोपेतम् names rock salt.
Right: गुड is named, with phāṇita.
Wrong: honey is not named in this unit.
Wrong: ghee is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: The drink comes with rock salt, jaggery and phāṇita (thick cane-juice syrup).
questions.rule: सैन्धव-गुड-फाणित-उपेत = with rock salt, jaggery and phāṇita added.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: What is done with the steeped fruit-pippalīs in the morning, by unit 27?
options: Boiled in milk and then strained
Dried in the sun and then ground
Burnt, and the ash kept aside
optionExplain: No boiling or straining is named in this unit.
Right: प्रभाते पुनरुपचूर्णितमुद्धृत्य = in the morning, powdered again and taken out.
No sun-drying is named; they are powdered again (पुनरुपचूर्णित).
No burning or ash is named in this unit.
questions.explain: In the morning (प्रभाते) the pippalīs are powdered again (पुनर् उपचूर्णित) and taken out (उद्धृत्य).
questions.rule: प्रभाते पुनरुपचूर्णितमुद्धृत्य = in the morning, powdered again, taken out.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: एकविंशतिकृत्वः means twenty-one times. What does a new word सप्तकृत्वः mean?
optionExplain: A part would be सप्तम भाग, not -कृत्वः.
Kinds would be सप्तविध.
Right: -कृत्वः after a number = so many times: सप्त + कृत्वः.
The ordinal locative would be सप्तमे.
questions.explain: Number + -कृत्वः = that many times.
questions.teaches: -कृत्वः after a number means 'so many times': एकविंशतिकृत्वः (21 times), सप्तकृत्वः (seven times).
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: What does unit 28 say about garlands and perfumes?
optionExplain: No ban is stated; व्याख्याताः means 'explained'.
No drinking is named in this unit.
No burning is named in this unit.
Right: एतेन … व्याख्याताः = by this they are explained.
questions.explain: The unit extends the method just given to garlands, perfumes, wraps and cloths.
questions.rule: एतेन = by this; व्याख्याताः = are explained.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Put the items of unit 28 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Garlands, perfumes, wraps, cloths: सर्वमाल्यगन्धप्रावरणपटाः.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Match each member of unit 28's compound to its meaning.
questions.explain: The four members of सर्वमाल्यगन्धप्रावरणपटाः, as the card renders them.
questions.rule: माल्य = garland; गन्ध = perfume; प्रावरण = wrap; पट = cloth.
questions.teaches: माल्य = garland, गन्ध = perfume, प्रावरण = wrap, पट = cloth: all 'explained by this' in unit 28.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Which English rendering of unit 28 has one wrong word?
options: By this, all garlands and perfumes are forbidden
By this, all garlands and perfumes are explained
Through this, all garlands and perfumes are explained
By this, every garland and perfume is explained
optionExplain: Right: Wrong: व्याख्याताः is 'explained', not 'forbidden'.
Correct: this is the card's rendering.
Correct: एतेन can be 'through this'.
Correct: सर्व = all, every.
questions.explain: व्याख्याताः (vi-ā-√khyā, past participle) = explained.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: By the order of the text, what does एतेन (by this) in unit 28 point back to?
options: The ghee cooked as before of line 05.01.42
The fragrant lotus method of line 05.01.28
The surā with decoction of line 05.01.36
optionExplain: That line comes after, not before, unit 28.
Right: That method uses fragrance; garlands and perfumes are carriers of fragrance.
That line comes after unit 28.
That line comes after unit 28.
questions.explain: एतेन takes up what was just said: the fragrance method of line 05.01.28.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: In unit 28, व्याख्याताः agrees with the masculine plural noun. Which new sentence agrees correctly?
optionExplain: व्याख्याताः is masculine plural; तैलानि is neuter.
व्याख्याता is feminine singular.
Right: तैलानि is neuter plural, so the participle is व्याख्यातानि.
व्याख्यातम् is singular; तैलानि is plural.
questions.explain: The past participle takes the gender and number of its noun.
questions.rule: Participle agrees with its noun: पटाः व्याख्याताः, तैलानि व्याख्यातानि.
questions.teaches: A past participle agrees with its noun: पटाः व्याख्याताः (m. pl.), तैलानि व्याख्यातानि (n. pl.).
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: What does unit 29 use when the fruit is not available?
optionExplain: Roots and bark are not named in this unit.
Neem is not named in this unit.
Neither is named in this unit.
Right: मदनपुष्पाणि शलाटूनि च = madana flowers and unripe fruits.
questions.explain: In the absence of fruit, the flowers and the unripe fruits of madana are prepared.
questions.rule: फलाभावे = in the absence of fruit; पुष्प = flower; शलाटु = unripe fruit.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Match each word of unit 29 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The condition, the two substitutes and the verb.
questions.rule: फलाभावे = when fruit is lacking; मदनपुष्प = madana flower; शलाटु = unripe fruit; कल्पयेत् = should prepare.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: The word of unit 29 for unripe fruit is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: शलाटु (here शलाटूनि, n. acc. pl.) = unripe fruit.
questions.teaches: शलाटु = unripe fruit: in the absence of ripe fruit, madana's unripe fruits are prepared the same way.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Which is the right split of फलाभावे?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ: फल + अभावे → फलाभावे.
भावे (in being) would give फलभावे, with no आ.
There is no word आभाव; and ए + आ does not give आ.
अः + अ would give ओऽ (फलोऽभावे).
questions.explain: फल + अभाव (absence): अ + अ → आ; the sense is 'in the absence of fruit'.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Having madana flowers but no fruit, how should they be prepared by unit 29?
options: Only as a smoke for the nose
By the same procedures as the fruit
Only as an oil for the skin
By a new method given here
optionExplain: No smoke is named; एवमेव points to the same procedures.
Right: एवमेव = in just this way: as the fruit was prepared.
No oil is named; एवमेव points to the same procedures.
No new method is given: एवमेव refers back.
questions.explain: एवमेव (in just this way) means the procedures already given for the fruit.
questions.rule: एवम् + एव = in just this way.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: फलाभावे means in the absence of fruit. What does a new phrase जलाभावे mean?
optionExplain: अभाव is absence, not presence.
Fruit is not named in जलाभावे.
Right: जल + अभावे: X-अभावे = when X is lacking.
That would be जले, without अभाव.
questions.explain: X-अभावे (locative) = in the absence of X.
questions.rule: X + अभावे = when X is not available.
questions.teaches: X-अभावे means 'in the absence of X': फलाभावे (of fruit), जलाभावे (of water).
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: What does unit 30 say has been stated?
optionExplain: No disease is named in this unit.
Purging is not named in this unit.
No signs are named in this unit.
Right: फलविधानम् उक्तम् = the procedure for the fruit has been stated.
questions.explain: इति फलविधानमुक्तम् closes the procedures for the (madana) fruit.
questions.rule: फलविधान = procedure for the fruit; उक्तम् = stated.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Match each word of unit 30 to its meaning.
questions.explain: A closing word, the topic, and the participle.
questions.rule: इति = thus; फलविधानम् = procedure for the fruit; उक्तम् = stated.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: In unit 30, the word meaning has been stated is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: उक्तम् is the past participle of √वच् (to speak): stated, said.
questions.teaches: उक्तम् (√वच्, past participle) = has been stated.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: Which is the right split of फलविधानमुक्तम्?
optionExplain: Right: Final म् before a vowel is written joined: …नम् + उ… → …नमु…
अः + उ would give अ उ with a gap (फलविधान उक्तम्).
ए + उ would give अयु (फलविधानयुक्तम्).
मुक्तम् means 'released'; the verb here is उक्तम्, stated.
questions.explain: The म् of फलविधानम् joins the vowel of उक्तम् in writing; the words do not change.
questions.rule: म् + vowel → written together (no sound change).
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: By the order of the text, which drug do the procedures closed in unit 30 concern?
optionExplain: Jīmūtaka starts after this close, in line 05.01.32.
Right: The fruit (फल) of these lines is madana; its procedures end here.
Ikṣvāku comes later in the chapter.
Kuṭaja's fruit comes later in the chapter.
questions.explain: फलविधान = the madana-fruit procedures; jīmūtaka follows next.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: उक्तम् is the past participle of √वच्. Which new sentence means Thus the procedure for the flower has been stated?
optionExplain: वक्ष्यते is future: 'will be stated'.
वदति is present active: 'he says'.
Right: पुष्प + विधानम् + उक्तम्, built like unit 30.
वदेत् is optative: 'he should say'.
questions.explain: उक्तम् = has been stated (done); future, present and optative change the meaning.
questions.rule: इति X-विधानम् उक्तम् = thus the procedure of X has been stated.
questions.teaches: इति … उक्तम् closes a topic: 'thus … has been stated'; उक्तम् is the past participle of √वच्.
questions.section: मदनफल के अन्य योग, फूल और कच्चे फल

questions.q: In which conditions does verse 31 say jīmūta is used especially?
options: Fever, śvāsa, hiccup and the like
optionExplain: These belong to ikṣvāku in line 05.01.43, not to jīmūta.
These are named for surā in line 05.01.36.
These are named in line 05.01.13.
Right: ज्वर-श्वास-हिक्का-आदिषु = in fever, breathlessness, hiccup and the like.
questions.explain: जीमूत is especially for fever, śvāsa and hiccup and the like.

questions.q: Put the conditions of verse 31 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Fever, breathlessness, hiccup: ज्वरश्वासहिक्कादिषु.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 31 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Three conditions and the word that marks them as the special use.
questions.rule: ज्वर = fever; श्वास = breathlessness; हिक्का = hiccup; विशेषतः = especially.
questions.teaches: ज्वर = fever, श्वास = breathlessness (asthma), हिक्का = hiccup: jīmūta is used especially in these.

questions.q: Which is the right split of जीमूतकादीनपि?
optionExplain: Right: अ + आ → आ; final न् joins the vowel of अपि in writing.
There is no word नपि; the न् ends आदीन् (acc. pl.).
अः + आ would give अ आ with a gap, not आ.
ए + आ would give अया (जीमूतकयादीन्).
questions.explain: जीमूतक-आदीन् (jīmūtaka and the rest, acc. pl.) + अपि (also).
questions.rule: अ + आ → आ; न् + vowel written together.

questions.q: How does verse 31 tell the physician to prepare jīmūtaka?
options: In the same way as the fruit
By a new list given here
optionExplain: No juice is named; एवम् points to the earlier procedures.
Right: एवं च … कल्पयेत् = and in this way one should prepare.
No burning is named in this verse.
No list follows; एवम् refers back.
questions.explain: एवम् (in this way) points back to the madana procedures just closed.
questions.rule: एवं कल्पयेत् = prepare in the same way.

questions.q: ज्वरश्वासहिक्कादिषु means in fever, śvāsa, hiccup and the like. What does a new word कासादिषु mean?
optionExplain: -आदि adds 'and the like'; 'alone' would be केवल.
'From' needs the ablative (कासादिभ्यः).
Right: कास + आदिषु: X-आदिषु = in X and the like.
'Of' needs the genitive (कासादीनाम्).
questions.explain: -आदिषु is the locative plural of -आदि: in X and the like.
questions.rule: X-आदिषु = in X and the like.
questions.teaches: X-आदिषु (locative plural) means 'in X and the like': ज्वरश्वासहिक्कादिषु, कासादिषु.

questions.q: Which liquid does unit 32 pair with the flowers?
optionExplain: Curd goes with the hairless fruits, not the flowers.
Peyā goes with fruits, not the flowers.
Honey is not named in this unit.
Right: पुष्पेषु क्षीरम् = in the flowers, milk.
questions.explain: The unit opens: पुष्पेषु क्षीरम्, in the flowers, milk.

questions.q: Put the liquids of unit 32 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Milk, thin gruel, milk-film, curd, upper part of curd.

questions.q: Match each liquid of unit 32 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four of the five liquids, as the card renders them.
questions.rule: क्षीर = milk; पेया = thin gruel; सन्तानिका = milk-film; दध्युत्तरक = upper part of curd.
questions.teaches: In unit 32, पेया = thin gruel, सन्तानिका = the film on milk, दध्युत्तरक = the upper part of curd.

questions.q: Which is the right split of दध्युत्तरकम्?
optionExplain: Right: इ + उ → यु: दधि + उत्तरकम् → दध्युत्तरकम्.
अ + उ would give ओ (दध्योत्तरकम्).
ए + उ would give अयु (दधयुत्तरकम्).
अः + उ would give अ उ with a gap.
questions.explain: दधि (curd) + उत्तरक (upper part): इ before a different vowel becomes य्.

questions.q: Which point of unit 32 is clear from the print, by the card?
optionExplain: Curd is not paired with hairy fruits; this pairing is not stated.
Right: पुष्पेषु क्षीरम् is plain; the fruit pairings are the unclear part.
Santānikā is paired with fruits, not flowers.
Not in this unit: here milk is paired with the flowers, the fruits with other liquids.
questions.explain: The flower → milk pairing is certain; which fruits take peyā or santānikā is not.
questions.rule: पुष्प → क्षीर (clear); फल → पेया / सन्तानिका (unclear pairing).

questions.q: पुष्पेषु (n. -अ stem) means in the flowers. Which new form means in the leaves, from पत्र?
optionExplain: This is nominative/accusative plural: 'leaves'.
This is instrumental plural: 'with leaves'.
Right: -अ stems take -एषु in the locative plural.
This is genitive singular: 'of a leaf'.
questions.explain: पुष्प → पुष्पेषु; पत्र → पत्रेषु: locative plural of -अ stems.
questions.teaches: The locative plural of -अ stems ends in -एषु: पुष्पेषु (in the flowers), फलेषु, पत्रेषु (in the leaves).

questions.q: Which two liquids does unit 33 give as choices?
optionExplain: Neither ghee nor oil is named in this unit.
Neither is named in this unit.
Neither is named in this unit.
Right: क्षीरं दध्यम्लं वा = milk or sour curd.
questions.explain: For the green and pale ones: milk, or sour curd (वा = or).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 33 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two colours and the two parts of the liquids.
questions.rule: हरित = green; पाण्डु = pale; क्षीर = milk; अम्ल = sour.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 33 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: In which ones, then the two liquids, then 'or'.
questions.teaches: Unit 33 reads हरितपाण्डुषु क्षीरं दध्यम्लं वा: in the green and pale ones, milk or sour curd.

questions.q: Which is the right split of दध्यम्लम्?
optionExplain: Right: इ + अ → य: दधि + अम्लम् → दध्यम्लम्.
ए + अ would give एऽ (दधेऽम्लम्).
उ + अ would give व (दध्वम्लम्).
अः + अ would give ओऽ (दधोऽम्लम्).
questions.explain: दधि (curd) + अम्ल (sour): इ before a different vowel becomes य्.

questions.q: For which ones does unit 33 give milk or sour curd?
optionExplain: Ripe and dried fruits come in line 05.01.37.
Right: हरितपाण्डुषु = in the green and pale ones.
Flowers take milk in line 05.01.34; sprouts are not named here.
Roots are not named in this unit.
questions.explain: Colour words, green (हरित) and pale (पाण्डु), mark the ones meant.

questions.q: हरितपाण्डुषु is a dvandva in the locative plural. What does a new phrase रक्तश्वेतेषु mean?
options: In the red and white ones
optionExplain: -एषु is plural, and a dvandva names both kinds.
'From' would need the ablative (-एभ्यः).
Right: रक्त + श्वेत, dvandva, -एषु: in the red and white ones.
There is no verb 'are'; it is one locative compound.
questions.explain: Two colour words joined as a dvandva, then the locative plural: in the X and Y ones.
questions.rule: Dvandva + locative plural = in the X and Y ones.
questions.teaches: A dvandva of two colours in the locative plural means 'in the X and Y ones': हरितपाण्डुषु, रक्तश्वेतेषु.

questions.q: What is mixed with its decoction in unit 34?
optionExplain: Milk is not named in this unit.
Ghee comes in line 05.01.42.
Sour curd comes in line 05.01.35.
Right: तत्कषायसंसृष्टां सुराम् = surā mixed with its decoction.
questions.explain: सुरा (grain liquor) is mixed (संसृष्ट) with its decoction (तत्कषाय).
questions.rule: तत्कषायसंसृष्टा सुरा = surā mixed with its decoction.

questions.q: Put the conditions of unit 34 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Kapha, loss of relish, cough, pāṇḍu disease, consumption.

questions.q: Match each condition of unit 34 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four of the five conditions, with the modern names the data gives.
questions.rule: अरोचक = loss of relish; कास = cough; पाण्डुरोग = anaemia; यक्ष्मन् = consumption.
questions.teaches: अरोचक = loss of relish, कास = cough, पाण्डुरोग = anaemia, यक्ष्मन् = consumption (includes tuberculosis).

questions.q: Which is the right split of कफारोचक-?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ: कफ + अरोचक → कफारोचक.
रोचक (relish) would give कफरोचक, with no आ; the illness is अरोचक.
There is no stem कफा; and रोचक is the opposite sense.
अः + अ would give ओऽ (कफोऽरोचक).
questions.explain: अरोचक = loss of relish (अ- + रोचक); कफ + अरोचक → कफारोचक.

questions.q: Which two of these patients fit the surā drink of unit 34?
options: One with fever of Pitta and Kapha
optionExplain: Wrong: hiccup is named for jīmūta in line 05.01.33.
Wrong: that fever is in line 05.01.38.
Right: कास is named.
Right: पाण्डुरोग is named.
questions.explain: Unit 34 names Kapha, arocaka, cough, pāṇḍu disease and yakṣman.
questions.rule: कास and पाण्डुरोग are in unit 34's list.

questions.q: तत्कषायसंसृष्टा सुरा is surā mixed with its decoction. What does a new phrase मधुसंसृष्टं पयः mean?
optionExplain: The head is पयः (milk); the first member is what is mixed in.
Right: X-संसृष्ट = mixed with X; the head पयः is milk.
संसृष्ट means mixed, not free of.
No sequence is stated; संसृष्ट is a mixture.
questions.explain: In X-संसृष्ट the first member names what is mixed into the head noun.
questions.rule: X-संसृष्टम् Y = Y mixed with X.
questions.teaches: X-संसृष्ट means 'mixed with X': तत्कषायसंसृष्टा सुरा (surā mixed with its decoction), मधुसंसृष्टं पयः (milk mixed with honey).

questions.q: In which condition does unit 35 give the jīmūtaka-fruit powder?
optionExplain: Kapha is not named in this unit.
Pitta-born is line 05.01.39 (Pitta-Kapha fever line 05.01.38); here it is vātapitta.
Right: वातपित्ते = in Vāta and Pitta together.
These are named in line 05.01.33.
questions.explain: The unit ends with वातपित्ते: the joint Vāta-Pitta condition.
questions.rule: वातपित्ते = in Vāta and Pitta together.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 35 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Three states of the fruit and the form it is given in.
questions.rule: पर्यागत = fully ripe; जीर्ण = old; शुष्क = dried; चूर्ण = powder.

questions.q: Put these words of unit 35 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Ripe, old, (of) jīmūtaka fruits, dried, powder, in vātapitta.
questions.rule: पर्यागतानां वा · जीर्णानां · जीमूतकफलानां · शुष्काणां वा · चूर्णं · वातपित्ते.
questions.teaches: Unit 35: powder of ripe (पर्यागत), old (जीर्ण) or dried (शुष्क) jīmūtaka fruits, in vātapitta.

questions.q: Which two states of the jīmūtaka fruit does unit 35 name?
optionExplain: Wrong: roasting is not named in this unit.
Right: शुष्काणाम् is named.
Wrong: unripe fruits are named for madana in line 05.01.30.
Right: जीर्णानाम् is named.
questions.explain: The unit names ripe, old and dried fruits; unripe and roasted are not among them.

questions.q: What is the probable identification of jīmūtaka on this card?
optionExplain: That is āragvadha, in line 05.01.38.
That is paṭolī, in line 05.01.38.
That is śatāvarī, in line 05.01.41.
Right: The data gives Luffa echinata (bitter luffa, Hindi देवदाली) as probable.
questions.explain: Jīmūtaka = Luffa echinata, bitter luffa (probable).

questions.q: वातपित्ते means in Vāta and Pitta together. What does a new word वातकफे mean?
optionExplain: Right: वात + कफ, dvandva, locative singular: in the joint Vāta-Kapha state.
A dvandva joins both equally; no cause is stated.
'Without' would need a word like विना.
'From' would need the ablative (वातकफात्).
questions.explain: A dvandva of two doṣas in the locative singular names the joint state: in X and Y together.
questions.rule: X-Y-e (dvandva, loc. sg.) = in X and Y together.
questions.teaches: A dvandva of two doṣas in the locative singular names their joint state: वातपित्ते, वातकफे.

questions.q: In which fever does unit 36 give its churned preparation?
options: Fever born of Pitta and Kapha
Fever born of Vāta and Kapha
optionExplain: Vāta is not named in this unit.
Right: पित्तश्लेष्मजे ज्वरे = in fever born of Pitta and phlegm.
Pitta-born alone is line 05.01.39; here Kapha joins.
That pair is named in line 05.01.40.
questions.explain: पित्त + श्लेष्म + ज = born of Pitta and phlegm (Kapha).
questions.rule: पित्तश्लेष्मज ज्वर = fever of Pitta and Kapha.

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 36 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Crush, (put) in the decoction (आसुत), churn; then the fever it is for.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 36 to its meaning in the card.
questions.explain: Two sources of the steeping decoction and two steps of the work.
questions.rule: आरग्वध = Cassia fistula (amaltās); पटोली = Trichosanthes dioica (parwal); सम्पोथ्य = crushing; मथित्वा = churning.
questions.teaches: In unit 36 the decoction is of one of the āragvadha (golden shower tree) group, or of paṭolī (pointed gourd).

questions.q: Which is the right split of निर्यूहेणासुतानि?
optionExplain: There is no word नासुत; the ण ends निर्यूहेण (instrumental).
There is no form निर्यूहेणः; the instrumental is निर्यूहेण.
Right: अ + आ → आ: …हेण + आसुतानि → …हेणासुतानि.
ए + आ would give अया, not आ.
questions.explain: निर्यूहेण (with the decoction, instr.) + आसुतानि (steeped; sense unsure): अ + आ → आ.

questions.q: The helper has paṭolī but no āragvadha. What does unit 36 allow?
optionExplain: Plain water is not named in this unit.
A decoction is required; paṭolī's is the named alternative.
Surā is named in line 05.01.36, not here.
Right: पटोल्या वा निर्यूहेण = or with the decoction of paṭolī.
questions.explain: वा (or) offers paṭolī's decoction in place of one of the āragvadha group.
questions.rule: आरग्वधादि … पटोल्या वा = āragvadha group, or paṭolī.

questions.q: सम्पोथ्य (with a prefix) ends in -य, मथित्वा (no prefix) in -त्वा. Which new form means having taken out, from उद् + √हृ?
optionExplain: Right: With a prefix the absolutive takes -य (here -त्य after a short vowel).
-त्वा is used without a prefix; with उद् it becomes -य/-त्य.
This is the infinitive: 'to take out'.
This is the past participle: 'taken out'.
questions.explain: No prefix: -त्वा (मथित्वा); with a prefix: -य (सम्पोथ्य, उद्धृत्य).
questions.teaches: The absolutive 'having done' is -त्वा without a prefix (मथित्वा) and -य with one (सम्पोथ्य, उद्धृत्य).

questions.q: With what does verse 37 give jīmūtaka in what is born of Pitta?
optionExplain: Warm water is for Vāta-Kapha and Kapha in the second line.
Right: शीतेनाम्बुना पित्तजे = with cold water, in what is born of Pitta.
Milk is not named in this verse.
Honey is not named in this verse.
questions.explain: Cold water for the Pitta-born; warm for the Vāta-Kapha-born or Kapha-born.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 37 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The two forms of the drug and the two waters: cold for the Pitta-born, warm for the Vāta-Kapha-born or Kapha-born.
questions.rule: कल्क = paste; शीत = cold; उष्ण = warm; अम्बु = water.

questions.q: Put these words of verse 37 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Drug, cold water, Pitta-born; the same with warm, Vāta-Kapha-born, Kapha-born.
questions.rule: जीमूतकचूर्णं (कल्कं वा) · शीतेनाम्बुना · पित्तजे · तदेवोष्णेन · वातकफजे · कफजे वा.
questions.teaches: Verse 37: jīmūtaka powder or paste with cold water in the Pitta-born; the same with warm in the Vāta-Kapha-born or Kapha-born.

questions.q: Which is the right split of तदेवोष्णेन?
optionExplain: There is no word एवा; the particle is एव.
अः + उ would give अ उ with a gap, not ओ.
Right: त् → द् before a vowel; अ + उ → ओ: एव + उष्णेन → एवोष्णेन.
There is no word ष्णेन; the word is उष्णेन (with warm).
questions.explain: तत् (that) + एव (same) + उष्णेन (with warm): त् → द्, अ + उ → ओ.
questions.rule: त् → द् before a vowel; अ + उ → ओ.

questions.q: A patient's condition is born of Kapha alone. Which way does verse 37 give jīmūtaka?
optionExplain: Cold water is for what is born of Pitta.
Kapha-born is named: कफजे वा.
Surā is in line 05.01.36, not here.
Right: तदेवोष्णेन … कफजे वा = the same with warm (water), or in the Kapha-born.
questions.explain: Kapha-born, like Vāta-Kapha-born, takes the warm vehicle.

questions.q: पित्तज means born of Pitta (पित्त + ज). What does a new word वातज mean?
optionExplain: Right: -ज at the end of a compound = born of: वात + ज.
Removing would be -हर (वातहर).
Increasing would be -वर्धन or -कर.
'Like' would be -वत् (वातवत्).
questions.explain: -ज = born of; -हर = removing; -वत् = like.
questions.teaches: -ज at the end of a compound means 'born of': पित्तज, कफज, वातज (born of Vāta).

questions.q: What vehicle does unit 38 name for what is born of Pitta?
optionExplain: Not all four together: अन्यतमस्य = of any one.
Right: स्वरसेन = with the expressed juice, of any one (अन्यतमस्य).
Honey is not named; cold water is line 05.01.39.
Warm water is line 05.01.40; rock salt is not named.
questions.explain: The juice (स्वरस) of any one of four drugs, in what is born of Pitta.
questions.rule: स्वरस = expressed juice; अन्यतम = any one.

questions.q: Put the drugs of unit 38 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Jīvaka, ṛṣabhaka, ikṣu, śatāvarī.

questions.q: Match each drug of unit 38 to its identification in the card.
questions.explain: Two standard identifications and one disputed one, as the data labels them.
questions.rule: इक्षु = sugarcane; शतावरी = Asparagus racemosus; जीवक = Malaxis acuminata (disputed).
questions.teaches: In unit 38, इक्षु = sugarcane and शतावरी = wild asparagus (standard); जीवक and ऋषभक are disputed (Malaxis orchids).

questions.q: Which is the right split of ऋषभकेक्षु-?
optionExplain: There is no word क्षु; the drug is इक्षु.
अः + इ would give अ इ with a gap, not ए.
Right: अ + इ → ए: ऋषभक + इक्षु → ऋषभकेक्षु.
उ + इ would give वि (ऋषभक्विक्षु).
questions.explain: ऋषभक + इक्षु (sugarcane): अ + इ → ए.

questions.q: A helper has only fresh sugarcane. Can unit 38's vehicle be made?
optionExplain: अन्यतमस्य means any one, not all four.
Śatāvarī is one of four; any one will do.
The text says स्वरस, the expressed juice.
Right: अन्यतमस्य = any one of the four; इक्षु is one of them.
questions.explain: Any one (अन्यतम) of jīvaka, ṛṣabhaka, ikṣu, śatāvarī gives the juice.

questions.q: Unit 38 uses अन्यतम (one of four); unit 26 uses अन्यतर (nimba or arka). Which fits a new list of five drugs?
optionExplain: Right: अन्यतम picks one of three or more: right for five.
अन्यतर picks one of two only.
उभय means both (of two).
सर्व means all, not any one.
questions.explain: अन्यतर = one of two; अन्यतम = one of many.
questions.rule: अन्यतम for three or more; अन्यतर for two.
questions.teaches: अन्यतम picks any one of three or more (जीवकर्षभकेक्षुशतावरीणामन्यतमस्य); अन्यतर picks one of two.

questions.q: What does unit 39 add as another option?
optionExplain: Oil and salt are not named in this unit.
Right: पूर्ववत् … घृतं सिद्धम् = ghee cooked as before.
Milk is not named in this unit.
Curd is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: The unit offers ghee, cooked in the earlier way.
questions.rule: घृत = ghee; सिद्ध = cooked; पूर्ववत् = as before.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 39 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The connective, the manner, the substance and its state.
questions.rule: अथवा = or else; पूर्ववत् = as before; घृत = ghee; सिद्ध = cooked.

questions.q: In unit 39, the word for cooked, prepared is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: सिद्धम् (√सिध्, past participle, n. sg.) = cooked, prepared.
questions.teaches: सिद्ध = cooked (in the glossary: siddha = cooked, śṛta = boiled).

questions.q: What does unit 39 say about which earlier preparation as before means?
optionExplain: No milk or line is named in the unit.
Surā is not named in this unit.
Right: पूर्ववत् refers back, but the unit names no earlier preparation.
The lotus method is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: The reference of पूर्ववत् is left open by the text.

questions.q: Which English rendering of unit 39 has one wrong word?
options: Or else ghee prepared as before
Or ghee, cooked in the former way
optionExplain: Correct: this is the card's rendering.
Correct: सिद्ध can be 'prepared'.
Correct: पूर्ववत् = in the former way.
Right: Wrong: पूर्ववत् is 'as before', not 'as later'.
questions.explain: पूर्व = former, earlier; पूर्ववत् = as before.

questions.q: पूर्ववत् means as before (पूर्व + वत्). What does a new word मातृवत् mean?
optionExplain: Right: -वत् = like, in the manner of: मातृ + वत्.
Possession would need the genitive (मातुः).
'Before' would be पूर्व, not -वत्.
'For' would need the dative (मात्रे).
questions.explain: Adverb -वत् = like X: पूर्ववत् (as before), मातृवत् (like a mother).
questions.teaches: The adverb -वत् means 'like, as': पूर्ववत् (as before), मातृवत् (like a mother).

questions.q: Which drug does unit 40 say is especially to be applied in cough, fever and vomiting?
options: Kuṭaja, the bark of the vatsaka tree
optionExplain: Madana is the drug of the earlier sections, not of this unit.
Right: ईक्ष्वाकुस्तु विशेषेण … योज्यः: ikṣvāku is especially to be applied.
Kuṭaja is not named in this unit.
Jīmūtaka is the drug of the section before; this unit turns to ikṣvāku.
questions.explain: Unit 40 opens the ikṣvāku section: ikṣvāku is especially to be applied in these ailments.
questions.rule: इक्ष्वाकु = bitter bottle gourd (probable); विशेषेण = especially; योज्यः = to be applied.

questions.q: Put the ailments of unit 40 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: कासश्वासज्वरच्छर्दिविषश्लेष्मरोगेषु: cough, breath-trouble, fever, vomiting, poison, phlegm-ailments.
questions.rule: कास · श्वास · ज्वर · छर्दि · विष · श्लेष्मरोग.

questions.q: Match each ailment of unit 40 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The first four members of the compound, with the standard equivalents the card gives.
questions.rule: कास = cough; श्वास = breathlessness; ज्वर = fever; छर्दि = vomiting.
questions.teaches: कास = cough, श्वास = breath-trouble (dyspnoea), ज्वर = fever, छर्दि = vomiting (standard equivalents).

questions.q: Which is the right split of ज्वरच्छर्दि inside the compound of unit 40?
optionExplain: There is no word च्छर्दि; the च् is added by sandhi before छ.
Visarga before छ becomes श्: that would give ज्वरश्छर्दि.
Right: After a short vowel, छ is written च्छ: ज्वर + छर्दि → ज्वरच्छर्दि.
Final म् before छ becomes anusvara: that would give ज्वरंछर्दि.
questions.explain: ज्वर (fever) + छर्दि (vomiting): after a short vowel छ doubles to च्छ.
questions.rule: Short vowel + छ → च्छ (ज्वर + छर्दि → ज्वरच्छर्दि).

questions.q: A patient has vomiting and the effects of poison. Does unit 40 name ikṣvāku for him?
options: No: only cough and fever are named
Only for poison, not for vomiting
Only for vomiting, not for poison
Yes: both chardi and viṣa are named
optionExplain: The list has six members, chardi and viṣa among them.
छर्दि (vomiting) is named in the same list.
विष (poison) is named in the same list.
Right: छर्दि and विष both stand in the list of unit 40.
questions.explain: Chardi (vomiting) and viṣa (poison) are both in the list of unit 40.
questions.rule: कास, श्वास, ज्वर, छर्दि, विष, श्लेष्मरोग: all six are named.

questions.q: योज्यः agrees with the masculine इक्ष्वाकुः. Which form fits a new sentence about oil: तैलं कासे ____?
optionExplain: Right: तैल is neuter singular, so the gerundive is योज्यम्.
योज्यः is masculine; तैलम् is neuter.
योज्या is feminine singular.
योज्याः is masculine or feminine plural.
questions.explain: A gerundive (to be applied) takes the gender and number of its noun: इक्ष्वाकुः योज्यः, तैलं योज्यम्.
questions.rule: Gerundive agrees with its noun: m. योज्यः, n. योज्यम्, f. योज्या.
questions.teaches: योज्य (to be applied, √युज्) agrees with its noun: इक्ष्वाकुः योज्यः (m.), तैलं योज्यम् (n.).

questions.q: Which part of ikṣvāku is taken with milk in unit 41?
optionExplain: Roots are not named in this unit.
Right: प्रवालैः = with the sprouts.
Seeds come in line 05.01.48, not here.
Bark is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: The milk is prepared with the sprouts of the plant while it bears no flower or fruit.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 41 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The part used, the liquid, the stage of the plant and the patient.
questions.rule: प्रवाल = sprout; क्षीर = milk; अपुष्पफल = flowerless and fruitless; उद्रिक्तपित्त = with excessive Pitta.

questions.q: At what stage of the plant are the sprouts of unit 41 taken?
options: When its fruit is fully ripe
When it is dried in the sun
When it has no flower or fruit
When it is in full flower
optionExplain: Ripe fruit is the opposite of अपुष्पफल.
Drying is not named in this unit.
Right: अपुष्पफलस्य = of that (plant) without flower and fruit.
अ-पुष्प means without flower.
questions.explain: अपुष्पफल is a bahuvrīhi: (the plant) that has no flower and no fruit.
questions.rule: अ- (not) + पुष्प-फल (flower and fruit) = without flower and fruit.
questions.teaches: अपुष्पफल = without flower and fruit: the sprouts of unit 41 are taken while the plant bears no flower or fruit (it may also mean not yet flowered).

questions.q: Which is the right split of क्षीरमुद्रिक्तपित्ते?
optionExplain: There is no word मुद्रिक्त; म् + म would be written क्षीरम्मुद्रिक्त.
क्षीर is neuter (क्षीरम्); अः before उ would give क्षीर उद्रिक्त….
आ + उ would give ओ: क्षीरोद्रिक्त….
Right: Final म् joins the next vowel in writing: क्षीरम् + उ… → क्षीरमु….
questions.explain: क्षीरम् (milk) + उद्रिक्तपित्ते (in one whose Pitta is excessive).
questions.rule: Final म् before a vowel is written joined: क्षीरम् + उद्रिक्त → क्षीरमुद्रिक्त.

questions.q: For which two states does unit 41 name the sprout milk?
optionExplain: Wrong: these come in line 05.01.48, not here.
Right: उद्रिक्तपित्ते = in one whose Pitta is excessive.
Wrong: Vāta is not named in this unit.
Right: पित्तकफज्वरे = in fever of Pitta and Kapha.
questions.explain: The milk is for one with excessive Pitta and for Pitta-Kapha fever.

questions.q: उद्रिक्तपित्ते means in one whose Pitta is excessive. What does a new word उद्रिक्तकफे mean?
options: In one whose Kapha is excessive
In one whose Kapha is lost
In one whose Pitta is calmed
For the full removal of all Kapha
optionExplain: Right: Same bahuvrīhi: उद्रिक्त (excessive) + कफ, locative.
Lost would be क्षीणकफ; उद्रिक्त is excessive.
The new word names Kapha, and उद्रिक्त is not calmed.
Removal would be कफहर; this is a locative of the patient.
questions.explain: उद्रिक्त + दोष as a bahuvrīhi = the one whose doṣa is excessive.
questions.rule: उद्रिक्तपित्त / उद्रिक्तकफ = one whose Pitta / Kapha is excessive.
questions.teaches: उद्रिक्त + doṣa is a bahuvrīhi for the patient: उद्रिक्तपित्त (excessive Pitta), उद्रिक्तकफ (excessive Kapha).

questions.q: What does the patient of unit 42 drink?
options: The ikṣvāku seeds in she-goat's milk
Fruit juice cooked in threefold milk
Fruit paste taken with meat broth
Plain fruit oil taken with honey
optionExplain: Seeds in goat's milk come in line 05.01.48.
Right: इक्ष्वाकुफलस्वरसं … त्रिगुणक्षीरसाधितम् … पिबेत.
Paste with meat broth comes in line 05.01.55.
Oil comes in line 05.01.53, and honey is not named here.
questions.explain: The expressed juice of the ikṣvāku fruit, prepared in threefold milk, is drunk.
questions.rule: स्वरस = expressed juice; त्रिगुणक्षीरसाधित = prepared in threefold milk.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 42 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: The juice, how it is prepared, who drinks, in which conditions, and the verb.
questions.rule: स्वरसं वा · त्रिगुणक्षीरसाधितम् · आतुरः · पित्ते कफपीनसे स्वरसादे · वमनार्थी पिबेत.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 42 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two conditions and the two words for the one who drinks.
questions.rule: कफपीनस = Kapha-type catarrh; स्वरसाद = failing voice; वमनार्थी = desiring emesis; आतुर = patient.
questions.teaches: कफपीनस = chronic nasal catarrh, स्वरसाद = hoarseness (standard); वमनार्थी = desiring emesis; आतुर = patient.

questions.q: Which English rendering of unit 42 has one wrong word?
options: The patient desiring emesis should drink it
The patient wanting to vomit should drink it
The patient desiring purgation should drink it
The sick man seeking emesis should drink it
optionExplain: Correct: वमनार्थी = desiring emesis.
Correct: emesis is vomiting.
Right: Wrong: वमनार्थी is desiring emesis (vomiting), not purgation.
Correct: आतुर = the sick man, the patient.
questions.explain: वमन = emesis; विरेचन would be purgation, a different procedure.
questions.rule: वमनार्थी = वमन + अर्थी = one desiring emesis.

questions.q: A patient with hoarseness wants to vomit. In what is the ikṣvāku juice of unit 42 prepared?
optionExplain: Whey goes with the fruit in line 05.01.50.
Meat broth goes with the paste in line 05.01.55.
Buttermilk is named in line 05.01.51, not here.
Right: त्रिगुणक्षीरसाधितम् = prepared in threefold milk.
questions.explain: For svarasāda the juice is prepared in threefold milk and drunk by the one desiring emesis.

questions.q: वमनार्थी means one desiring emesis. What does a new word विरेचनार्थी mean?
optionExplain: Right: विरेचन (purgation) + अर्थी (desiring).
That would be विरिक्त; -अर्थी is desiring.
Fearing would need -भीरु; -अर्थी is desiring.
A drug would be विरेचन itself, not -अर्थी.
questions.explain: -अर्थी after a noun = one who desires it.
questions.rule: X + अर्थी = one desiring X: वमनार्थी, विरेचनार्थी.
questions.teaches: -अर्थी after a noun means 'one desiring it': वमनार्थी (desiring emesis), विरेचनार्थी (desiring purgation).

questions.q: Into what does verse 43 have milk poured?
options: A fresh fruit, with its seeds kept in
An old fruit, its seeds taken out
A clay pot holding the sprouts
A hollow root of the same plant
optionExplain: The fruit is old (जीर्ण) and the seeds are taken out.
Right: जीर्णे … समुद्धृतबीजे फले क्षीरं प्रक्षिपेत्.
No pot or sprouts are named in this verse.
No root is named in this verse.
questions.explain: Milk is poured into an old fruit from which the seeds have been taken out.
questions.rule: जीर्ण = old; समुद्धृतबीज = with seeds taken out; प्रक्षिपेत् = should pour in.

questions.q: Put these phrases of verse 43 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Old fruit, seeds taken out, milk poured in, curd formed there.
questions.rule: जीर्णे वा · समुद्धृतबीजे फले · क्षीरं प्रक्षिपेत् · तत्र जातं दधि.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 43 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The state of the fruit, what is removed, what is done, and what happens to the milk.
questions.rule: जीर्ण = old; समुद्धृतबीज = seeds taken out; प्रक्षिपेत् = should pour in; जात = formed (√जन्).
questions.teaches: Verse 43: जीर्ण = old, समुद्धृतबीज = whose seeds are taken out, प्रक्षिपेत् = should pour in, जात = formed.

questions.q: Where does the curd of verse 43 form?
options: In a separate pot of whey
optionExplain: No vessel is named; तत्र points to the fruit.
Whey is not named in this verse.
Right: तत्र जातं दधि = the curd formed there, in the fruit.
तत्र refers to the fruit just named, not the belly.
questions.explain: तत्र (there) takes up the fruit into which the milk was poured.

questions.q: A helper has a fresh fruit with its seeds inside. What must differ for the method of verse 43?
options: It must be boiled and powdered
It must be soaked in goat's milk
It must be dried and then dusted
It must be old, with seeds removed
optionExplain: Neither boiling nor powdering is named here.
Goat's milk belongs to the seeds of line 05.01.48.
Drying and dusting are not named in this verse.
Right: जीर्णे … समुद्धृतबीजे: old, and with the seeds taken out.
questions.explain: The text asks for an old fruit from which the seeds have been taken out.
questions.rule: जीर्ण + समुद्धृतबीज: the two conditions of the fruit.

questions.q: जातम् agrees with the neuter दधि. Which form fits a new phrase with the feminine पेया: तत्र ____ पेया?
optionExplain: Right: पेया is feminine singular, so the participle is जाता.
जातम् is neuter, like दधि; पेया is feminine.
जातः is masculine singular.
जाताः is plural; पेया is singular.
questions.explain: The past participle takes the gender and number of its noun: दधि जातम्, पेया जाता.
questions.rule: Participle agrees with its noun: n. जातम्, f. जाता, m. जातः.
questions.teaches: जात (formed, √जन्) agrees with its noun: दधि जातम् (n.), पेया जाता (f.).

questions.q: In what are the ikṣvāku seeds of unit 44 soaked?
optionExplain: Cow's urine is not named in this unit.
Right: छागीक्षीरभावितानि = soaked in she-goat's milk.
Honey is not named in this unit.
Rice water is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: The seeds are soaked in the milk of a she-goat (छागी).
questions.rule: छागी = she-goat; क्षीर = milk; भावित = soaked.

questions.q: Put these ailments of unit 44 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: विषगुल्मोदरगलगण्डग्रन्थ्यर्बुदश्लीपदेषु: after poison come these six in this order.
questions.rule: विष · गुल्म · उदर · गलगण्ड · ग्रन्थि · अर्बुद · श्लीपद.

questions.q: Match each ailment of unit 44 to its modern equivalent.
questions.explain: The standard equivalents given in the unit data.
questions.rule: गुल्म = abdominal lump; गलगण्ड = goitre; अर्बुद = tumour; श्लीपद = filariasis.
questions.teaches: गुल्म = abdominal lump, गलगण्ड = goitre (neck-swelling), अर्बुद = tumour, श्लीपद = filariasis (standard).

questions.q: Which is the right split of ग्रन्थ्यर्बुद in unit 44?
optionExplain: अ + अ would give आ: ग्रन्थ्यार्बुद.
इः before a vowel becomes इर्: ग्रन्थिरर्बुद.
Right: इ + अ → य: ग्रन्थि + अर्बुद → ग्रन्थ्यर्बुद.
उ + अ would give व: ग्रन्थ्वर्बुद.
questions.explain: ग्रन्थि (nodular swelling) + अर्बुद (tumour): इ before a different vowel becomes य्.

questions.q: Which two of these ailments does unit 44 name for the soaked seeds?
optionExplain: Right: अर्बुद is in the list.
Right: श्लीपद closes the list.
Wrong: kuṣṭha heads the list of line 05.01.49, not this one.
Wrong: fever is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: Arbuda and ślīpada are in the list; kuṣṭha and fever are not.
questions.rule: विष, गुल्म, उदर, गलगण्ड, ग्रन्थि, अर्बुद, श्लीपद.

questions.q: भावितानि agrees with the neuter plural बीजानि. Which new phrase about one fruit agrees correctly?
optionExplain: भावितः is masculine; फलम् is neuter.
भाविता is feminine singular.
भावितानि is plural; फलम् is singular.
Right: फलम् is neuter singular, so भावितम्.
questions.explain: The participle (soaked) agrees with its noun: बीजानि भावितानि, फलं भावितम्.
questions.rule: Participle agrees in gender and number: n. pl. भावितानि, n. sg. भावितम्.
questions.teaches: भावित (soaked) agrees with its noun: बीजानि भावितानि (n. pl.), फलं भावितम् (n. sg.).

questions.q: Which part of the ikṣvāku fruit does unit 45 use?
optionExplain: Right: इक्ष्वाकुफलमध्यम् = the inner part of the ikṣvāku fruit.
The rind is not named in this unit.
The stalk is not named in this unit.
Seeds were the drug of line 05.01.48.
questions.explain: Unit 45 uses the inner part of the fruit.

questions.q: Put these ailments of unit 45 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: कुष्ठविषगुल्मोदर…अर्बुदश्लीपदेषु: kuṣṭha heads the list and ślīpada closes it.
questions.rule: कुष्ठ · विष · गुल्म · उदर · … · अर्बुद · श्लीपद.

questions.q: Match each ailment of unit 45 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four clear members of the list, with the equivalents of the card.
questions.rule: कुष्ठ = skin disease; विष = poison; उदर = belly-ailment; ग्रन्थि = nodular swelling.
questions.teaches: कुष्ठ = skin diseases including leprosy, विष = poison, उदर = belly-ailment, ग्रन्थि = nodular swelling.

questions.q: Which ailment heads the list of unit 45, beyond the seed list of line 05.01.48?
optionExplain: Ślīpada closes both lists.
Right: The compound opens with कुष्ठ, which line 05.01.48 lacks.
Arbuda stands in both lists.
Gulma stands in both lists.
questions.explain: The inner-part list repeats most of the seed list and adds kuṣṭha at its head.
questions.rule: कुष्ठ heads the list of unit 45.

questions.q: The part of the fruit in unit 45 is इक्ष्वाकुफल____. Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: इक्ष्वाकुफलमध्यम् = the inner part (मध्य) of the ikṣvāku fruit.
questions.teaches: In unit 45 the part used is मध्य, the inner part of the ikṣvāku fruit.

questions.q: इक्ष्वाकुफलमध्यम् is the inner part of the ikṣvāku fruit. What does a new phrase बिल्वफलमध्यम् mean?
options: The bilva fruit and its stalk
The hard outer rind of bilva fruit
The inner part of the bilva fruit
The middle of the bilva tree
optionExplain: मध्य is the inner part, not a second item.
Rind would be त्वक्; मध्य is the inner part.
Right: Same tatpuruṣa: बिल्व-फल-मध्य = inner part of the bilva fruit.
फल names the fruit, not the tree.
questions.explain: X-फल-मध्य = the inner part of the fruit of X.
questions.rule: Tatpuruṣa: the last member is the head: फल-मध्य = inner part of the fruit.
questions.teaches: X-फल-मध्यम् (tatpuruṣa) = the inner part of the fruit of X: इक्ष्वाकुफलमध्यम्, बिल्वफलमध्यम्.

questions.q: With what is the ikṣvāku fruit taken in the first line of verse 46?
optionExplain: Meat broth goes with the paste in line 05.01.55.
Goat's milk is for the seeds of line 05.01.48.
Cane juice is not named in this verse.
Right: मस्तुना = with whey, the watery part of curd.
questions.explain: The fruit is taken with mastu, whey.

questions.q: Put the ailments of the first line of verse 46 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: कुष्ठविषपाण्ड्वामयेषु: skin disease, poison, pale-ailment.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 46 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two liquids, one ailment and one salt of the verse.
questions.rule: मस्तु = whey; तक्र = buttermilk; पाण्ड्वामय = pale-ailment; सैन्धव = rock salt.
questions.teaches: Verse 46: मस्तु = whey, तक्र = buttermilk, पाण्ड्वामय = pale-ailment (anaemia), सैन्धव = rock salt.

questions.q: Which is the right split of पाण्ड्वामय in verse 46?
optionExplain: Right: उ before a different vowel becomes व्: पाण्डु + आमय → पाण्ड्वामय.
उ + अ would give व, short: पाण्ड्वमय.
उः before a vowel becomes उर्: पाण्डुरामय.
ओ before आ becomes अव्: पाण्डवामय.
questions.explain: पाण्डु (pale) + आमय (ailment): उ + आ → वा.

questions.q: What is added to the buttermilk in the second line of verse 46?
optionExplain: Neither ghee nor jaggery is named in this verse.
Right: समधुसैन्धवम् = with honey and saindhava (rock salt).
These are not named in this verse.
Neither is named with the buttermilk.
questions.explain: The buttermilk comes with honey and rock salt.

questions.q: समधुसैन्धवम् means with honey and saindhava. What does a new word सगुडघृतम् mean?
optionExplain: Without would need निर्- or अ-; स- is with.
No cooking is in the word; स- only joins the two as additions.
Right: स- (with) + गुड (jaggery) + घृत (ghee).
Both members are added: गुड and घृत.
questions.explain: स- before a dvandva of additions = together with all of them.
questions.teaches: The prefix स- means 'with': समधुसैन्धवम् (with honey and rock salt), सगुडघृतम् (with jaggery and ghee).

questions.q: What does one eat in unit 47?
options: The seeds, soaked in honey water
The fruit oil, mixed with whey
The young sprouts, boiled in milk
That same inner part, with jaggery
optionExplain: Seeds and honey are not named in this unit.
Oil and whey are not named in this unit.
Sprouts belong to line 05.01.44.
Right: तदेव … मध्यं सगुड… भक्षयेत्.
questions.explain: The inner part of the fruit is eaten together with jaggery.
questions.rule: मध्य = inner part; गुड = jaggery; भक्षयेत् = should eat.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 47 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: तदेव वा मध्यं सगुडपलं भक्षयेत्: that same, or, inner part, with jaggery, should eat.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 47 to its meaning.
questions.explain: What, which part, with what, and the verb.
questions.rule: तदेव = that same; मध्य = inner part; गुड = jaggery; भक्षयेत् = should eat.
questions.teaches: Unit 47: तदेव = that same, मध्य = inner part, गुड = jaggery, भक्षयेत् = should eat.

questions.q: Which is the right split of तदेव?
optionExplain: Right: त् before a vowel becomes द्: तत् + एव → तदेव.
आ + ए would give ऐ: तदैव.
That would give तदिव (like that).
That would give तदव, not तदेव.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + एव (same, very): त् → द् before a vowel.
questions.rule: त् + vowel → द् + vowel (तत् + एव → तदेव).

questions.q: By the order of the text, the inner part of unit 47 is that of which earlier line?
optionExplain: That line names seeds, not an inner part.
Right: Line 05.01.49 names इक्ष्वाकुफलमध्यम्; तदेव मध्यम् takes it up.
That line names sprouts, not an inner part.
That line names a whole fruit used as a vessel.
questions.explain: तदेव मध्यम् = that same inner part: the one named in line 05.01.49.
questions.rule: तद् + एव points back to what was just named.

questions.q: तदेव joins तत् and एव (that very). What does a new word तत्रैव mean?
optionExplain: Again would be पुनः; तत्र is there.
There is no negative in the word.
Right: तत्र (there) + एव (very): अ + ए → ऐ.
Everywhere would be सर्वत्र.
questions.explain: एव after a word stresses it: तदेव = that very; तत्रैव = in that very place.
questions.rule: एव = very, just; अ + ए → ऐ (तत्र + एव → तत्रैव).
questions.teaches: एव stresses the word before it: तदेव (that very one), तत्रैव (in that very place, अ + ए → ऐ).

questions.q: What does one drink in unit 48?
optionExplain: Juice (स्वरस) was the drink of line 05.01.45; here it is तैल.
Ghee is not named in this unit.
No root or decoction is named in this unit.
Right: इक्ष्वाकुफलतैलं … पिबेत् = should drink the oil of the ikṣvāku fruit.
questions.explain: Unit 48 gives the oil of the ikṣvāku fruit to drink.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 48 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: इक्ष्वाकुफलतैलं वा पिबेत्: the compound members, then or, then the verb.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 48 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The members of the compound, the particle and the verb.
questions.rule: तैल = oil; फल = fruit; वा = or; पिबेत् = should drink.
questions.teaches: Unit 48: तैल = oil, फल = fruit, वा = or, पिबेत् = should drink (√पा, optative).

questions.q: Which English rendering of unit 48 has one wrong word?
options: Or one should eat the oil of the ikṣvāku fruit
Or one should drink the oil of the ikṣvāku fruit
Or he should drink the ikṣvāku fruit's oil
Or the oil of the ikṣvāku fruit should be drunk
optionExplain: Right: Wrong: पिबेत् is should drink, not eat (that is भक्षयेत्).
Correct: this is the card's rendering.
Correct: the same sense in other words.
Correct: a passive turn of the same sense.
questions.explain: पिबेत् (√पा) = should drink; भक्षयेत् of line 05.01.52 = should eat.

questions.q: The verb of unit 48 that means should drink is ____. Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: पिबेत् = should drink: optative of √पा.
questions.teaches: पिबेत् (√पा, optative) = should drink.

questions.q: इक्ष्वाकुफलतैलम् is the oil of the ikṣvāku fruit. What does a new word बिल्वफलतैलम् mean?
optionExplain: A tatpuruṣa names one thing, the oil, not two.
Right: Same tatpuruṣa: बिल्व-फल-तैल = oil of the bilva fruit.
The word has no frying; तैल is the head.
No juice is in the word.
questions.explain: In a tatpuruṣa the last member is the head: X-फल-तैल = the oil of the fruit of X.
questions.rule: Tatpuruṣa: X-फल-तैल = oil of X fruit.
questions.teaches: X-फल-तैलम् (tatpuruṣa) = the oil of the fruit of X: इक्ष्वाकुफलतैलम्, बिल्वफलतैलम्.

questions.q: Which preparation does unit 49 make with saktu?
optionExplain: Peyā is not named in this unit.
A leha is made in line 05.01.58, not here.
Right: सक्तुभिर्मन्थम् = a mantha with saktu.
Surā is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: Saktu (parched-grain flour) is made into a mantha, a stirred drink.
questions.rule: सक्तु = parched-grain flour; मन्थ = stirred drink.

questions.q: Put the ailments of unit 49 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: श्लेष्मज्वरकासकण्ठरोगारोचकेषु: phlegm-fever, cough, throat-ailments, distaste for food.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 49 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The flour, the drink, and two of the ailments.
questions.rule: सक्तु = parched-grain flour; मन्थ = stirred drink; कण्ठरोग = throat-ailment; अरोचक = anorexia.
questions.teaches: सक्तु = parched-grain flour, मन्थ = stirred drink, कण्ठरोग = throat-ailment, अरोचक = distaste for food (anorexia).

questions.q: Which is the right split of सक्तुभिर्मन्थम्?
optionExplain: There is no word र्मन्थम्; the र् comes from the visarga.
That would give सक्तुभिं मन्थम्, with anusvara.
That would give सक्तुभिरमन्थम्, with a vowel after र्.
Right: इः before a voiced sound becomes इर्: सक्तुभिः + मन्थम् → सक्तुभिर्मन्थम्.
questions.explain: सक्तुभिः (with saktu) + मन्थम् (stirred drink): visarga after इ → र् before म.
questions.rule: इः / उः before a voiced sound → इर् / उर् (सक्तुभिः + मन्थम् → सक्तुभिर्मन्थम्).

questions.q: Which two of these does unit 49 name for the saktu mantha?
optionExplain: Right: अरोचक closes the list.
Right: कण्ठरोग is in the list.
Wrong: goitre (गलगण्ड) is in line 05.01.48, not here.
Wrong: ślīpada is in lines 05.01.48 and 05.01.49, not here.
questions.explain: Throat-ailments and arocaka are named; goitre and filariasis are not.

questions.q: सक्तुभिः + मन्थम् gives सक्तुभिर्मन्थम्. How is a new pair सक्तुभिः + युक्तम् (joined with saktu) written?
optionExplain: Right: य is voiced, so इः → इर्: सक्तुभिर्युक्तम्.
Visarga becomes स् before त्/थ्, a voiceless sound; य is voiced, so it becomes र्.
After इ the visarga is not dropped; it becomes र्.
Before a voiced sound the visarga must change; it becomes र्.
questions.explain: Visarga after इ or उ becomes र् before any voiced sound (म, य, a vowel).
questions.teaches: Visarga after इ/उ becomes र् before a voiced sound: सक्तुभिर्मन्थम्, सक्तुभिर्युक्तम्.

questions.q: With what is the ikṣvāku paste of unit 50 taken?
optionExplain: Whey goes with the fruit in line 05.01.50.
Right: मांसरसेन = with meat broth.
Honey is not named in this unit.
Goat's milk is for the seeds of line 05.01.48.
questions.explain: The paste is taken with meat broth.
questions.rule: मांसरस = meat broth; मांसरसेन = with meat broth.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 50 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The form of the drug, its vehicle and two words of the conditions.
questions.rule: कल्क = paste; मांसरस = meat broth; प्रसक्त = persistent; गुल्म = abdominal lump.

questions.q: Put the members of the compound of unit 50 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: वातकफगुल्मप्रसक्तज्वरेषु: Vāta, Kapha, gulma, persistent, fevers.
questions.teaches: The conditions of unit 50 run वात · कफ · गुल्म · प्रसक्त · ज्वर (persistent fevers come last).

questions.q: Which English rendering of unit 50 has one wrong word?
options: Ikṣvāku paste with meat broth, in persistent fevers
Ikṣvāku paste with meat soup, in lasting fevers
Ikṣvāku paste with milk, in persistent fevers
A paste of ikṣvāku with meat broth, in long fevers
optionExplain: Correct: this follows the card.
Correct: soup and lasting render the same words.
Right: Wrong: मांसरसेन is with meat broth, not milk.
Correct: प्रसक्त ज्वर = persistent, long fevers.
questions.explain: मांसरस = meat broth; प्रसक्त = persistent.

questions.q: A patient has a persistent fever. Which ikṣvāku preparation does unit 50 give?
optionExplain: The oil of line 05.01.53 names no fever.
The seeds of line 05.01.48 name no fever.
The fruit with whey of line 05.01.50 names no fever.
Right: इक्ष्वाकुकल्कं मांसरसेन … प्रसक्तज्वरेषु.
questions.explain: For persistent fevers unit 50 gives ikṣvāku paste with meat broth.

questions.q: इक्ष्वाकुकल्कं मांसरसेन is ikṣvāku paste with meat broth. What does a new phrase बिल्वकल्कं मधुना mean?
optionExplain: Right: कल्क = paste; मधुना (instrumental) = with honey.
A brew would be क्वाथ; कल्क is paste.
The paste is of bilva; honey is the vehicle.
Juice would be स्वरस; कल्क is paste.
questions.explain: X-कल्क = paste of X; an instrumental noun names what it is taken with.
questions.rule: Instrumental = with: मांसरसेन (with meat broth), मधुना (with honey).
questions.teaches: X-कल्कम् + instrumental = paste of X taken with: इक्ष्वाकुकल्कं मांसरसेन, बिल्वकल्कं मधुना.

questions.q: Which seeds are treated in unit 51?

questions.q: The part of bilva used in unit 51 is बिल्व____ (root). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: बिल्वमूल = the root (मूल) of bilva.
questions.teaches: In unit 51 the bilva part is मूल, the root.

questions.q: What is प्रस्थ in unit 51?
optionExplain: मूल is the root; प्रस्थ is a measure.
No vessel is named in this unit.

questions.q: A helper has bilva leaves but no bilva root. Does he have what unit 51 names?

optionExplain: The text names the root only.
No leaves are named in this unit.
The text names the root, not the fruit.
Right: बिल्वमूल = bilva root; leaves are not named.
questions.explain: The liquid is made from bilva root (मूल).

questions.q: बिल्वमूल is the root of bilva. What does a new word निम्बमूलम् mean?
optionExplain: Right: Same tatpuruṣa: निम्ब + मूल = root of nimba (neem).
A tatpuruṣa names one thing, the root.
Fruit would be फल; मूल is root.
Likeness would need -वत् or -सदृश.
questions.explain: X-मूल = the root of X: the last member is the head.
questions.rule: Tatpuruṣa: बिल्वमूल, निम्बमूल = root of bilva, of nimba.
questions.teaches: X-मूलम् (tatpuruṣa) = the root of X: बिल्वमूल (bael root), निम्बमूल (neem root).

questions.q: What does unit 52 add last, in a quantity equal to the decoction?

Right: क्वाथतुल्यमेव च त्रिकटुकमावपेत् = trikaṭuka equal to the decoction.
Honey is not named in this unit.
Jaggery is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: Last comes trikaṭuka, equal to the decoction.
questions.rule: त्रिकटुक = dry ginger, long pepper, black pepper (standard).

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 52 in the order of the text.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 52 to its meaning.
pairs: dry ginger, long pepper, black pepper
questions.explain: Three drug names with the data's identifications, and the verb of grinding.
questions.rule: त्रिकटुक = three pungents (standard); वत्सक = kuṭaja; कृतवेधन = ridged gourd; पिष्ट्वा = having ground.
questions.teaches: त्रिकटुक = dry ginger + long pepper + black pepper (standard); वत्सक = kuṭaja (probable); कृतवेधन = ridged gourd (probable).

questions.rule: घृतसम = equal to the ghee; क्वाथतुल्य = equal to the decoction.

questions.q: Which two of these drug names stand in the compound …महाजालिनीवत्सककृतवेधनानि of unit 52?

Wrong: bilva root gives the decoction of line 05.01.56; it is not in this list.

Right: महाजालिनी is in the list.

questions.q: पिष्ट्वा (having ground) is built with -त्वा on a root with no prefix. Which new form means having drunk (√पा)?
optionExplain: पिबेत् is optative: should drink.
पातुम् is the infinitive: to drink.
पेयम् is a gerundive: to be drunk.
Right: √पा with no prefix takes -त्वा: पीत्वा, having drunk.
questions.explain: A root without a prefix forms its absolutive (having done) with -त्वा.
questions.teaches: -त्वा makes 'having done' from a root with no prefix: पिष्ट्वा (having ground), पीत्वा (having drunk).

questions.q: What does one prepare in unit 53?
optionExplain: Right: लेहं साधयेत् = should prepare a leha.
The mantha was made in line 05.01.54, not here.
Curd was made in line 05.01.47, not here.
Surā is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: The mixture is heated again and made into a leha.
questions.rule: लेह = licked preparation; साधयेत् = should prepare.

questions.q: Put these words of unit 53 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: ततः पुनरपि … लेहं साधयेत्: then, again, (heating it), a leha, should prepare.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 53 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The four clear words of the unit.
questions.rule: ततः = then; पुनरपि = again; लेह = licked preparation; साधयेत् = should prepare.
questions.teaches: Unit 53: ततः = then, पुनरपि = again (पुनर् + अपि), लेह = licked preparation, साधयेत् = should prepare.

questions.q: Which is the right split of पुनरपि?
optionExplain: There is no word रपि; the र् belongs to पुनर्.
Right: पुनः keeps its र् before a vowel: पुनर् + अपि → पुनरपि.
आ + अ would give आ: पुनरापि.
There is no word पि; the second word is अपि.
questions.explain: पुनः (again) + अपि (also): the र् of पुनर् shows before the vowel.

questions.q: By the order of the text, what does ततः (then) in unit 53 follow?
options: Pouring milk into an old fruit
optionExplain: Licking comes after, in line 05.01.59.
That is the curd method of line 05.01.46.
Right: Line 05.01.57 adds the seeds, the four drugs and trikaṭuka; then comes this unit.
That is the seed method of line 05.01.48.
questions.explain: ततः follows the adding of line 05.01.57: the mixture is heated again into a leha.
questions.rule: ततः = then, after the step just given.

questions.q: साधयेत् means he should prepare. Which new form means they should prepare (वैद्याः लेहं ____)?
optionExplain: साधयेत् is 3rd singular: he should prepare.
साधयन्ति is present: they prepare, not should.
साधयेम is 1st plural: we should prepare.
Right: Optative 3rd plural ends in -युः: साधयेयुः.
questions.explain: Optative 3rd person: singular -एत्, plural -एयुः.
questions.teaches: Optative 3rd person: साधयेत् = he should prepare, साधयेयुः = they should prepare.

questions.q: What is done first with the leha in unit 54?
options: It is rubbed on the skin
It is poured into the nose
optionExplain: Right: तमवलिह्य = having licked it.
Smelling is not named in this unit.
No rubbing is named in this unit.
No nasal use is named in this unit.
questions.explain: The leha is licked, and something is drunk after it.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 54 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Having licked it … the procedure, for the four beginning with kāśmarya, members of the great five roots, stated separately, to be known.
questions.rule: तमवलिह्य · कल्पः · काश्मर्यादिषु चतुर्षु · महापञ्चमूलाङ्गेषु · पृथक्पृथगुक्तो वेदितव्यः.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 54 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The action, the procedure, how it is stated and what one must do with it.
questions.rule: अवलिह्य = having licked; कल्प = procedure; पृथक् पृथक् = separately; वेदितव्य = to be known.
questions.teaches: Unit 54: अवलिह्य = having licked, कल्प = procedure, पृथक् पृथक् = separately, वेदितव्य = to be known.

questions.q: Why does अवलिह्य end in -य and not in -त्वा?
options: The root is in the causative
The subject is in the plural
The form is a future tense
optionExplain: No causative is in अवलिह्य; the -य comes from the prefix.
Right: With a prefix the absolutive takes -य: अव + √लिह् → अवलिह्य.
Number does not change an absolutive.
An absolutive (having done) is not a tense.
questions.explain: Absolutive: -त्वा without a prefix (पिष्ट्वा), -य with a prefix (अवलिह्य).

questions.q: For what does unit 54 say the same procedure is stated separately?
options: Jīmūtaka and drugs of its kind
The tumbī seeds and the bilva root
optionExplain: These belong to line 05.01.30, not to this statement.
These are named in line 05.01.32, not here.
Right: काश्मर्यादिषु चतुर्षु महापञ्चमूलाङ्गेषु: the four, beginning with kāśmarya.
These make the leha itself; the statement names the four members from kāśmarya on.
questions.explain: The kalpa is to be known as stated separately for the four members of the great five roots, from kāśmarya on.
questions.rule: महापञ्चमूल = the great five roots; काश्मर्य = gambhārī (standard).

questions.q: अव + √लिह् gives अवलिह्य (having licked). Which new form means having drunk after (अनु + √पा)?
optionExplain: -त्वा is for a root with no prefix; अनु needs -य.
अनुपिबेत् is optative: should drink after.
अनुपातुम् is an infinitive: to drink after.
Right: With the prefix अनु the absolutive takes -य: अनुपीय.
questions.explain: A prefixed root forms its absolutive with -य: अवलिह्य, अनुपीय.
questions.teaches: With a prefix, 'having done' takes -य: अवलिह्य (having licked), अनुपीय (having drunk after).

questions.q: Which qualities of the ailments does unit 55 name for its drug?
optionExplain: Right: स्थिरेषु गुरुषु च = in those that are firm and heavy.
These are the opposites of स्थिर and गुरु.
Neither word stands in this unit.
Hot and sharp are qualities of kṛtavedhana in line 05.01.65.
questions.explain: The drug is for ailments that are firm (स्थिर) and heavy (गुरु).

questions.q: Put the first members of the ailment compound of unit 55 in the order of the text.
