questions.explain: Line 2: and by actions that destroy vomiting, one should turn it back.
questions.rule: कण्ठ से आता स्नेह → छर्दिघ्नी क्रियाएँ → निवर्तन.

questions.q: Like छर्दिघ्नी (destroying vomiting), what does ज्वरघ्नी, said of an action, mean?
optionExplain: Caused by would be -ज or -जनित.
Sign would be लिङ्ग or लक्षण.
Right: -घ्नी (from √हन्) = destroying: ज्वर-घ्नी = that destroys fever.
Having would be -वत् or ज्वरित.
questions.explain: -घ्न (m./n.), -घ्नी (f.) = destroying X.
questions.teaches: The final member -घ्न / -घ्नी means 'destroying': छर्दिघ्नी, ज्वरघ्नी.

questions.q: What does उपलिम्पति mean?
optionExplain: Burning would be दहति or दाह.
Cutting would be छिनत्ति, as in छिन्न.
Drying would be शोषयति.
Right: उप-√लिप् = to smear, coat.
questions.explain: स ह्युपलिम्पति = for it smears (the anus).

questions.q: Put these words of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: (Not) should administer the sneha; the anus, it, for, smears.
questions.rule: प्रणयेत् · स्नेहम् · गुदम् · सः · हि · उपलिम्पति.

questions.q: Match each word of line 1 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1 gives a prohibition and its reason with हि.
questions.rule: प्रणयेत् = should administer; गुद = anus; हि = for; सः = it.
questions.teaches: हि gives the reason: the unripe sneha is not to be given, for it smears the anus.

questions.q: Which is the right split of ह्युपलिम्पति?
optionExplain: Right: इ + उ → यु: हि + उप → ह्युप.
युपलिम्पति is not a word.
This would read हियुप..., not ह्युप.
अ + उ would give ओ: ह्योप..., not ह्युप.
questions.explain: हि (for) + उपलिम्पति (smears).

questions.q: By line 1, why should this sneha not be administered into the anus?
options: For it rushes upward with force
For it is too little in amount
optionExplain: Rushing upward is the uncovered sneha of verse 15.
Right: गुदं स ह्युपलिम्पति: हि gives the reason.
No burning is named; उपलिम्पति is smearing.
Little (अल्प) sneha was verse 3, not this line.
questions.explain: स ह्युपलिम्पति = for it smears (the anus): the reason for the prohibition.

questions.q: Like न प्रणयेत् (one should not administer), which phrase means one should not give?
optionExplain: This is a statement: he does not give.
This is 'not having given', an absolutive.
Right: न + optative = a prohibition: दद्यात् is the optative of √दा.
This is 'not to give', an infinitive of purpose.
questions.explain: न + optative = one should not ...
questions.teaches: न with an optative forbids: न प्रणयेत् (should not administer), न दद्यात् (should not give).

questions.q: In what is the oil of line 1 boiled?
options: In the juice of arka leaves
optionExplain: Urine is in the nirūha of verse 16.
Sour gruel (सौवीरक) is in verse 6.
Milk is not named in this verse.
Right: अर्कपत्ररसे = in the juice of arka (madar) leaves.
questions.explain: तैलम् अर्कपत्ररसे शृतम् = oil boiled in arka-leaf juice.

questions.q: Put the faulty nozzles of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Short, long, thin, thick, old, with loose binding.
questions.rule: ह्रस्व · दीर्घ · तनु · स्थूल · जीर्ण · शिथिलबन्धन.

questions.q: Match each word of line 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These describe the nozzles named in verse 20.
questions.rule: ह्रस्व = short; दीर्घ = long; तनु = thin; जीर्ण = old.
questions.teaches: Line 2 begins the list of faulty enema nozzles: short, long, thin, thick, old, loosely bound.

questions.q: ह्रस्व and दीर्घ are opposites in line 2. Which other pair of line 2 are opposites?
optionExplain: Right: Thin and thick.
Old and loosely bound are two faults, not opposites.
Long and thin are not opposites.
Thick and old are not opposites.
questions.explain: Line 2 pairs opposites: short/long, thin/thick; then old and loosely bound.

questions.q: Verse 18 forbids a sneha that smears the anus and opens the treatment. Which treatment does line 1 name?
options: A mild purgation and the āma measures
A sharp enema and arka-leaf oil
optionExplain: That is verse 12.
Right: तीक्ष्णो बस्तिस्तथा तैलमर्कपत्ररसे शृतम्.
That is verse 17, for the sneha at the throat.
That is verse 16.
questions.explain: Verse 18's 'kriyā atra' → sharp enema; oil boiled in arka-leaf juice.

questions.q: Like तीक्ष्णः + बस्तिः = तीक्ष्णो बस्तिः, how does स्थूलः + बस्तिः join?
optionExplain: -र् comes from a visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ.
-स् stays only before त/थ; not before ब.
Right: -अः before a voiced consonant becomes -ओ.
-आ comes from -आः, not from -अः.
questions.explain: तीक्ष्णः + बस्तिः → तीक्ष्णो बस्तिः; स्थूलः + बस्तिः → स्थूलो बस्तिः.
questions.teaches: A final -अः before a voiced consonant becomes -ओ: तीक्ष्णो बस्तिः, स्थूलो बस्तिः.

questions.q: What are the eight things that one should avoid (अष्टौ ... वर्जयेत्) in line 1?
optionExplain: Positions to avoid come in verses 23 and 24.
The eight bags come in verse 22.
No food is named in this verse.
Right: नेत्राणि = nozzles, the tube of the enema apparatus.
questions.explain: अष्टौ नेत्राणि वर्जयेत् = one should avoid the eight nozzles.

questions.q: Put the faults of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Non-arrival, over-going, agitation, dragging, wounding, leaking.
questions.rule: अप्राप्ति · अतिगति · क्षोभ · कर्षण · क्षणन · स्रव.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
pairs: with a hole in the side
questions.explain: Two faulty nozzles of line 1 and three of their faults in line 2.
questions.rule: पार्श्वच्छिद्र = side hole; वक्र = crooked; अप्राप्ति = non-arrival; क्षणन = wounding; स्रव = leaking.
questions.teaches: The eight nozzles to avoid are the six of verse 19 plus the side-holed and the crooked one.

questions.q: Which is the right split of वक्रमष्टौ?
optionExplain: Right: A final म् before a vowel is joined to it: वक्रम् + अ → वक्रम.
मष्टौ is not a word.
ष्टौ is not a word.
-अः + अ would give -ओऽ: वक्रोऽष्टौ.
questions.explain: वक्रम् (crooked) + अष्टौ (eight).

questions.q: A physician checks nozzles. Which do verses 19 and 20 tell him to avoid?
options: A nozzle with a hole in the side
optionExplain: Right: वक्र, this verse.
Not in the list; the list has a loosely bound one.
Right: ह्रस्व, verse 19.
Not in the list; the list has an old (जीर्ण) one.
Right: पार्श्वच्छिद्र, this verse.
questions.explain: Eight to avoid: short, long, thin, thick, old, loosely bound, side-holed, crooked.
questions.rule: ह्रस्व दीर्घ तनु स्थूल जीर्ण शिथिलबन्धन पार्श्वच्छिद्र वक्र.

questions.q: Like अष्टौ नेत्राणि वर्जयेत्, which phrase says one should avoid eight beds (शय्याः, f.)?
optionExplain: अष्टाः is not a form of the numeral.
Right: अष्टौ keeps the same form in every gender: अष्टौ नेत्राणि, अष्टौ शय्याः.
अष्टानि is not a form; the numeral does not take a neuter ending.
अष्टम् is not the plural numeral eight.
questions.explain: अष्टौ is the nominative/accusative of the numeral eight, alike in all genders.
questions.teaches: The numeral अष्टौ (eight) has one form for all three genders: अष्टौ नेत्राणि, अष्टौ बस्तीन्, अष्टौ शय्याः.

questions.q: What does दोषाः mean in तेषां दोषाः?
optionExplain: Vāta, Pitta and Kapha are not meant in this list.
Pain in the anus is one fault; दोषाः is the general word.
Right: Here दोष is the fault of a device, not a humour.
No drug is named here.
questions.explain: तेषां दोषाः = their faults (of the nozzles).

questions.q: Put the defective bags of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Fleshy, unctuous, uneven, net-like, thick, windy.
questions.rule: मांसल · स्निग्ध · विषम · जालवत् · स्थूल · वातल.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two nozzle faults of line 1 and two bag faults of line 2.
questions.rule: गुदपीडा = pain in the anus; जिह्म = crooked; जालवत् = net-like; वातल = windy.
questions.teaches: Pain in the anus and a crooked course complete the eight faults of the nozzles; line 2 starts the bags.

questions.q: Which is the right split of गतिर्जिह्मा?
optionExplain: इह्मा is not a word; the word is जिह्मा.
र्जिह्मा is not a word.
गतिर is not a word; the र् comes from the visarga of गतिः.
Right: A visarga after इ becomes र् before the voiced ज.
questions.explain: गतिः (course) + जिह्मा (crooked).

questions.q: A student counts the eight faults of the nozzles. Which two in this verse complete them?
options: Pain in the anus and a crooked course
Fleshy and unctuous, of the bags
optionExplain: Right: गुदपीडा गतिर्जिह्मा.
These are defective bags of line 2, not faults.
These are bags of verse 22.
These are in verse 20, already counted.
questions.explain: Six faults in verse 20 + two here = eight.

questions.q: In गतिर्जिह्मा, जिह्मा agrees with गतिः (f.). Which phrase means a crooked nozzle (नेत्रम्, n.)?
optionExplain: जिह्मा is feminine, for गतिः.
Right: The adjective takes the neuter nominative -म् to agree with नेत्रम्.
जिह्मः is masculine.
जिह्मे is a locative or a dual; नेत्रम् is singular.
questions.explain: Adjectives agree with their noun in gender, number and case.
questions.teaches: An adjective follows its noun's gender: गतिर्जिह्मा (f.), जिह्मं नेत्रम् (n.).

questions.q: What does बस्ति mean in तानष्टौ बस्तीन्?
optionExplain: The bladder sense is not meant here.
No body part is meant by बस्तीन् here.
Right: The faults named are of a bag, so बस्ति is the bag here.
अष्टौ counts eight faulty bags, not a course.
questions.explain: बस्तीन् = the bags (acc. pl.), the device of the enema.

questions.q: Put the faults of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Uneven going, bad smell, crookedness, leaking, hard to hold.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two bags of line 1 and three of their faults.
questions.rule: छिन्न = cut; क्लिन्न = moist; दौर्गन्ध्य = bad smell; स्रुति = leaking; दुर्ग्रह = hard to hold.
questions.teaches: The eight bags to avoid are the six of verse 21 plus the cut and the moist one.

questions.q: Which is the right split of तानष्टौ?
optionExplain: -अः + अ would give -ओऽ: तानोऽष्टौ.
ष्टौ is not a word.
त् before न would become न्: तन्नष्टौ.
Right: A final न् before a vowel joins it: तान् + अ → तान.
questions.explain: तान् (those, m. acc. pl.) + अष्टौ (eight).

questions.q: A physician finds that the bag is torn. What does this verse say?
options: It is among the eight bags to avoid
Only nozzles are faulted, never the bags
It is to be used for a mild enema
It is avoided only in the nirūha enema
optionExplain: Right: छिन्नः is one of the eight bags to avoid.
Verses 21 and 22 fault the bags too.
No such use is named; it is to be avoided.
कर्मसु = in the procedures, with no such limit.
questions.explain: छिन्नः क्लिन्नश्च तानष्टौ बस्तीन्कर्मसु वर्जयेत्.

questions.q: Like जिह्म → जिह्मत्व (crookedness), what does स्थूलत्व mean?
optionExplain: That is the adjective स्थूल itself.
Right: -त्व makes an abstract noun: the state of being thick.
That would be a causative noun, not -त्व.
That is स्थूल standing for a noun.
questions.explain: -त्व = -ness: जिह्मत्व crookedness, स्थूलत्व thickness.
questions.teaches: The suffix -त्व makes an abstract noun: जिह्मत्व = crookedness, स्थूलत्व = thickness.

questions.q: What does बस्तिदोषतः mean?
optionExplain: -तः is not a locative, and दोष here is fault.
There is no negative in the word.
Right: -तः gives the sense 'from': basti-doṣa-taḥ.
No mending is named.
questions.explain: बस्ति-दोषतः = from the fault of the basti (bag).

questions.q: Put the topics of verses 19 to 24 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Nozzles (19-20), their faults (20-21), bags (21-22), their faults (22-23), positions (23-24).

questions.q: Match each clear word to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words are sure; the first word of each line is unreadable.
questions.rule: बस्तेः = of the basti; स्युः = would be; दोष = fault; ऊर्ध्व = upward.
questions.teaches: Line 1 says such faults would be of the basti, from the basti's fault; only these words and 'foamy' are sure.

questions.q: In verses 21 to 23 बस्ति is the bag. Which phrase uses बस्ति for the enema itself?
optionExplain: These are the eight bags to avoid.
Here the faults are of the bag.
From the fault of the bag.
Right: A sharp enema: here basti is the treatment.
questions.explain: Basti = bag in verses 21-23; enema in verse 19.

questions.q: A bag leaks and smells bad during the enema. How do verses 22 and 23 class these?
options: As faults from the basti's fault
As faults of the enema nozzle
As faults of the bed and posture
As signs of a covering by stool
optionExplain: Right: बस्तेः स्युर्बस्तिदोषतः: they come from the bag's fault.
The nozzle faults were verses 20 and 21.
The positions come in verses 23 and 24.
Those signs were verse 12.
questions.explain: Leaking and bad smell are listed in verse 22 and summed up here as from the bag's fault.

questions.q: Like बस्तिदोषतः (from the basti's fault), what does नेत्रदोषतः mean?
optionExplain: In would be a locative such as नेत्रदोषे.
Right: -तः added to a stem gives 'from': नेत्र-दोष-तः.
That would be the plural नेत्रदोषाः.
To would be a dative or accusative.
questions.explain: -तः = from: बस्तिदोषतः, नेत्रदोषतः.
questions.teaches: The suffix -तः gives the sense 'from': बस्तिदोषतः = from the bag's fault, नेत्रदोषतः = from the nozzle's fault.

questions.q: What does उत्तान mean?
optionExplain: Face-down would be न्युब्ज or अवाक्.
The left side would be वाम पार्श्व.
Right: उत्तान = lying on the back, face-up.
No sitting is named.
questions.explain: उत्तानम् = supine.

questions.q: Put these words of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Supine, the right side, (sama) beds, one should avoid.

questions.q: Match each word of line 1 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The clear words of line 1.
questions.rule: उत्तान = supine; दक्षिण = right; पार्श्व = side; परित्यजेत् = should avoid.
questions.teaches: Line 1 tells one to avoid the supine position and the right side for the enema.

questions.q: Which verb of verses 20 and 22 means the same as परित्यजेत्?
optionExplain: This means 'one should expel' (verse 14).
This means 'one should administer' (verse 18).
This means 'one should do' (verse 17).
Right: Both mean 'one should avoid'.
questions.explain: वर्जयेत् (nozzles, bags) and परित्यजेत् (positions) both say 'avoid'.

questions.q: A patient is laid face-up to receive the enema. What does line 1 say of this?
options: It is a position to avoid
It is the position the verse prescribes
It is allowed only after food
It is avoided only for the nirūha
optionExplain: Right: उत्तानं ... परित्यजेत्: the supine position is to be avoided.
The verse lists it among things to avoid.
Food is not named in this verse.
No such limit is stated.
questions.explain: Supine and the right side are to be avoided.

questions.q: Like दक्षिणं पार्श्वम् (the right side, acc.), which phrase means the left side (वाम = left)?
optionExplain: वामः is nominative; पार्श्वम् here is accusative.
Right: वाम takes the same case and gender as पार्श्वम्.
वामा is feminine.
वामे is a locative.
questions.explain: Adjective and noun agree: दक्षिणं पार्श्वम्, वामं पार्श्वम्.
questions.rule: Agreement in case, number and gender.
questions.teaches: An adjective takes its noun's case and gender: दक्षिणं पार्श्वम्, वामं पार्श्वम् (the right / left side).

questions.q: What does मरुत्कोप mean?
optionExplain: Blockage of urine is in verse 24, on a conjectural reading.
कोप is aggravation, the opposite of calming.
Right: मरुत् = wind, कोप = aggravation.
No loss of strength is named.
questions.explain: मरुत्-कोपः = aggravation of wind.

questions.q: Put these words of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Their faults would be; to be arranged ... here.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: The clear members of line 1.
questions.rule: आशु = quick; आगति = coming; मरुत् = wind; पक्वाशय = large-intestine region.
questions.teaches: Line 1 (conjectural) closes the list: quick coming, aggravation of wind, and the pakvāśaya.

questions.q: Which is the right split of आश्वागतिः?
optionExplain: उ + अ would give व: आश्वगतिः, with a short अ.
आश्वा is not a word.
A visarga after उ before a vowel becomes र्: आशुरागतिः.
Right: उ + आ → वा: आशु + आ → आश्वा.
questions.explain: आशु (quick) + आगतिः (coming).

questions.q: What does line 2 call the outcomes listed in verses 24 and 25?
optionExplain: Right: तद्दोषाः स्युः: these would be their faults.
Āma was verses 11 and 12.
Turning back was verse 17.
The nozzles were verses 19 and 20.
questions.explain: तद्दोषाः sums up the list of verses 24-25.

questions.q: Like विधातव्यम् (to be arranged), what does कर्तव्यम् mean?
optionExplain: Having done would be कृत्वा.
Right: -तव्य is the gerundive: what is to be done.
Doing would be कुर्वत्.
One who does would be कर्तृ.
questions.explain: -तव्य = to be ...: विधातव्यम्, कर्तव्यम्.
questions.teaches: The gerundive in -तव्य says what is to be done: विधातव्यम् (to be arranged), कर्तव्यम् (to be done).

questions.q: What does तिर्यक् mean in this list of faults?
optionExplain: Too slow is अतिमन्दक, in line 2.
Shaken is कम्पित.
Right: तिर्यक् = slanting, crosswise.
Lifted up is उत्क्षिप्त.
questions.explain: तिर्यक् = slanting: one of the faults of giving the enema.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these clear faults of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: After the damaged first member: struck too much, lifted up, slanting, hurried, shaken.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each fault to its meaning.
questions.explain: These are clear members of the list of faults.
questions.rule: अतिहत = struck too much; द्रुत = hurried; कम्पित = shaken; अतिवेग = too forceful.
questions.teaches: The verse lists faults of giving the enema: struck too much, lifted up, slanting, hurried, shaken, too slow, outer, too forceful.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split is right for तिर्यग्द्रुत?
optionExplain: Neither तिर्यग्द् nor रुत is the word here.
त् would give द्, not ग्.
Neither तिर्य nor ग्द्रुत is a word.
Right: क् → ग् before the voiced द.
questions.explain: तिर्यक् (slanting) + द्रुत (hurried).
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which of these faults are named in line 2?
optionExplain: Right: बाह्य is named.
Not named in this list.
Heat is not named in this list.
Right: अतिवेग is named.
Right: अतिमन्द with -क.
questions.explain: Line 2: अतिमन्दक, बाह्य, अतिवेग: these are faults.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Like अति + वेग = अतिवेग (too much speed), what does अतिमात्र mean?
optionExplain: Right: अति- = beyond, too much: अतिमात्र = beyond the measure.
Without would need a negative such as अ- or निर्-.
Small is अल्प; अति- means too much.
अति- goes beyond; it does not mean exact.
questions.explain: अति- before a noun or adjective: too much, beyond.
questions.teaches: The prefix अति- means too much or beyond: अतिवेग, अतिहत, अतिमन्दक, अतिमात्र.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: What does the agitated wind become, by line 2?
options: A cause of burning and swelling
A cause of pain and pricking
optionExplain: Burning and swelling are named in verse 32.
Right: शूलतोदकरः = producing pain (शूल) and pricking pain (तोद).
Heavy stool is in verse 34.
Stiffness of the thighs is in verse 29.
questions.explain: प्रविश्य क्षुभितो वायुः शूलतोदकरो भवेत्.
questions.rule: शूल = pain; तोद = pricking pain; -कर = producing.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these words of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Having entered, agitated, the wind, producing pain and pricking, would become.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of line 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 2 says what the wind does: it enters, is agitated, and produces pain and pricking.
questions.rule: प्रविश्य = having entered; क्षुभित = agitated; शूल = pain; तोद = pricking pain.
questions.teaches: Line 2: the agitated wind, having entered, would produce pain (śūla) and pricking pain (toda).
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split is right for क्षुभितो वायुः?
optionExplain: A final म् does not turn into ओ.
A final आ does not turn into ओ.
Right: -अः before a voiced sound (व) → -ओ.
A final औ stays औ or becomes आव्, never ओ.
questions.explain: क्षुभितः (agitated, m. nom. sg.) agrees with वायुः.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Why does प्रविश्य end in -य and not in -त्वा?
options: -य marks a future action to come
-य marks a passive form of the root
-य marks that the subject is plural
A prefix (प्र-) stands before the root
optionExplain: प्रविश्य is an absolutive, not a future.
प्रविश्य is not passive; the wind itself enters.
The subject वायुः is singular.
Right: With a prefix the absolutive takes -य: प्र-√विश् → प्रविश्य.
questions.explain: Absolutive: -त्वा without a prefix, -य with a prefix.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Like प्र + √विश् → प्रविश्य (having entered), what is the absolutive of उप + √विश् (having sat down)?
optionExplain: Right: With the prefix उप- the absolutive takes -य: उपविश्य.
This is the present tense: he sits down.
This is the past participle: seated.
-त्वा is not used when a prefix stands before the root.
questions.explain: Prefix + root + -य = having done (absolutive).
questions.teaches: With a prefix, the absolutive ends in -य: प्रविश्य (having entered), उपविश्य (having sat down).
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Where is the oil massage (अभ्यङ्ग) applied, in line 1?
optionExplain: The head is not named in line 1.
Right: अभ्यङ्गो गुदे: गुदे is the locative, on the anus.
The belly is not named in line 1.
Thighs are named in verse 29, not here.
questions.explain: तत्राभ्यङ्गो गुदे = there, oil massage on the anus.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these phrases in the order of the verse (the unclear printed word is left out).
questions.explain: Line 1: the remedy; line 2: introduced quickly, drawn out.
questions.rule: अभ्यङ्ग गुदे · वातघ्न अशन · द्रुतं प्रणीते · निष्कृष्टे.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of the verse to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1 gives the remedy; line 2 names faulty handlings.
questions.rule: अभ्यङ्ग = oil massage; वातघ्न = Vāta-destroying; अशन = food; निष्कृष्ट = drawn out.
questions.teaches: The pain of verse 27 is met with oil massage on the anus and Vāta-destroying foods.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split is right for वातघ्नान्यशनानि?
optionExplain: यशनानि is not a word; the word is अशनानि.
न्यशनानि is not a word.
Right: इ + अ → य: वातघ्नानि + अशनानि → वातघ्नान्यशनानि.
Neither part is a word.
questions.explain: वातघ्नानि (Vāta-destroying, n. pl.) agrees with अशनानि (foods).
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which handlings does line 2 name?
optionExplain: Beyond measure is verse 33.
Right: द्रुतं प्रणीते.
Pressed too much is verse 36.
Right: निष्कृष्टे.
questions.explain: द्रुतं प्रणीते निष्कृष्टे सहसोत्क्षिप्त एव वा.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Like वात + घ्न = वातघ्न (Vāta-destroying), what does कफघ्न mean?
optionExplain: Caused by would be कफज.
-घ्न destroys; it does not increase.
Free of would need निः- or a similar word.
Right: -घ्न = destroying: कफघ्न destroys Kapha.
questions.explain: -घ्न at the end of a compound = destroying the first member.
questions.teaches: -घ्न at the end of a compound means 'destroying': वातघ्न, कफघ्न.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: What does स्तम्भ mean in line 1?
optionExplain: Right: स्तम्भ = stiffness, rigidity.
Swelling is शोफ, in verse 32.
Burning is दाह, in verse 32.
Itching is not named here.
questions.explain: स्तम्भ = stiffness; भेदन = splitting pain.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these body sites in the order of line 1.
questions.explain: Waist, anus, calves, thighs, bladder: then stiffness and splitting pain.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each body site of line 1 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five sites are named; each gets stiffness and severe splitting pain.
questions.rule: कटी = waist; जङ्घा = calf; ऊरु = thigh; बस्ति in line 1 = bladder.
questions.teaches: Line 1: stiffness and severe splitting pain of waist, anus, calves, thighs and bladder.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: बस्ति occurs in both lines. What is it in line 1, and in सबस्तयः of line 2?
options: Enema in both of the lines
Bladder in line 1, enema in line 2
Bladder in both of the lines
Enema in line 1, bladder in line 2
optionExplain: In line 1 it stands among body sites: the bladder.
Right: Line 1 lists body sites; line 2 lists remedies.
In line 2 it stands among remedies: the enema.
The other way round: site first, remedy second.
questions.explain: Read बस्ति by its company: among body parts the bladder, among remedies the enema.
questions.rule: बस्ति = bladder (site) or enema (treatment), by context.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: The waist and thighs stiffen after it was introduced quickly or drawn out. Which remedies does line 2 give?
options: Cool astringent and sweet affusions here
Ghee, milk and a picchā enema
optionExplain: Cool affusions are verse 33.
The picchā enema is verse 34.
Right: भोजनं वातघ्नं स्वेदाभ्यङ्गाः सबस्तयः.
These are verse 36.
questions.explain: Stiffness and splitting pain → Vāta-destroying food, sweating, oil massage, with enemas.
questions.rule: स्तम्भ-भेदन → वातघ्न भोजन, स्वेद, अभ्यङ्ग, बस्ति.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Like जङ्घा + ऊरु → जङ्घोरु (आ + ऊ → ओ), how do महा + उदर join?
optionExplain: औ would come from आ + ओ or औ, not from आ + उ.
The उ cannot simply vanish.
व् comes from उ before a vowel, not from आ.
Right: आ + उ → ओ: महा + उदर → महोदर.
questions.explain: अ/आ + उ/ऊ → ओ (guṇa).
questions.rule: आ + ऊ → ओ; आ + उ → ओ.
questions.teaches: अ or आ followed by उ or ऊ becomes ओ: जङ्घा + ऊरु → जङ्घोरु, महा + उदर → महोदर.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: What covers the opening in line 1?
optionExplain: Right: तिर्यग्वल्यावृत = covered by a slanting fold (वली).
Stool is not named here.
Oil is not named in line 1.
Swelling (शोफ) is in verse 32.
questions.explain: तिर्यक् + वली + आवृत + द्वारे: when the opening is covered by a slanting fold.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these phrases in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The problem (covered or blocked, it does not go), then the steps: draw out straight, cleanse, lead again.
questions.rule: covered · blocked, does not go · draw out straight · cleanse, lead again.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1 names the obstacle; line 2 the steps.
questions.rule: वली = fold; बद्ध = blocked; ऋजु = straight; संशोध्य = having cleansed.
questions.teaches: When a fold covers the opening, the nozzle is drawn out straight, cleansed and led in again.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split is right for पुनर्नयेत्?
optionExplain: येत् is not a word.
Right: पुनः ends in an original र्, which shows before the voiced न: पुनर्नयेत्.
There is no word पुनम्; and म् would not become र्.
अर्नयेत् is not a word.
questions.explain: पुनः (again) + नयेत् (should lead).
questions.rule: पुनः → पुनर् before a voiced sound.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: It will not go, because a slanting fold covers the opening. What does line 2 say to do?
options: Push harder until it slides past
Leave it in, give a purgation
optionExplain: The verse never says to push harder.
No purgation is named here.
Right: तदृजु निष्कास्य संशोध्य च पुनर्नयेत्.
Oil massage is verse 28, for pain.
questions.explain: Covered or blocked → draw out straight → cleanse → lead in again.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: In प्रक्षाल्य पुनर्दद्यात् (two actions, like निष्कास्य ... नयेत्), which is done first?
optionExplain: The absolutive marks the earlier action, so washing is first.
The absolutive marks a prior action, not a simultaneous one.
प्रक्षाल्य says the washing is done.
Right: The absolutive (-य) action comes before the main verb.
questions.explain: Absolutive (-य / -त्वा) = having done; then the optative verb.
questions.teaches: An absolutive names the earlier action: निष्कास्य, संशोध्य ... पुनर्नयेत् = having drawn out and cleansed, one should lead again.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: What happens to the wind (अनिल) in the anus, in line 1?
options: It is let out freely and fully
It is calmed by the oil
It is mixed with the stool
optionExplain: Right: प्रतिहतोऽनिलः = the wind, struck back, obstructed.
प्रतिहत means struck back, the opposite of free.
Nothing in line 1 calms it.
Stool is not named here.
questions.explain: मुक्ते गुदे प्रतिहतोऽनिलः: let go, the wind in the anus is struck back.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these words in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Released, in the anus, struck back, the wind; then chest-and-head pain, sinking, of the thighs.
questions.rule: मुक्ते · गुदे · प्रतिहतः · अनिलः · उरःशिरोरुजम् · सादम् · ऊर्वोः.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of line 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 2 names the effects: pain of chest and head, sinking of the thighs.
questions.rule: उरः = chest; शिरः = head; रुज् (रुजम्) = pain; साद = sinking.
questions.teaches: Let go in between, the struck-back wind would produce pain of the chest and head and sinking of the thighs.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: What form is ऊर्वोः here?
options: Genitive dual: of the two thighs
optionExplain: The nominative plural would be ऊरवः.
Right: ऊरु, -ओः = genitive dual: the sinking of the two thighs.
The locative singular would be ऊरौ.
The instrumental plural would be ऊरुभिः.
questions.explain: सादम् ऊर्वोः = sinking of the (two) thighs.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: The wind is struck back in the anus. What does line 2 say it may produce?
options: Burning, swelling and pain of the anus
Stiffness of the waist and calves
Pain of chest and head, sinking of thighs
Pain and pricking in the belly
optionExplain: Burning and swelling are verse 32.
That is verse 29.
Right: उरःशिरोरुजं सादमूर्वोश्च जनयेत्.
Pain and pricking are verse 27.
questions.explain: Struck-back wind → chest and head pain, sinking of the thighs.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Like प्रतिहतः + अनिलः → प्रतिहतोऽनिलः, how do वातः + अपि join?
optionExplain: -अः does not become आ before अ.
र् appears only after vowels other than अ / आ.
Visarga becomes स् before त् / थ्, not before a vowel.
Right: -अः + अ → -ओ, and the अ is dropped (ऽ).
questions.teaches: A final -अः before अ- becomes -ओ and the अ- is dropped, marked by ऽ: प्रतिहतोऽनिलः, वातोऽपि.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which plant opens the compound of the enema's contents?
optionExplain: Right: बिल्वादि: bilva (wood-apple) and the rest.
Nimba is not named here.
Kuṭaja is not named here.
Madana is not named here.
questions.explain: बिल्वादिफलश्यामादिमूत्रवान्: bilva first, then fruit, śyāmā, urine.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put the contents of the enema in the order of line 1.
questions.explain: Bilva and the rest, fruit, śyāmā and the rest, urine: the enema 'having' these (-वान्).
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of line 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 2 names signs when the anus is injured.
questions.rule: दाह = burning; दवथु = burning distress; शोफ = swelling; अभिहत = injured.
questions.teaches: When the anus is injured: burning, burning distress and swelling.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: What does -वान् at the end of ...मूत्रवान् say about the enema?
options: It is free of these things
It is made for the urine
It is given after passing urine
optionExplain: Free of would need a negative; -वान् means having.
Right: -वत् (nom. -वान्) = having: the basti has bilva, fruit, śyāmā, urine.
-वान् does not mean 'for'.
-वान् does not name a time.
questions.explain: -वत् / -वान् = possessing.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: The anus has been injured during the enema. Which signs does line 2 name?
options: Pain of the chest and the head
optionExplain: That is verse 31.
That is verse 29.
Right: दाहो दवथुः शोफः ... अभिहते गुदे.
That is verse 34.
questions.explain: Injured anus → dāha, davathu, śopha.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Like मूत्रवान् (having urine) said of the masculine बस्तिः, which word means having oil?
optionExplain: This is the genitive: of oil.
This is the ablative: from oil.
This is the plural: oils.
Right: -वत्, masculine nominative -वान्: तैलवान् बस्तिः = an enema having oil.
questions.explain: Noun + -वत् makes an adjective 'having'; it agrees with बस्तिः as -वान्.
questions.teaches: The suffix -वत् (masculine nominative -वान्) makes 'having X': मूत्रवान्, तैलवान्.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: What kind of affusions (सेक) does line 1 name?
optionExplain: Right: कषायमधुराः शीताः सेकाः.
Pungent, salty and hot are not named.
Sour and bitter are not named here.
Oily and heavy are not named here.
questions.explain: Cool astringent-sweet affusions, with enemas.
questions.rule: कषाय = astringent; मधुर = sweet; शीत = cool.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these words of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Astringent and sweet, cool, affusions, there, with enemas.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1: the cool affusions; line 2: the nozzle introduced beyond measure.
questions.rule: मधुर = sweet; शीत = cool; सेक = affusion; अतिमात्र = beyond measure.
questions.teaches: Burning and swelling of the injured anus are met with cool astringent and sweet affusions, with enemas.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split is right for सेकास्तत्र?
optionExplain: स्तत्र is not a word.
Right: -आः before त् → -आस्: सेकाः + तत्र → सेकास्तत्र.
सेकाः + अत्र would give सेका अत्र, not सेकास्तत्र.
म् before त् would give सेकं तत्र.
questions.explain: सेकाः (affusions) + तत्र (there).
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: A nozzle was introduced beyond measure. What does line 2 say is wounded?
optionExplain: The bladder is named in verse 29, not here.
The throat is verse 36.
Right: क्षणनाद्बलेः = from the wounding of the fold.
Thighs are verses 29 and 31.
questions.explain: अतिमात्रप्रणीतेन नेत्रेण क्षणनाद्बलेः: by a nozzle introduced beyond measure, from the wounding of the fold.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Like अतिमात्रप्रणीतेन नेत्रेण (by a nozzle introduced too far), which means by a hurried hand (हस्त, m.)?
optionExplain: द्रुतः is nominative; it does not agree with हस्तेन.
द्रुतस्य is genitive; it does not agree with हस्तेन.
हस्तः is nominative; it does not agree with द्रुतेन.
Right: The adjective takes the noun's case: both instrumental singular.
questions.explain: Adjective and noun agree in case: -एन ... -एन.
questions.teaches: An adjective agrees with its noun in case: अतिमात्रप्रणीतेन नेत्रेण, द्रुतेन हस्तेन (both instrumental).
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which enema is recommended in line 2?
optionExplain: Right: पिच्छाबस्तिश्च शस्यते.
Urine is in the enema of verse 32.
A sharp enema is not named here.
Cool affusions are verse 33.
questions.explain: पिच्छा-बस्ति = an enema of picchā, a slimy substance.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these words of line 2 in the order of the verse (the unclear word is left out).
questions.explain: There, milk and the picchā enema are recommended.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of line 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The clear words of the remedy line.
questions.rule: क्षीर = milk; पिच्छा = slime; शस्यते = is recommended; तत्र = there.
questions.teaches: For the wounded fold, milk and the picchā enema are recommended.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split is right for पिच्छाबस्तिश्च?
optionExplain: श्च is not a word.
Right: -इः before च् → -इश्: बस्तिः + च → बस्तिश्च.
म् before च would give बस्तिं च.
अच is not a word here.
questions.explain: पिच्छाबस्तिः (the picchā enema) + च (and).
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: After a nozzle pushed too far has wounded the fold, which of these does line 2 recommend?
optionExplain: Right: पिच्छाबस्तिः.
Those are verse 33, for the injured anus.
Right: क्षीरम्.
Purgation is verse 36.
That is verses 28-29.
questions.explain: तत्र ... क्षीरं पिच्छाबस्तिश्च शस्यते.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Like शस्यते (is recommended, passive of √शंस्), what does दीयते mean, from √दा?
optionExplain: Gives is ददाति, active.
The future is दास्यति.
Right: -यते marks the present passive: दीयते = is given.
The past would be दत्तः or अदीयत.
questions.explain: Root + -यते = present passive: is done.
questions.teaches: The present passive ends in -यते: शस्यते (is recommended), दीयते (is given).
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: What does the outer (बाह्य) one do, in line 1?
optionExplain: Staying in the belly is verse 36.
Rising to the throat is verse 36.
Burning is verse 32.
Right: बाह्यश्चाशु निवर्तते: the outer one returns quickly.
questions.explain: आशु निवर्तते = returns quickly.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these phrases in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The two faults, then: the sneha, again properly, to be given, by one wishing success.
questions.rule: मन्द · बाह्य · स्नेह · पुनः सम्यक् · प्रणेयः · सिद्धिमिच्छता.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1 says what goes wrong with the slow and the outer administration.
questions.rule: मन्द = slow; बाह्य = outer; आशु = quickly; निवर्तते = returns.
questions.teaches: The slow one does not soak in (rendering open), the outer one returns quickly: then the sneha is given again properly.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split is right for बाह्यश्चाशु?
optionExplain: Right: -अः + च → -अश्च; च + आ → चा.
म् before च would give बाह्यं च.
श्च is not a word.
चाशु is not a word; it is च + आशु.
questions.explain: बाह्यः (outer) + च (and) + आशु (quickly).
questions.rule: विसर्ग + च् → श्च्; अ + आ → आ.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: The sneha given has returned quickly. What does line 2 tell one who wishes for success?
options: Give no more sneha that day
optionExplain: The verse says to give it again.
Right: स्नेहस्तत्र पुनः सम्यक् प्रणेयः.
No purgation is named here.
Too forceful (अतिवेग) is itself a fault in verse 26.
questions.explain: Failed sneha → give it again, properly.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: In सिद्धिमिच्छता ... प्रणेयः the doer of a gerundive stands in the instrumental. Which means the enema should be given by the physician?
optionExplain: भिषक् is nominative: it would say the physician is to be given.
बस्तिम् is accusative; the thing to be given is nominative with देयः.
Right: भिषजा is instrumental: the doer of the gerundive देयः.
भिषजम् is accusative; the doer needs the instrumental.
questions.explain: Gerundive: the thing in the nominative, the doer in the instrumental.
questions.rule: X देयः Y-इना / -आ = X is to be given by Y.
questions.teaches: With a gerundive (प्रणेयः, देयः) the thing done is nominative and the doer instrumental: सिद्धिमिच्छता, भिषजा.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: What does अतिप्रपीडितः describe?
optionExplain: Too slow is अतिमन्दक, verse 26.
Lifted suddenly is verse 28.
No length of time is named.
Right: अति + प्रपीडित = pressed in too much.
questions.explain: अतिप्रपीडितः = pressed too much.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these phrases in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The fault, its two outcomes, then the three measures.
questions.rule: अतिप्रपीडितः · कोष्ठे तिष्ठति · आयाति गलम् · बस्तिः · विरेकः · गलपीडादिकर्म.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1: it stays in the belly or comes to the throat; line 2: the measures.
questions.rule: कोष्ठ = belly; गल = throat; विरेक = purgation; तिष्ठति = stays.
questions.teaches: Pressed too much, it stays in the koṣṭha or comes to the throat; enema and purgation are named.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split is right for तिष्ठत्यायाति?
optionExplain: Right: इ + आ → या: तिष्ठति + आयाति → तिष्ठत्यायाति.
तिष्ठत्य is not a verb form.
यायाति is not a word.
ई + या would stay ईया, not त्याया.
questions.explain: तिष्ठति (stays) + आयाति (comes).
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Given with too much pressure, it has come up to the throat. Which measures does line 2 name?
options: Enema, purgation, and galapīḍā and so on
Ghee, milk and the picchā enema
optionExplain: Those are verses 28-29.
Right: बस्तिर्विरेकश्च गलपीडादिकर्म च.
Those are verse 33.
Those are verse 34.
questions.explain: Pressed too much → basti, vireka, galapīḍā-ādi karma.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: Like गलम् आयाति (comes to the throat), what does मुखमायाति mean?
optionExplain: From the mouth would be मुखात्.
In the mouth would be मुखे.
Right: The accusative मुखम् names the goal.
With the mouth would be मुखेन.
questions.explain: With verbs of going and coming, the accusative names the goal.
questions.rule: गलम् आयाति = comes to the throat.
questions.teaches: With verbs of motion the accusative is the goal: गलम् आयाति, मुखमायाति.
questions.section: प्रणेता के दोष और उनकी चिकित्सा

questions.q: By what has the patient been purified (विशुद्ध), in line 1?
optionExplain: Bloodletting is not named.
Fasting is not named.
Sweating is not named here.
Right: वमनाद्यैर्विशुद्धम्: purified by vamana and the rest.
questions.explain: वमन-आद्यैः = by emesis and the rest (the purifying procedures).
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Put these phrases in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Purified by emesis and the rest, with emaciated body, strength and fire; as a tender egg, as a full oil vessel.
questions.rule: वमनाद्यैः · विशुद्धम् · क्षामदेहबलानलम् · यथाण्डं तरुणम् · पूर्णं तैलपात्रं यथा.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1 describes the patient; line 2 gives the two comparisons.
questions.rule: क्षाम = wasted; अनल = fire; तरुण = tender; तैलपात्र = oil vessel.
questions.teaches: After purification the patient, with emaciated body, strength and fire, is like a tender egg or a full oil vessel.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Which split is right for वमनाद्यैर्विशुद्धम्?
optionExplain: Right: -ऐः before a voiced sound (व) → -ऐर्.
इशुद्धम् is not a word.
म् would not become र्.
र्विशुद्धम् is not a word.
questions.explain: वमनाद्यैः (by emesis and the rest) + विशुद्धम् (purified).
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: A patient has had emesis and is now weak. How should he be regarded, by line 2?
options: Like a strong young ox, ready for hard work
Like a tender egg or a full oil vessel
Like dry wood, ready to be burned
Like a ripe fruit, ready to fall
optionExplain: No such comparison is in the verse; it compares him to an egg and an oil vessel.
Right: यथाण्डं तरुणं पूर्णं तैलपात्रं यथा.
No such comparison is in the verse.
No such comparison is in the verse.
questions.explain: Both images ask for great care: fragile egg, brim-full vessel.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Like यथाण्डं ... तथा (as an egg ... so), which sentence means as the father, so the son?
optionExplain: यदा ... तदा = when ... then.
यत्र ... तत्र = where ... there.
Right: यथा ... तथा = as ... so.
यतः ... ततः = from where / since ... then.
questions.explain: Comparison pair: यथा ... तथा.
questions.teaches: यथा ... तथा makes a comparison: यथाण्डं ... तथा, यथा पिता तथा पुत्रः.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: From what should the physician protect the patient?
optionExplain: Wind is not named here.
Heavy foods are not named.
Sweet things are in fact given first.
Right: सर्वस्मादपचारतः = from every wrong conduct (अपचार).
questions.explain: भिषक् ... रक्षेत् सर्वस्मादपचारतः.
questions.rule: अपचार = wrong conduct, lapse in regimen.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Put these phrases in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: The physician should protect from all wrong conduct; give sweet, agreeable things; then sour and salty.
questions.rule: भिषक् · रक्षेत् · सर्वस्मादपचारतः · दद्यान्मधुरहृद्यानि · ततोऽम्ललवणौ रसौ.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Protection first, then a sequence of tastes.
questions.rule: अपचार = wrong conduct; हृद्य = agreeable; अम्ल = sour; लवण = salty.
questions.teaches: After purification: protect from wrong conduct, give sweet and agreeable things, then sour and salty.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: What does ततः tell about अम्ल and लवण?
options: They come after the sweet ones
They come before the sweet ones
They are mixed with the sweet ones
optionExplain: Right: ततः = then, after that.
ततः means after, not before.
ततः gives a sequence, not a replacement.
ततः gives a sequence, not a mixture.
questions.explain: दद्यान्मधुरहृद्यानि ततोऽम्ललवणौ रसौ: sweet first, then sour and salty.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: A physician gives sour and salty things at once after purification. What does this verse say?
options: That is exactly the verse's order
Sweet, agreeable ones should come first
The order of tastes does not matter
Only salty should be given at all
optionExplain: The verse puts sweet first.
Right: Sweet and agreeable first; sour and salty then (ततः).
The verse gives an order with ततः.
Sour and sweet are named too.
questions.explain: मधुर-हृद्य → अम्ल-लवण.
questions.rule: First sweet, then sour and salty.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Like अम्ललवणौ रसौ (the two tastes sour and salty), how do you say the two tastes sweet and bitter?
optionExplain: -आः is plural, not dual.
रसः is singular; it must be dual to agree.
Right: Dual -औ on both, like अम्ललवणौ रसौ.
-आन् is accusative plural, not dual.
questions.explain: A dvandva of two adjectives is dual and agrees with रसौ.
questions.teaches: Two items in a dvandva take the dual: अम्ललवणौ रसौ, मधुरतिक्तौ रसौ.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Which pair of tastes is given after sweet and bitter?
optionExplain: Sour and salty came before, in verse 38.
This pair is not named.
This pair is not named.
Right: कषायकटुकौ ततः: then astringent and pungent.
questions.explain: स्वादुतिक्तौ ... कषायकटुकौ ततः.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Put these phrases in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Sweet-bitter likewise again, astringent-pungent then; of the mutually opposed tastes, of the unctuous and dry.
questions.rule: स्वादुतिक्तौ · तथा भूयः · कषायकटुकौ ततः · अन्योन्यप्रत्यनीकानाम् · रसानाम् · स्निग्धरूक्षयोः.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1 names two more pairs of tastes; line 2 names the unctuous and the dry.
questions.rule: स्वादु = sweet; तिक्त = bitter; कटुक = pungent; रूक्ष = dry.
questions.teaches: The graded feeding goes on: sweet and bitter, then astringent and pungent.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Here कषाय stands in a list of tastes. What does it mean here?
optionExplain: Right: Among tastes, कषाय = astringent, कसैला.
Decoction is the other sense, not this one: it stands among tastes.
Sour is अम्ल.
No colour is meant here.
questions.explain: कषाय beside कटुक, among tastes: astringent.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Verse 38 gave sour and salty after sweet. What does this verse give next?
options: Sour and salty again, then sweet alone
optionExplain: Sour and salty do not return here.
Right: स्वादुतिक्तौ तथा भूयः कषायकटुकौ ततः.
Bitter comes paired with sweet.
Pungent comes last here.
questions.explain: Order: sweet-agreeable → sour-salty → sweet-bitter → astringent-pungent.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: अन्योन्य- means each other. What does अन्योन्यसहाय mean?
optionExplain: अन्योन्य is mutual, not 'others only'.
There is no negative.
Right: अन्योन्य + सहाय = helpers of each other.
Oneself would be आत्म-.
questions.explain: अन्योन्य- = mutual, each other, as in अन्योन्यप्रत्यनीक (opposed to each other).
questions.teaches: अन्योन्य- marks a mutual relation: अन्योन्यप्रत्यनीक (opposed to each other), अन्योन्यसहाय (helping each other).
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: To what should the physician lead the patient?
optionExplain: Fasting is not named.
No enema is named here.
Sleep is not named.
Right: तं प्रकृतिं नयेत्: lead him to his prakṛti.
questions.explain: प्रकृतिम् = to the natural state (accusative of the goal).
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Put these phrases in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: By alternation, by use, in order, lead him to his natural state; all-enduring, steady in strength, to be known, having reached it.
questions.rule: व्यत्यासात् · उपयोगेन · क्रमात् · तं प्रकृतिं नयेत् · सर्वसहः स्थिरबलः · विज्ञेयः प्रकृतिं गतः.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1: how he is led back; line 2: the signs of the natural state.
questions.rule: व्यत्यास = alternation; उपयोग = use; सर्वसह = all-enduring; स्थिरबल = of steady strength.
questions.teaches: By alternating use, step by step, he is led to his natural state: then he is all-enduring and of steady strength.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: What does प्रकृतिं गतः mean in line 2?
options: One who has reached his natural state
One who has gone away from his natural state
optionExplain: Right: गतः with the accusative = gone to, reached.
प्रकृतिम् is accusative, the goal; it is not the subject.
Away from would need the ablative प्रकृतेः.
गतः is a past participle; birth is not named.
questions.explain: गतः + accusative = having reached.
questions.rule: प्रकृतिं गतः = reached the natural state.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: A patient now bears everything and his strength is steady. How is he to be known?
options: As still too weak for any food
As restored to his natural state
As one who needs a second emesis
As one to be kept on gruel
optionExplain: Steady strength is the sign of recovery.
Right: सर्वसहः स्थिरबलो विज्ञेयः प्रकृतिं गतः.
No further purification is named.
Gruel is not named here.
questions.explain: All-enduring, steady strength → natural state reached.
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: Like सर्व + सह = सर्वसह (enduring all), what does क्लेशसह mean?
optionExplain: Causing would be -कर.
Free of would need निः- or a similar word.
Right: -सह at the end = enduring the first member.
Afraid would be -भीत.
questions.explain: X-सह = enduring X.
questions.teaches: -सह at the end of a compound means 'enduring': सर्वसह (enduring all), क्लेशसह (enduring hardship).
questions.section: शोधन के बाद रस-क्रम से प्रकृति

questions.q: What does त्यजेत् ask one to do with the eight (things) in this interval?
optionExplain: √त्यज् means to leave, not to practise.
Nothing about teaching is said; त्यजेत् = should give up.
The verse says give up, especially; it does not ask for moderation.
Right: त्यजेत् = should give up (optative of √त्यज्).
questions.explain: अत्रान्तरे त्यजेदष्टौ भाष्यादीनि विशेषतः: in this interval one should give up the eight beginning with speaking.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Put these words of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: In this interval, should give up the eight, beginning with speaking, especially.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Match each word of line 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 2 gives the first cause and its ailments: from loud speaking, head disease and pains of chest and voice.
questions.rule: उच्चैः = loudly; भाष्य = speaking; शिरोरोग = head disease; उरः = chest; स्वर = voice.
questions.teaches: From loud speaking (उच्चैर्भाष्यात्) come head disease, timira, and pains of the chest and voice.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Which split is right for त्यजेदष्टौ?
optionExplain: Right: त् → द् before a vowel: त्यजेत् + अष्टौ → त्यजेदष्टौ.
दष्टौ is not the word here; the number is अष्टौ (eight).
A visarga after ए before a vowel would not become द्.
अ + अ → आ would give त्यजेताष्टौ, not त्यजेदष्टौ.
questions.explain: त्यजेत् (should give up) + अष्टौ (eight).
questions.rule: Final त् → द् before a vowel.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Which ailments does line 2 name as coming from loud speaking?
optionExplain: Right: उरः ... व्यथाः, pains of the chest.
The thighs come in verse 44, from excessive walking.
Right: शिरोरोग is named.
Right: स्वर ... व्यथाः, pains of the voice.
Joint pain comes in verse 43, with another cause.
questions.explain: उच्चैर्भाष्यात् शिरोरोग-तिमिर-उरः-स्वर-व्यथाः: head disease, timira, chest and voice pains.
questions.rule: Loud speaking → head disease, timira, chest and voice pains.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Like भाष्यात् (from speaking), what does a new form भोजनात् mean?
optionExplain: For would be the dative भोजनाय.
Right: -आत् is the ablative singular of an अ-stem: from, because of.
In would be the locative भोजने.
Of would be the genitive भोजनस्य.
questions.explain: An ablative in -आत् names the cause: भाष्यात् = from speaking, भोजनात् = from eating.
questions.teaches: The ablative singular in -आत् names the cause: उच्चैर्भाष्यात् = from loud speaking.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does रक्तनिष्ठीवन mean?
optionExplain: Nose bleeding would need a word for the nose; निष्ठीवन is spitting.
Urine is not named; निष्ठीवन is spitting.
Right: रक्त = blood; निष्ठीवन = spitting.
Vomiting is छर्दि (verse 45); निष्ठीवन is spitting.
questions.explain: रक्त-निष्ठीवन = spitting of blood: first of the further ailments in line 1.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Match each clear word to its meaning.
questions.explain: ज्वर is an ailment of line 1; साधन introduces the remedies of line 2: अभ्यङ्ग, स्वेदन ...
questions.rule: अभ्यङ्ग = oil massage; स्वेदन = sweating; साधन = remedy; ज्वर = fever.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does अधोभक्त tell us about the unctuous substance (sneha)?
optionExplain: Before food would not be अधोभक्त; the card says after food.
Nothing says the sneha replaces food.
Night is not named; अधोभक्त = after food.
Right: अधोभक्त = after food: the sneha is used after the meal.
questions.explain: अधोभक्त-स्नेह-उपसेवनम् = the use of unctuous substance taken after food.
questions.teaches: The last remedy of line 2 is sneha taken after food (अधोभक्त).
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Which split is right for the ending ...आद्यास्तत्र in line 1?
optionExplain: Right: Visarga → स् before त: आद्याः + तत्र → आद्यास्तत्र.
A final म् does not turn into स्.
स्तत्र is not a word; the word is तत्र.
त् + त would stay त्त: आद्यात्तत्र.
questions.explain: ...आद्याः (and so on, nom. pl.) + तत्र (in that case).
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Put the clear remedies of line 2 in the order of the verse (leave out the conjectural nasya).
questions.explain: Oil massage, sweating, [nasya], and sneha taken after food.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Like स्वेदन (sweating, from √स्विद्), what does a new noun लेपन (from √लिप्, smear) mean?
optionExplain: The doer would be लेपक; -अन names the action.
Right: -अन makes an action noun: √लिप् → लेपन, the act of smearing.
The thing smeared would be लिप्त; -अन names the action.
Again would need पुनः; -अन names the action.
questions.explain: Root + -अन = the action: स्वेदन, साधन, लेपन.
questions.teaches: -अन makes action nouns: स्वेदन (sweating), साधन (remedy, means), उपसेवन (use).
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does मौनम् mean among these remedies?
optionExplain: Fasting is लङ्घन (verse 47).
Rest is not named; मौन = silence.
Right: मौन = silence, keeping quiet.
Sleep is not named here; मौन = silence.
questions.explain: मौनम् opens line 1 as a remedy.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Match each word of line 1 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1: silence; a Vāta-removing procedure; or one that conquers the disorder.
questions.rule: मौन = silence; विधि = procedure; वातहर = removing Vāta; विकारजित् = conquering the disorder.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does यथास्वम् add to the remedy that conquers the disorder?
options: Each according to its own case
optionExplain: यथास्वम् points to each case's own nature, not one rule for all.
Strength is not named in the verse.
Time of meal is not named here.
Right: यथास्वम् = according to each one's own.
questions.explain: यथास्वं वा विकारजित्: or, as is proper to each, one that conquers the disorder.
questions.rule: यथास्वम् = according to each one's own.
questions.teaches: यथास्वम् = each according to its own (case): the remedy is fitted to the disorder.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Which split is right for विधिर्वातहरो?
optionExplain: Right: -इः → -इर् before a voiced sound; -अः → -ओ before a voiced sound.
A final म् does not become र्.
र्वातहरः is not a word.
औ would not turn into ओ.
questions.explain: विधिः (procedure) + वातहरः (removing Vāta), both m. nom. sg.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Put the sites of pain named in line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: सन्धि-मूर्ध-त्रिक-आदि-रुक्: pain of joints, head, trika and so on.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Like विकारजित् (conquering the disorder), what would a new compound रोगजित् mean?
optionExplain: Born of would be -ज or -जात.
Right: -जित् = conquering: रोग-जित्, disease-conquering.
Suffering would be रोगी or रोगार्त.
Bringing on would be -कर or -कृत्.
questions.explain: Noun + -जित् = conquering that noun.
questions.teaches: -जित् at the end of a compound means conquering: विकारजित्, रोगजित्.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What is recommended for these ailments in line 2?
optionExplain: Kapha measures come in verse 47; here it is Vāta.
Those are the Kapha measures of verse 47.
Right: वातहरं सर्वम् = everything that removes Vāta.
Silence belongs to verse 43, nasya to verse 42.
questions.explain: तेषां वातहरं सर्वं स्नेहस्वेदादि शस्यते.
questions.rule: Remedy: everything Vāta-removing, oleation and sweating first.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Put the limbs of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: पाद-जङ्घा-ऊरु: feet, shanks, thighs, and so on.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: The limbs that suffer, and the verb of the remedy.
questions.rule: पाद = foot; जङ्घा = shank; ऊरु = thigh; शस्यते = is recommended.
questions.teaches: Feet, shanks and thighs suffer; for these everything Vāta-removing is recommended (शस्यते).
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: In line 2, what does तेषाम् (of these, masculine plural) refer back to?
options: The eight things to give up (verse 41)
The ailments listed right before it
optionExplain: Those are neuter (भाष्यादीनि), and far back.
No physician is named in the verse.
The remedies are what is given, not 'these' who receive it.
Right: तेषाम् points back to the ailments listed right before it: the pains of verse 43 line 2 and the sinking of feet, shanks and thighs.
questions.explain: तेषाम् = for these (ailments): the …आदयः of line 1, masculine plural.
questions.rule: तेषाम् agrees with the masculine plural …आदयः.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Which two measures does line 2 name first among the Vāta-removing ones?
optionExplain: Right: स्नेह-स्वेद-आदि: oleation and sweating, and so on.
Smoke and fasting are the Kapha measures of verse 47.
Silence and a procedure come in verse 43.
Suppository and enema come in unit 51.
questions.explain: स्नेहस्वेदादि = beginning with oleation (स्नेह) and sweating (स्वेद).
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Like शस्यते (is recommended, passive of √शंस्), what does a new passive दीयते (of √दा) mean?
optionExplain: Gives would be ददाति (active).
Right: -यते marks the present passive: √दा → दीयते, is given.
Will give would be दास्यति (future).
Should give would be दद्यात् (optative).
questions.explain: Root + -यते (with ātmanepada endings) = is being done: शस्यते, दीयते.
questions.teaches: शस्यते is a present passive: 'is recommended'. Root + -य- + ātmanepada ending = is done.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does अजीर्णभोजन mean in this verse?
optionExplain: Too little would be अल्प; अजीर्ण = undigested.
Night is not named in the verse.
Right: अजीर्ण-भोजन = eating while the previous meal is undigested.
भोजन is eating, not fasting.
questions.explain: अजीर्णभोजनात् = from eating while undigested: the next cause.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Put these parts of the verse in its order.
questions.explain: Cause, ailments, then the procedure stated in the Mātrāśitīya, which is to be applied.
questions.rule: Cause → ailments → stated in → to be applied.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: The cause and two clear ailments of line 1, and the duty of line 2.
questions.rule: अजीर्ण = undigested; छर्दि = vomiting; ज्वर = fever; विधेय = to be applied.
questions.teaches: From eating while undigested: vomiting (छर्दि), fever (ज्वर) and so on; the procedure is to be applied (विधेय).
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: विधेयो stands before विधि-. What is its form before sandhi?
optionExplain: A final म् would stay म् or become ं, not ओ.
A final औ stays औ before a consonant such as व; it never becomes ओ.
A final ए stays ए before a consonant.
Right: -अः → -ओ before a voiced sound such as व.
questions.explain: विधेयः (to be applied, m. nom. sg.) agrees with विधिः.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: विधेयः is a gerundive. What does it say about the procedure?
options: That it is to be applied
That it is being applied now
optionExplain: Right: A gerundive (-य, -तव्य, -अनीय) means 'to be done'.
Already done would be a past participle such as विहितः.
Now would be a present form such as विधीयते.
Forbidden would need न; the verse has none.
questions.explain: तत्र मात्राशितीयोक्तो विधेयो विधिः: in that case the procedure stated in the Mātrāśitīya is to be applied.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Like मात्राशितीय + उक्तः → मात्राशितीयोक्तः, what does सूत्र + उक्तः give?
optionExplain: औ comes from अ + ओ or अ + औ, not अ + उ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: सूत्र + उक्तः → सूत्रोक्तः.
आ would come from अ + अ, not अ + उ.
व् comes from उ before a vowel, not from अ + उ.
questions.explain: अ/आ + उ/ऊ → ओ.
questions.teaches: अ + उ → ओ: मात्राशितीय + उक्तः → मात्राशितीयोक्तः (stated in the Mātrāśitīya).
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does अहितान्न mean?
optionExplain: Too much would be अति; अहित = unwholesome.
Undigested is अजीर्ण, the cause of verse 45.
Right: अहित = not wholesome; अन्न = food.
Dry food (रूक्ष अन्न) is a Kapha measure in verse 47.
questions.explain: अहितान्नात् = from unwholesome food: the next cause.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1: diseases according to the doṣa, and remedies. Line 2: declared earlier.
questions.rule: अहित = unwholesome; यथादोषम् = according to the doṣa; भेषज = remedy; प्रोक्त = declared; पुरा = earlier.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does यथादोषम् say about the diseases from unwholesome food?
optionExplain: No single doṣa is named; यथादोषम् = according to the doṣa.
रोगाः is plural and follows the doṣa.
The line adds भेषजानि च, and remedies.
Right: यथा-दोषम् = according to the doṣa.
questions.explain: अहितान्नाद्यथादोषं रोगाः स्युः: from unwholesome food, diseases according to the doṣa.
questions.teaches: From unwholesome food there may be diseases according to the doṣa, and remedies as well.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: The print has प्रोक्ता before दिवा-. What is its full form, agreeing with हलीमकादयः?
optionExplain: Right: -आः drops the visarga before a voiced sound such as द: प्रोक्ताः → प्रोक्ता.
Neuter singular would not agree with masculine plural हलीमकादयः.
-ए would not agree with masculine plural हलीमकादयः.
A dual would not agree with plural हलीमकादयः.
questions.explain: हलीमकादयः प्रोक्ताः ... गदाः: masculine nominative plural.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Put these words of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: From unwholesome food, according to the doṣa, diseases may be, and remedies.
questions.rule: अहितान्नात् · यथादोषम् · रोगाः · स्युः · भेषजानि च.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Like अ + हित = अहित (unwholesome), what does a new word अपथ्य mean, if पथ्य = suitable?
optionExplain: Very would be अति- or सु-, not अ-.
Right: अ- negates: अ-पथ्य = not suitable.
Again would be पुनः, not अ-.
Later would be पश्चात्, not अ-.
questions.explain: अ- (अन्- before a vowel) = not.
questions.teaches: The prefix अ- negates: अहित (unwholesome), अजीर्ण (undigested), अपथ्य (unsuitable).
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does व्यवाय mean in line 2?
optionExplain: Exercise is not named here; व्यवाय = sexual intercourse.
Walking about is the cause of verse 44.
Right: व्यवाय = sexual intercourse (मैथुन).
Loud speaking is the cause of verse 41.
questions.explain: व्यवायात् = from sexual intercourse: the next cause.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Put the Kapha measures of line 1 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: धूम-रूक्ष-अन्न-लङ्घनम्: smoke, dry food, fasting.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Line 1 prescribes smoke, dry food and fasting; line 2 speaks of Vāta (अनिल) ailments.
questions.rule: धूम = smoke; रूक्ष = dry; लङ्घन = fasting; विदध्यात् = should prescribe; अनिल = wind.
questions.teaches: For those overcome by Kapha one should prescribe (विदध्यात्) smoke, dry food and fasting.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Which split is right for अनिलामय in line 2?
optionExplain: मय is not 'ailment', and अ + म would give अनिलमय.
Neither अन् nor इलामय is the word here.
म् before a vowel would give अनिलमामय.
Right: अ + आ → आ: अनिल (wind) + आमय (ailment).
questions.explain: अनिल-आमयैः = by Vāta ailments.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: A patient is overcome by Kapha. Which set of measures does line 1 prescribe?
optionExplain: Right: धूम, रूक्ष अन्न, लङ्घन: all named in line 1.
Those are the Vāta measures of verse 44.
Those come in verse 49, not for Kapha.
Those belong to verses 42 and 43.
questions.explain: विदध्यात्कफजितेषु धूमरूक्षान्नलङ्घनम्.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Like विदध्यात् (he should prescribe, optative), what does दद्यात् mean?
optionExplain: Past would be अददात् or ददौ.
Right: -यात् marks the optative: दद्यात् = he should give.
Future would be दास्यति.
Present would be ददाति.
questions.explain: Optative 3rd singular in -यात् = should do: विदध्यात्, दद्यात्.
questions.teaches: विदध्यात् is an optative: 'one should prescribe'. The optative gives the rule of what to do.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does चेतना do, as it were, in line 1?
optionExplain: Torn off is said of the anus (गुद).
Entering darkness is said of the mind (मनः).
Right: भ्रमतीव चेतना = consciousness, as it were, whirls.
Smoking is said of the organ in line 2.
questions.explain: भ्रमति इव चेतना: consciousness reels, as it were.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Put these four sensations in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Anus, consciousness, the organ that smokes, then the mind entering darkness.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words name the parts and the sensations of the verse.
questions.rule: गुद = anus; चेतना = consciousness; मनः = mind; तमस् = darkness; धूमायति = smokes.
questions.teaches: The anus seems torn off, consciousness seems to whirl, the organ smokes, the mind seems to enter darkness.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Which split is right for भ्रमतीव?
optionExplain: व alone is not a word here; the particle is इव.
ईव is not a word; the particle is इव.
ए + इ would give भ्रमत इव or भ्रमतयिव, not ई.
Right: इ + इ → ई: भ्रमति + इव → भ्रमतीव.
questions.explain: भ्रमति (whirls) + इव (as if).
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does इव add to these sentences?
options: That it only seems so: as if
optionExplain: Right: इव = as if, as it were.
Again would be पुनः.
Slowly would be शनैः.
Certainty would be ध्रुवम्; इव marks likeness.
questions.explain: गुदोऽवलुप्यत इव, भ्रमतीव, तमसीव: each is 'as it were'.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Like भ्रमति + इव → भ्रमतीव, what does गच्छति + इव give?
optionExplain: इ → य् only before an unlike vowel; before इ it merges to ई.
Right: इ + इ → ई.
ए comes from अ + इ, not इ + इ.
ऐ comes from अ + ए, not इ + इ.
questions.explain: Like vowels merge into the long vowel: इ + इ → ई.
questions.teaches: Like vowels merge into one long vowel: भ्रमति + इव → भ्रमतीव; तमसि + इव → तमसीव.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What kind of food does line 2 name?
optionExplain: Dry food is a Kapha measure (verse 47).
Without salt is said of a child's nirūhaṇa (verse 55).
Right: आहारो बृंहणः = food that is bulking (बृंहण).
Fasting is not named in this verse.
questions.explain: आहारो बृंहणस्तत्र: in that case, bulking food.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: Milk and ghee, bulking food, virilising bastis.
questions.rule: क्षीर = milk; सर्पिस् = ghee; आहार = food; बृंहण = bulking; वृष्य = virilising.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Which bastis does line 2 name?
optionExplain: Salt-free is said of a child's nirūhaṇa (verse 55).
Kapha is not named in this verse.
Children come in verse 55.
Right: वृष्यास्ते च बस्तयः = and those virilising bastis.
questions.explain: वृष्य = promoting sexual vigour and semen.
questions.teaches: In that case: bulking food and virilising (वृष्य) bastis.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Which split is right for वृष्यास्ते?
optionExplain: Right: Visarga → स् before त: वृष्याः + ते → वृष्यास्ते.
स्ते is not a word; the word is ते (those).
A final म् does not turn into स्.
त् + त would give त्त: वृष्यात्ते.
questions.explain: वृष्याः (virilising, m. nom. pl.) + ते (those), with बस्तयः.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Put these parts of line 2 in the order of the verse.
questions.explain: Food, bulking, in that case; virilising, those, and bastis.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: Like क्षीरसर्पिषोः (of milk and ghee, dual -ओः), what does a new form मधुघृतयोः mean?
optionExplain: With would be the instrumental -आभ्याम्.
Right: -ओः of a two-member dvandva: of the two, honey and ghee.
A subject would be nominative मधुघृते.
From would be the ablative -आभ्याम्.
questions.explain: -ओः is the genitive (and locative) dual: of the two.
questions.teaches: क्षीरसर्पिषोः is a genitive dual: 'of milk and ghee', the two together.
questions.section: आठ परिहार्य: उच्च भाषण से मैथुन तक

questions.q: What does सदाऽऽतुराः mean?
optionExplain: आतुर means ailing, not healthy.
सदा means at all times, not now and then.
Right: सदा = at all times; आतुराः = ailing.
Nothing about a cure is said here.
questions.explain: ये सदाऽऽतुराः = those who are ever ailing.
questions.rule: सदा = at all times; आतुर = ailing.

questions.q: Put these parts of the verse in its order.
questions.explain: Because of holding back urges and upward wind, stated earlier, those ever ailing; of them, when the wind is obstructed.
questions.rule: वेगरोध... · प्रागुक्ता · ये सदाऽऽतुराः · तेषाम् · विबद्धे पवने.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: The cause (holding back urges, upward Vāta) and the condition (obstructed wind).
questions.rule: वेग = urge; रोध = holding back; ऊर्ध्व = upward; पवन = wind; विबद्ध = obstructed.
questions.teaches: The ever ailing suffer from holding back urges and upward Vāta; treatment is for obstructed wind.

questions.q: Which split is right for प्रागुक्ता?
optionExplain: Neither प्रा nor गुक्ताः is a word here.
उ + उ would give ऊ: प्रागूक्ताः.
अ + उ would give ओ: प्रागोक्ताः.
Right: क् → ग् before a vowel; the visarga of -आः drops before a voiced sound (here य of ये).
questions.explain: प्राक् (earlier) + उक्ताः (stated).
questions.rule: Final क् → ग् before a vowel.

questions.q: In which condition (locative) is the treatment for these patients given?
optionExplain: Right: विबद्धे पवने = when the wind is obstructed (locative).
Kapha is not named in this verse.
Digestive fire is not named here.
Loose bowels are not named here.
questions.explain: तेषां विबद्धे पवने: of them, when the wind is obstructed.
questions.rule: विबद्धे पवने = when the wind is obstructed.

questions.q: Like विबद्धे पवने (when the wind is obstructed), what does a new phrase शान्ते ज्वरे mean?
optionExplain: For would need the dative.
Right: Noun and participle both in the locative: when ... (locative absolute).
From would need the ablative.
शान्त is the state of the fever, not what it brings.
questions.explain: Locative absolute: noun + participle in the locative = when X is Y.
questions.teaches: Noun and participle together in the locative give the condition: विबद्धे पवने = when the wind is obstructed.

questions.q: What is a फलवर्ति?
optionExplain: वर्ति is a wick, not a drink.
Oil massage is अभ्यङ्ग.
Right: फल-वर्ति, lit. fruit-wick: a medicated suppository.
Nasal medication is नस्य.
questions.explain: फलवर्ति = suppository (standard term).

questions.q: Put these words of unit 51 in their order.
questions.explain: Suppository first one should give, then a basti that brings strength.
questions.rule: फलवर्ति · पुरा · दद्यात् · अथ · बस्तिम् · बलावहम्.

questions.q: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explain: पुरा ... अथ: first ... then.
questions.rule: पुरा = first; अथ = then; दद्यात् = should give; बलावह = bringing strength.
questions.teaches: First (पुरा) a suppository, then (अथ) a strength-bringing basti.

questions.q: Which split is right for दद्यादथ?
optionExplain: दथ is not a word; the word is अथ (then).
अ + अ → आ would give दद्याताथ.
Visarga after आ drops before a vowel: दद्या अथ.
Right: त् → द् before a vowel.
questions.explain: दद्यात् (should give) + अथ (then).
questions.rule: Final त् → द् before a vowel.

questions.q: Which item does बलावहम् (masculine accusative) describe?
optionExplain: Right: बस्तिम् is masculine accusative, like बलावहम्.
वर्ति is feminine; बलावहम् does not agree with it.
The patient is in the genitive (तेषाम्, unit 50).
The wind is in the locative (पवने, unit 50).
questions.explain: बस्तिं बलावहम् = a basti that brings strength.
questions.rule: An adjective agrees in gender, case and number.

questions.q: Like बल + आवह → बलावह (bringing strength), what does सुख + आवह give?
optionExplain: ओ comes from अ + उ, not अ + आ.
Right: अ + आ → आ.
ए comes from अ + इ, not अ + आ.
The long vowel stays before व, not after it: सुख + आवह → सुखावह.
questions.explain: अ + आ → आ.
questions.teaches: अ + आ → आ: बल + आवह → बलावह (bringing strength).

questions.q: What is उरुबूक, according to the card?
optionExplain: Leadwort is the probable sense of अग्नि.
Deodar is the probable sense of दारु.
Right: उरुबूक = castor, Ricinus communis: a standard identification.
Spreading hogweed is पुनर्नव.
questions.explain: उरुबूक = castor (standard).

questions.q: Put these drugs in the order of the list.
questions.explain: निकुम्भ, कुम्भ, अग्नि, उरुबूक, धावनी, पुनर्नव, दारु, महत् पञ्चक.

questions.q: Match each drug to the identification the card gives.
questions.explain: The card keeps each identification with its confidence word.
questions.rule: उरुबूक = castor; पुनर्नव = spreading hogweed; अग्नि = probably leadwort; दारु = probably deodar; कुम्भ = unidentified.
questions.teaches: The list: nikumbha, kumbha, agni (probably leadwort), urubūka (castor), dhāvanī, punarnava, dāru (probably deodar).

questions.q: Which split is right for कुम्भाग्न्युरुबूक?
optionExplain: Neither कुम्भाग् nor नि is a word here.
अग्नु and रुबूक are not words.
A visarga after इ before a vowel would give अग्निरुरुबूक.
Right: अ + अ → आ; इ + उ → य् + उ.
questions.explain: कुम्भ, अग्नि, उरुबूक: three members of the list.
questions.rule: अ + अ → आ; इ + unlike vowel → य्.

questions.q: Which items does line 2 add to the list?
optionExplain: Right: फलं च.
Honey is not named in this verse.
Right: ghee together with oil.
Right: five salts.
Milk is in verse 49, not here.
questions.explain: Line 2: फलं च ... घृतं सतैलं लवणानि पञ्च.
questions.rule: Line 2: fruit, ghee with oil, five salts.

questions.q: Like पञ्चक (a group of five, from पञ्च), what does a new word अष्टक mean?
optionExplain: Right: -क after a number makes a group: अष्टक = a set of eight.
The eighth would be अष्टम.
Eight times would be अष्टकृत्वः.
