questions.q: Join by the rule of उपयोगात् + च = उपयोगाच्च: कल्कात् + च (and from kalka). Which is right?
optionExplain: Right: A final त् before च becomes च्: उपयोगात् + च = उपयोगाच्च.
द् comes before a voiced sound or a vowel; च is unvoiced.
श्च comes from a visarga + च, not from त् + च.
In close sandhi त् does not stay before च.
questions.explain: Same rule as उपयोगाच्च.
questions.teaches: A final त् before च becomes च्: उपयोगात् + च = उपयोगाच्च; कल्कात् + च = कल्काच्च.

questions.q: What does unit 32 equate with niryūha?
optionExplain: Svarasa is the niryāsa of unit 28.
Right: क्वाथो निर्यूहः: kvātha is niryūha.
The powder is unit 30, compared with kalka.
Phāṇṭa is defined in line 05.08.43.
questions.explain: क्वाथ = निर्यूह.

questions.q: Match each name to its definition in units 28 to 32.
questions.explain: Units 28 to 32 define the forms one by one.

questions.q: Unit 32: क्वाथो ____ (the other name of the decoction). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: क्वाथो निर्यूहः: kvātha is niryūha.
questions.teaches: Kvātha (decoction) is another name for niryūha, the third of the five forms.

questions.q: Which is the right split of क्वाथो निर्यूहः?
optionExplain: That would print क्वाथं निर्यूहः.
A dual in -औ would stay क्वाथौ in print.
Right: अः before a voiced sound such as न becomes ओ.
A locative क्वाथे would stay क्वाथे in print.
questions.explain: क्वाथः (decoction) + निर्यूहः.

questions.q: A later recipe says: make a क्वाथ. Which of the five forms of verse 26 is meant, by unit 32?
optionExplain: Niryāsa is the svarasa, pressed juice.
Kalka is the ground paste.
Śīta is the cold soaked form.
Right: Unit 32: kvātha is niryūha, the third form.
questions.explain: क्वाथ → निर्यूह.

questions.q: Join by the rule of क्वाथो निर्यूहः: रसः + मधुरः (the taste is sweet). Which is right?
optionExplain: Right: अः before a voiced sound (म) becomes ओ, as in क्वाथो निर्यूहः.
स् comes before त / थ, not before म.
श् comes before च / छ, not before म.
आ with a dropped visarga belongs to -आः, not to -अः.
questions.explain: Same rule as क्वाथो.
questions.teaches: अः before a voiced consonant becomes ओ: क्वाथः + निर्यूहः = क्वाथो निर्यूहः; रसः + मधुरः = रसो मधुरः.

questions.q: Which pot does unit 33 allow for the niryūha?
options: Only a pot made of gold, kept clean
Any one of copper, iron or clay
Only a pot made of stone
A wooden bowl kept by the fire
optionExplain: Gold is not named in the unit.
Right: ताम्र-अयः-मृन्मय-अन्यतम-स्थाल्याम्: in a pot of any one of copper, iron or clay.
Stone is the grinding means of kalka, unit 29.
Wood is not named among the pot materials.
questions.explain: ताम्र = copper; अयस् = iron; मृन्मय = earthen.

questions.q: Match each word for the pot in unit 33 to its meaning.
questions.explain: शुचौ … ताम्रायोमृन्मयान्यतमस्थाल्याम्: in a clean pot of any one of copper, iron or clay.

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 33 in the order of the text.
items: split finely those to be split
questions.explain: भेदयित्वा → छेदयित्वा → प्रक्षाल्य उदकेन → समावाप्य → उदकम् आसेचयेत्.
questions.rule: Split · cut · wash · put in · pour water.
questions.teaches: For niryūha the medicines are split, cut, washed, put into the pot, and then water is poured in.

questions.q: Which is the right split of प्रक्षाल्योदकेन?
optionExplain: दकेन is not a word; the ओ comes from अ + उ.
That would print प्रक्षाल्यमुदकेन.
Right: अ + उ becomes ओ: प्रक्षाल्य + उदकेन = प्रक्षाल्योदकेन.
अः + उ drops the visarga: प्रक्षाल्य उदकेन, two words.
questions.explain: प्रक्षाल्य (having washed) + उदकेन (with water).

questions.q: A physician readies the pot for niryūha. Which does unit 33 require of the pot?
options: It has a lid on it
optionExplain: Wrong: only copper, iron or clay are named.
Wrong: no lid is named.
Right: शुचौ, in a clean (pot).
Right: अधःप्रलिप्तायाम्, smeared on the underside.
Wrong: newness is not stated.
questions.explain: शुचौ … अधःप्रलिप्तायाम् … स्थाल्याम्: in a clean pot smeared below.
questions.rule: Pot: clean, smeared below; copper, iron or clay.

questions.q: भेदयित्वा has no prefix and takes -त्वा; प्रक्षाल्य has a prefix and takes -य. Which means having brought (आ + √नी)?
optionExplain: -त्वा is used without a prefix; आ is a prefix.
नीत्वा has no prefix: having led, not having brought.
A prefixed verb does not take -त्वा.
Right: With a prefix the absolutive takes -य: आ + नी → आनीय, like प्र + क्षाल् → प्रक्षाल्य.
questions.explain: Prefix → -य; no prefix → -त्वा.
questions.teaches: The absolutive takes -त्वा without a prefix (भेदयित्वा) and -य with one (प्रक्षाल्य, समावाप्य, आनीय).

questions.q: What fire does unit 34 ask for?
options: A gentle fire reaching all around
A strong fire kept under one spot only
No fire, only the hot sun
A fire of cow-dung cakes only
optionExplain: Right: मृदुना … परितः समुपगच्छता अनलेन: with a gentle fire reaching all around.
मृदु is gentle, and परितः is all around.
अग्नौ, अनलेन: a fire is named twice.
No fuel is named in the unit.
questions.explain: मृदु = gentle; परितः = all around; अनल = fire.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 34 to its meaning.
questions.explain: दर्व्या च विघट्टयन् मृदुना … अनलेन: stirring with a ladle, with a gentle fire.
questions.rule: दर्वी = ladle; अनल = fire; मृदु = gentle; विघट्टयन् = stirring.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 34 in the order of the text.
items: seated comfortably on a large seat
he should prepare it with a gentle fire
questions.explain: अधिश्रित्य → सुखोपविष्टः → सततम् अवलोकयन् → दर्व्या विघट्टयन् → मृदुना अनलेन साधयेत्.
questions.rule: Place · sit · watch · stir · cook gently.
questions.teaches: Cooking the niryūha: on the fire, the maker sits comfortably, watches constantly, stirs with a ladle and cooks with a gentle fire.

questions.q: Which is the right split of अथाग्नावधिश्रित्य?
optionExplain: वधिश्रित्य is not a word; the व् comes from औ.
Right: अ + अ → आ (अथाग्नौ); औ before a vowel → आव् (अग्नावधिश्रित्य).
इ + अ would give अग्न्यधिश्रित्य, with य्.
Neither अथा nor ग्नौ is the word here; अथ = then, अग्नौ = on the fire.
questions.explain: अथ (then) + अग्नौ (on the fire) + अधिश्रित्य (having placed).
questions.rule: औ + vowel → आव्; अ + अ → आ.

questions.q: A maker sits comfortably and stirs the pot on a gentle fire, but keeps looking away. Which instruction of unit 34 does he break?
optionExplain: He does sit comfortably, so this is kept.
He does stir the pot, so this is kept.
Right: Unit 34: he should watch constantly from all sides.
He uses a gentle fire, so this is kept.
questions.explain: Constant watching: सततम् अवलोकयन्.

questions.q: Join by the rule of अग्नौ + अधिश्रित्य = अग्नावधिश्रित्य: तौ + अपि (those two also). Which is right?
optionExplain: ओ would come from अ + उ or अः, not from औ.
In close sandhi औ does not stay before a vowel.
अय् comes from ए before a vowel, not from औ.
Right: औ before a vowel becomes आव्, as in अग्नौ + अधि- = अग्नावधि-.
questions.explain: Same rule as अग्नावधिश्रित्य.
questions.teaches: औ before a vowel becomes आव्: अग्नौ + अधिश्रित्य = अग्नावधिश्रित्य; तौ + अपि = तावपि.

questions.q: What is the first step of unit 35?
options: Taking it down from the fire
Putting it back into the pot
optionExplain: Right: अवतार्य = having taken (it) down.
The unit begins with taking down, not putting in.
No water is added in unit 35.
Grinding makes kalka, unit 29.
questions.explain: अवतार्य = having taken down.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 35 to its meaning.
questions.explain: अवतार्य च सुपरिस्रुतं यथार्हस्पर्शं प्रयुञ्जीत.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 35 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: Take down, well strained, of fitting touch, use.
questions.teaches: After cooking: take it down, strain it well, and use it, of fitting touch (यथार्हस्पर्शम्).

questions.q: Which is the right split of यथार्ह-?
optionExplain: Neither यथ nor आर्ह is the word; यथा = as.
Right: आ + अ becomes आ: यथा + अर्ह = यथार्ह, as is fitting.
रह is not the word; अर्ह = fitting.
यथा is an indeclinable with no visarga.
questions.explain: यथा (as) + अर्ह (fitting).

questions.q: The decoction is taken down but used with the herb pieces still in it. Which word of unit 35 is missed?
optionExplain: It was taken down, so this step was done.
It was used, so this step was done.
Right: The unit asks that it be well strained before use.
Cooking is line 05.08.39, and it was done.
questions.explain: Strain well before use: सुपरिस्रुत.

questions.q: सु- in सुपरिस्रुतम् means well. What does a new phrase सुपिष्टः कल्कः mean?
optionExplain: Badly would be दुः- / दुष्-, not सु-.
Not ground would be अपिष्ट.
Strained is परिस्रुत; पिष्ट is ground.
Right: सु- = well; पिष्ट = ground (unit 29); कल्क = paste.
questions.explain: सु- + participle = well (done).
questions.teaches: The prefix सु- means well: सुपरिस्रुत = well strained; सुपिष्ट = well ground.

questions.q: What does unit 36 say happens to a substance cooked with milk and the like?
options: Its rasa is not fully released
It turns sour if kept overnight
optionExplain: Right: न सम्यक् मुक्त-रसं भवति: it does not become one whose rasa is fully released.
Nothing about turning sour is said.
Strength is not the point; the release of rasa is.
It is still used, after a water decoction first.
questions.explain: With milk, rasa is not fully released.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 36 to its meaning.
questions.explain: वारि-क्वाथ-पूर्वकम् … क्षीराद्यैः: preceded by a water decoction, with milk and the like.
questions.rule: क्षीर = milk; वारि = water; क्वाथ = decoction; पूर्वक = preceded by.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 36 in the order of the text.
items: with milk and the like the rasa is not fully released
then with milk and the like (क्षीराद्यैः)
questions.explain: Reason · इति · वारिक्वाथपूर्वकम् · क्षीराद्यैः … काथयेत्.
questions.rule: Reason · so · water first · then milk.
questions.teaches: Unit 36: because with milk and the like the rasa is not fully released, a water decoction comes first (वारिक्वाथपूर्वकम्), then milk and the like (क्षीराद्यैः).

questions.q: What does इति after भवति mark in unit 36, by the card?
options: The end of the whole chapter
The reason for the next step
A question put to the student
optionExplain: The chapter goes on; इति here closes a reason.
Right: The note: the first half gives the reason (इति, thus); then the instruction follows.
No teacher is named in the unit.
The line asks nothing; it states a reason.
questions.explain: … भवति इति: 'it does not become …', thus (so) ….

questions.q: A medicine is to be prepared with milk and the like. What does unit 36 have done first?
optionExplain: Overnight soaking is for śīta, line 05.08.42.
Grinding makes kalka, unit 29.
Right: वारि-क्वाथ-पूर्वकम्: preceded by a decoction in water.
Pressing makes the juice, unit 28.
questions.explain: Water decoction first, then milk.

questions.q: Join by the rule of भवति + इति = भवतीति: अस्ति + इति (it is, thus). Which is right?
optionExplain: य् comes before a different vowel; here इ meets इ.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from इ + इ.
Two इ join into a long ई, not a short इ.
Right: इ + इ becomes ई, as in भवति + इति = भवतीति.
questions.explain: Same rule as भवतीति.
questions.teaches: Two like vowels join into the long one: भवति + इति = भवतीति; अस्ति + इति = अस्तीति.

questions.q: In what water is śīta soaked, by verse 37?
optionExplain: Right: शीत-सलिल-आप्लुतम्: soaked in cold water.
Hot water (उष्णाम्भसि) is for phāṇṭa.
Milk is in line 05.08.41, not in śīta.
सलिल is water; it is soaked.
questions.explain: शीत-सलिल = cold water.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 37 to its meaning.
questions.explain: शीतसलिलाप्लुतं … निशापर्युषितं पूतं शीतः; उष्णाम्भसि … फाण्टः.

questions.q: Put the steps of making śīta in the order of verse 37.
questions.explain: शीतसलिलाप्लुतम् → निशापर्युषितम् → पूतम् → शीतः.
questions.teaches: Śīta is made by soaking the medicine in cold water, keeping it overnight and straining it.

questions.q: Which is the right split of उष्णांभसि?
optionExplain: म्भसि is not a word; अम्भस् = water.
Right: अ + अ becomes आ: उष्ण + अम्भसि = उष्णाम्भसि, in hot water.
That would print उष्णं भसि; भसि is not water.
उष्णाम् is not the word here, and भसि is not water.
questions.explain: उष्ण (hot) + अम्भसि (in water).

questions.q: A medicine is put into hot water and strained, not kept overnight. Which form of verse 37 is it?
optionExplain: Śīta needs cold water and a night.
Niryāsa is the pressed juice, unit 28.
Right: उष्णाम्भसि … पूतं फाण्टः: made in hot water and strained = phāṇṭa.
Kalka is the ground paste, unit 29.
questions.explain: Hot water = phāṇṭa; cold water overnight = śīta.

questions.q: Join by the rule of उष्ण + अम्भसि: शीत + अम्भसि (in cold water). Which is right?
optionExplain: Two अ join into a long आ, not a short अ.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + अ.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + अ.
Right: अ + अ becomes आ, as in उष्ण + अम्भसि = उष्णाम्भसि.
questions.explain: Same rule as उष्णाम्भसि.
questions.teaches: अ + अ joins into आ: उष्ण + अम्भसि = उष्णाम्भसि; शीत + अम्भसि = शीताम्भसि.

questions.q: In unit 38, what does मात्रा mean?
optionExplain: Right: मात्राम् (f. acc. sg.) = the dose, the object of संश्रयेत्.
Taste is रस, also named in the unit.
Potency is वीर्य, a separate word of the unit.
Disease is व्याधि, whose strength is weighed.
questions.explain: मात्रां च संश्रयेत्: and he should resort to the dose.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 38 to its meaning.
questions.explain: रसवीर्यादीनि औषधस्य: the medicine's taste, potency and so on; व्याधि-आतुर-आदि-बलतः: by the strength of disease, patient and so on.
questions.rule: रस = taste; वीर्य = potency; व्याधि = disease; आतुर = patient.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 38 in the order of the text.
items: Examine the medicine's rasa, vīrya and so on
Go by the strength of disease, patient and so on
questions.explain: First the medicine is examined, then the strength of disease and patient is weighed, then the dose is chosen.
questions.rule: Medicine → strength of disease and patient → dose.
questions.teaches: Unit 38: examine the medicine's rasa and vīrya, weigh the strength of disease and patient, then resort to the dose.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Whose rasa and vīrya are to be examined, by unit 38?
optionExplain: The patient (आतुर) is weighed for strength, not for rasa and vīrya.
Right: औषधस्य (gen. sg.) = of the medicine: its rasa, vīrya and so on.
No season is named in this unit.
The physician does the examining; nothing of his is examined.
questions.explain: रसवीर्यादीनि औषधस्य समीक्ष्य: having examined the medicine's taste, potency and so on.
questions.rule: Rasa and vīrya belong to the medicine (औषधस्य).
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Two patients need the same drug; one is strong, one weak. What does unit 38 tell the physician to do?
options: Give both the same fixed dose
Let each patient pick the form he likes best
Set the dose by each one's strength
Choose by the drug's colour only
optionExplain: Unit 38 ties the dose to the strength of disease and patient.
The choice rests on examination, not on liking.
Right: The dose is chosen by the strength (बलतः) of disease, patient and so on.
Colour is not named; rasa, vīrya and strength are.
questions.explain: व्याध्यातुरादिबलतः … मात्रां संश्रयेत्: the dose follows the strength of disease and patient.
questions.rule: Dose by examination and strength, not by a fixed figure.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Which sentence says 'having examined the patient, he should resort to the dose', built like unit 38?
optionExplain: आतुरः is nominative: the patient would be the one examining.
समीक्षते is a finite verb 'examines'; two finite verbs, no 'having'.
मात्रा is nominative; the object of संश्रयेत् must be मात्राम्.
Right: आतुरम् is the object (acc.), समीक्ष्य the absolutive 'having examined', मात्राम् the object of संश्रयेत्.
questions.explain: Object in the accusative + absolutive in -य + main verb, as in रसवीर्यादीनि … समीक्ष्य … मात्रां संश्रयेत्.
questions.rule: With a prefix (सम्-), the absolutive ends in -य: समीक्ष्य = having examined.
questions.teaches: A prefixed root forms the absolutive in -य (सम्-ईक्ष् → समीक्ष्य, 'having examined'); its object stands in the accusative.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: In unit 39, what does केचित् mean?
optionExplain: Right: केचित् = some (m. nom. pl.): an unnamed group.
All would be सर्वे; केचित् is only some.
The author is not meant: केचित् points to other unnamed people.
केचित् is positive: some people say it.
questions.explain: केचिदाहुः: some say.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 39 to its meaning.
questions.explain: तथा च केचिदाहुः: and thus some say.
questions.rule: तथा = thus; च = and; केचित् = some; आहुः = they say.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Put the words of unit 39 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: तथाच केचिदाहुः = तथा च केचित् आहुः.
questions.teaches: Unit 39 runs: तथा च केचित् आहुः, 'and thus some say'.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Which is the right split of केचिदाहुः in unit 39?
optionExplain: Neither केचि nor दाहुः is a word here.
Right: A final त् before a vowel becomes द्: केचित् + आहुः = केचिदाहुः.
That would print केचिद्दाहुः, with a doubled द्.
हुः is not a word; the verb is आहुः.
questions.explain: केचित् (some) + आहुः (they say).
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Unit 39 says 'some say'. What comes next in the text, by the card?
options: The colophon that closes this chapter
A list of the five medicines to be gathered
The author's rule for storing oil in a jar
optionExplain: The chapter goes on; no colophon follows here.
The five forms were defined earlier; a saying follows.
Right: The card: the line introduces the quotation in lines 05.08.46 and 05.08.47.
Storing comes much later (line 05.08.65).
questions.explain: तथा च केचिदाहुः introduces a quotation on dose.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Join a new pair the same way as केचित् + आहुः: एतत् + आहुः (they say this). Which is right?
optionExplain: The त् does not stay unvoiced before a vowel.
च्च comes from त् + च; here a vowel follows.
त् becomes न् only before a nasal; आ is not a nasal.
Right: A final त् before a vowel becomes द्, as in केचिदाहुः.
questions.explain: Same rule as केचिदाहुः.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a vowel: केचित् + आहुः = केचिदाहुः; एतत् + आहुः = एतदाहुः.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: In verse 40, what does वयः mean?
optionExplain: Right: वयः (n. acc. sg. of वयस्) = age.
Body is देह, named first.
Strength is बल, named just before वयः.
Time is काल, in देशकालौ.
questions.explain: देहं दोषं बलं वयः: body, doṣa, strength, age.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Match each word of verse 40 to its meaning.
questions.explain: देहं दोषं बलं वयः … देशकालौ: body, doṣa, strength, age, place and time.
questions.rule: देह = body; बल = strength; वयस् = age; देश = place; काल = time.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Put the things to be considered in verse 40 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: देहं दोषं बलं वयः आलोच्य देशकालौ च.
questions.teaches: Verse 40 lists body, doṣa, strength, age, then place and time, to be considered (आलोच्य) before giving medicine.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Which is the right split of भैषज्यमवचारयेत् in verse 40?
optionExplain: भैषज्यमव is not a word; the object is भैषज्यम्.
Right: A final म् before a vowel is written joined to it: भैषज्यम् + अवचारयेत् = भैषज्यमवचारयेत्.
मवचारयेत् is not a verb; the म् ends भैषज्यम्.
That drops the अ of the prefix अव-; वचारयेत् is not a verb.
questions.explain: भैषज्यम् (the medicine) + अवचारयेत् (he should administer).
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel: written together, no change.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: An old, weak patient lives in a hot land in summer. By verse 40, what must the physician weigh before giving medicine?
options: Only the season, as the verse names nothing else
Only his age, since age is named first of all
Body, doṣa, strength, age, place and time
Only the place, and not his body or age
optionExplain: Time is one of six; body, doṣa, strength, age and place are named too.
Age is fourth in the list and one of six.
Right: Verse 40 names all six to be considered (आलोच्य).
Body and age are named; place is one of six.
questions.explain: आलोच्य: all six are weighed together.
questions.rule: Body, doṣa, strength, age, place, time: consider all.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: देश + काल gives the dual देशकालौ (place and time). Which dual form says 'the disease (व्याधि) and the patient (आतुर)'?
optionExplain: -अः is singular; two things need the dual.
-आः is the plural, for more than two.
-एण is the instrumental singular, 'by'.
Right: Two masculine nouns in a dvandva take the dual -औ: व्याधि + आतुर → व्याध्यातुरौ (इ + आ → या).
questions.explain: Same pattern as देशकालौ.
questions.rule: Dvandva of two masculine nouns → dual in -औ.
questions.teaches: A dvandva of two masculine nouns takes the dual in -औ: देश + काल → देशकालौ; व्याधि + आतुर → व्याध्यातुरौ.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: In unit 41, what does अलम् mean?
optionExplain: Right: अलम् (ind.) = enough.
Again is पुनः, which comes in unit 46.
Also is अपि, which comes in unit 51.
Always would be सदा; अलम् is enough.
questions.explain: इत्यलम्: thus, enough.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Which is the right split of इत्यलं in unit 41?
optionExplain: इत्य is not a word; the य् comes from the इ of इति.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: इति + अलम् = इत्यलम्.
यलम् is not a word; the य् is from sandhi.
Neither इत् nor यलम् is a word here.
questions.explain: इति (thus) + अलम् (enough).
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Unit 41 reads इति ____ (enough). Type the word in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: इत्यलम् = इति + अलम्.
questions.teaches: अलम् = enough; it closes a discussion.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Which are true of unit 41, by the card?
optionExplain: Wrong: no medicine is named.
Right: इत्यलम् = इति + अलम्.
Wrong: the unit gives no figure or rule.
Right: the card glosses अलम् as enough.
questions.explain: इत्यलम्: thus, enough. No dose, no drug.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: A speaker closes a quotation with the word for thus. Which word of unit 41 does that job?
optionExplain: अलम् means enough, not thus.
च (and) is not in unit 41.
Right: इति = thus; it marks the close of what was said.
पुनः (again) is not in unit 41.
questions.explain: इत्यलम् = इति (thus) + अलम् (enough).
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Join इति + अपि (thus also) by the same rule as इति + अलम्. Which is right?
optionExplain: ई would come from इ + इ, not इ + अ.
ए comes from अ + इ, not इ + अ.
The इ does not stay beside य्; it becomes य् itself.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: इति + अपि = इत्यपि.
questions.explain: Same rule as इत्यलम्.
questions.teaches: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: इति + अलम् = इत्यलम्; इति + अपि = इत्यपि.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: In verse 42, what does भिषजः mean?
optionExplain: Right: भिषजः (m. nom. pl.) = physicians.
Medicine is भैषज्य or भेषज, not भिषज्.
No students are named; भिषज् is a physician.
A patient is आतुर, not भिषज्.
questions.explain: सर्वे भिषजः: all physicians.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Match each word of verse 42 to its meaning.
questions.explain: तदेवमुपदिष्टं बुद्धिमतां …; यथा तु सर्वे भिषजो विज्ञास्यन्ति.
questions.rule: उपदिष्ट = taught; बुद्धिमताम् = of the intelligent; सर्वे = all; विज्ञास्यन्ति = they will understand.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Put the phrases of verse 42 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: तदेवमुपदिष्टं बुद्धिमतां ज्ञानप्रबोधाय । यथा तु सर्वे भिषजो विज्ञास्यन्ति तथोपदेक्ष्यते ॥
questions.rule: Taught thus · for the intelligent · as all physicians will understand · so it will be taught.
questions.teaches: Verse 42 moves from what was taught for the intelligent to what will be taught so that all physicians understand.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: What tense is विज्ञास्यन्ति in verse 42, by its grammar label?
optionExplain: The present would be विजानन्ति; -स्य- marks the future.
Right: The label: 3 pl. future of वि-√ज्ञा.
No past ending; -स्यन्ति is future.
The optative would end in -ईयुः or -एयुः, not -स्यन्ति.
questions.explain: विज्ञास्यन्ति = they will understand.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: By verse 42, how is the coming teaching meant, compared with what was taught?
options: Only for the most intelligent physicians
For patients rather than for physicians
As a secret kept from most physicians
optionExplain: The earlier teaching was for the intelligent; the coming one is for all.
Patients are not named; all physicians are.
Right: यथा तु सर्वे भिषजो विज्ञास्यन्ति तथोपदेक्ष्यते: so that all physicians will understand.
The verse says the opposite: all physicians are to understand.
questions.explain: Taught before for the intelligent; to be taught now for all physicians.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Join यथा + उक्तम् (as said) by the same rule as तथा + उपदेक्ष्यते. Which is right?
optionExplain: औ comes from आ + ओ or औ, not आ + उ.
The आ cannot simply vanish; it merges into ओ.
The उ cannot vanish; आ + उ gives ओ.
Right: आ + उ → ओ: यथा + उक्तम् = यथोक्तम्, as तथा + उपदेक्ष्यते = तथोपदेक्ष्यते.
questions.explain: Same rule as तथोपदेक्ष्यते.
questions.teaches: आ before उ merges into ओ: तथा + उपदेक्ष्यते = तथोपदेक्ष्यते; यथा + उक्तम् = यथोक्तम्.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: In verse 43, what does मध्यमा मात्रा mean?
optionExplain: Right: मध्यमा = middle; मात्रा = dose.
Largest would be उत्तमा or अधिका; मध्यमा is middle.
Smallest would be हीना; मध्यमा is middle.
Nothing in मध्यमा refers to a day.
questions.explain: निर्यासस्य मध्यमा मात्रा: the middle dose of niryāsa.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Match each word of verse 43 to its meaning.
questions.explain: निर्यास, कल्क and चूर्ण are three preparations; आलोडन is stirring up or mixing.
questions.rule: निर्यास = juice; कल्क = paste; चूर्ण = powder; आलोडन = stirring.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Put the words of the second line of verse 43 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: कल्कचूर्णयोः कर्षः पलत्रयं तदालोडने: of kalka and cūrṇa a karṣa; three palas in stirring it.
questions.teaches: Verse 43, line 2: kalka and cūrṇa take a karṣa; the stirring takes three palas.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: By verse 43, what dose is given for kalka and cūrṇa?
optionExplain: Three palas are for the stirring (आलोडने), not the dose of the paste.
Right: कल्कचूर्णयोः कर्षः: of kalka and cūrṇa, a karṣa.
Half a prastha of water is for the decoction, in unit 44.
No quarter pala is named in verse 43.
questions.explain: Kalka and cūrṇa: a karṣa; stirring: three palas.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: A physician is about to stir up a karṣa of powder. What amount does verse 43 give for the stirring?
options: One karṣa, the same as the powder
Half a prastha of water, as in a decoction
Three palas, of what is not stated
A sixth part of the powder's weight
optionExplain: The karṣa is the dose of the powder itself.
That measure belongs to the decoction of unit 44.
Right: पलत्रयं तदालोडने: three palas in stirring it; the text does not name the liquid.
No sixth part is named in verse 43.
questions.explain: पलत्रयम् = three palas, for the stirring.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: कल्कचूर्णयोः is genitive dual: of kalka and cūrṇa. Which form means of ghee and oil (घृत, तैल)?
optionExplain: -आनाम् is genitive plural, for more than two.
-ए is the nominative or accusative dual of a neuter, not genitive.
-स्य is genitive singular, for one thing.
Right: A dvandva of two takes the dual; the genitive dual ends in -योः.
questions.explain: Same ending as कल्कचूर्णयोः.
questions.teaches: The genitive dual of an -अ stem ends in -योः: कल्कचूर्णयोः, घृततैलयोः.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: In unit 44, how much drug goes into the niryūha?
optionExplain: Right: भेषजपलम्: a pala of the drug.
A karṣa is the dose of kalka and cūrṇa in verse 43.
Half a prastha is the water, not the drug.
No tulā is named in unit 44.
questions.explain: निर्यूहे भेषजपलम्: in the decoction, a pala of the drug.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Put the steps of the niryūha in unit 44 in the order of the text.
items: A pala of drug in half a prastha of water
questions.explain: भेषजपलमुदकार्धप्रस्थेऽधिश्रित्य पादशेषितमवतारयेत्.
questions.rule: Drug and water → on the fire → a quarter left → taken down.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 44 to its meaning.
questions.explain: निर्यूहे … अधिश्रित्य पादशेषितमवतारयेत्.
questions.rule: अधि-√श्रि = put on the fire; पाद = quarter; अव-√तॄ (caus.) = take down.
questions.teaches: Unit 44's decoction words: अधिश्रित्य (put on the fire), पादशेषित (a quarter left), अवतारयेत् (take down).
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: When is the niryūha taken down, by unit 44?
options: When half of the water remains
When a quarter of it remains
As soon as it first starts to boil
When all the water is gone
optionExplain: Half (अर्ध) is the starting water, not what is left.
Right: पादशेषितम् अवतारयेत्: take it down when a quarter is left.
The text waits until a quarter remains.
A quarter remains; it is not boiled dry.
questions.explain: पाद = a quarter.
questions.rule: Take down at a quarter left.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: A physician wants to make a śīta. How much drug does unit 44 give?
optionExplain: Karṣa is the kalka and cūrṇa dose of verse 43.
Half a prastha is the decoction water, not drug.
Right: शीतफाण्टयोरौषधपलम्: for śīta and phāṇṭa, a pala of the drug.
The quarter is what remains of the decoction.
questions.explain: Śīta and phāṇṭa: a pala of drug, steeped.
questions.rule: Śīta, phāṇṭa: a pala of drug.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: Join पात्रे + अधिश्रित्य (having put in the pot on the fire) by the rule of प्रस्थे + अधिश्रित्य. Which is right?
optionExplain: आ would come from अ + अ; here the word ends in ए.
ऐ comes from अ + ए, not ए + अ.
ओ belongs to a final -अः before a voiced sound; पात्रे ends in ए.
Right: A final ए before अ stays ए and the अ is dropped, marked by avagraha (ऽ).
questions.explain: Same rule as प्रस्थेऽधिश्रित्य.
questions.teaches: Final ए before अ: the अ drops and is marked ऽ: प्रस्थे + अधिश्रित्य = प्रस्थेऽधिश्रित्य; पात्रे + अधिश्रित्य = पात्रेऽधिश्रित्य.
questions.section: मात्रा का विचार और मध्य मात्रा

questions.q: In unit 45, what is the sneha of sneha-cooking?
optionExplain: Right: स्नेह in the cooking sense is ghee or oil (standard).
Milk and curd are not what स्नेह means here.
Honey is मधु; स्नेह is a fat.
Water and juice are the liquid (द्रव), not the sneha.
questions.explain: स्नेहपाक = the cooking of sneha (ghee or oil).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 45 to its meaning.
questions.explain: अनिर्दिष्टप्रमाणे: where the measure is not stated; समुदितस्य द्रवस्य पादेन: at a quarter of the total liquid.
questions.rule: अनिर्दिष्ट = not stated; प्रमाण = measure; पाद = quarter; द्रव = liquid.

questions.q: Put the parts of the rule in unit 45 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: स्नेहपाके त्वनिर्दिष्टप्रमाणे समुदितस्य द्रवस्य पादेन स्नेहः प्रयोज्यस्तत्पादेन कल्कः.
questions.rule: Case · quarter of the liquid · sneha · quarter of that: kalka.
questions.teaches: Unit 45: where no measure is stated, sneha at a quarter of the total liquid, kalka at a quarter of that.

questions.q: When does the rule of unit 45 apply?
options: When the recipe states no measure
Only when no ghee is at hand at all
Only when the patient is very weak
optionExplain: The rule is for sneha-cooking without a stated measure.
Right: अनिर्दिष्टप्रमाणे: where the measure is not stated.
Nothing is said about ghee being absent.
The patient is not mentioned in this rule.
questions.explain: A fallback rule for unstated measures.

questions.q: A sneha recipe states no measure, and the total liquid is 16 parts. How much sneha does unit 45 prescribe?
optionExplain: 8 is half; the rule says a quarter.
That equals the liquid; the rule says a quarter of it.
Right: A quarter (पाद) of 16 parts is 4 parts.
2 is an eighth; the rule says a quarter.
questions.explain: समुदितस्य द्रवस्य पादेन स्नेहः: sneha = a quarter of the total liquid.

questions.q: पादेन (instrumental) gives the share 'at a quarter'. Which phrase means at half (अर्ध) of the liquid?
optionExplain: अर्धः is nominative: 'the half' as subject, not 'at half'.
The cases are swapped: 'of half, by the liquid'.
द्रवाय is dative, 'for the liquid'.
Right: Same pattern: the whole in the genitive (द्रवस्य), the share in the instrumental (अर्धेन).
questions.explain: Genitive of the whole + instrumental of the share, as in समुदितस्य द्रवस्य पादेन.
questions.rule: Share in the instrumental: पादेन, अर्धेन.
questions.teaches: Unit 45 puts the whole in the genitive and the share in the instrumental: द्रवस्य पादेन (at a quarter of the liquid); द्रवस्य अर्धेन (at half).

questions.q: In unit 46, what does अन्ये mean?
optionExplain: Right: अन्ये (m. nom. pl.) = others.
All is सर्वे.
Nobody would need a negative; अन्ये is positive.
We is वयम्; अन्ये is third person.
questions.explain: अन्ये पुनः पठन्ति: others, again, read.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 46 to its meaning.
questions.explain: अन्ये पुनः पठन्ति: others, again, read.
questions.rule: अन्ये = others; पुनः = again; पठन्ति = they read.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 46 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: अन्ये पुनः पठन्ति.
questions.teaches: Unit 46 runs: अन्ये पुनः पठन्ति, 'others, again, read'.

questions.q: What is पठन्ति in unit 46, by its grammar label?
optionExplain: The singular is पठति; -अन्ति is plural.
Right: The label: 3 pl. present of √पठ्.
-अन्ति is a present ending, not past.
The imperative would be पठन्तु.
questions.explain: पठन्ति = they read.

questions.q: Unit 45 gave a rule; unit 46 says अन्ये पुनः पठन्ति. What should the student expect next, by the card?
options: The close of the whole chapter
A list of drugs for the sneha
Another reading of the same rule
The author's own last word on it
optionExplain: The chapter goes on; a reading follows.
No drug list is announced; a reading of the rule is.
Right: The card: the line introduces a different reading of the rule on measures.
The reading belongs to others (अन्ये), not to the author.
questions.explain: अन्ये पुनः पठन्ति announces another version.

questions.q: Which form means he reads, the singular of पठन्ति?
optionExplain: पठन्तु is the imperative plural, 'let them read'.
पठामि is first person, 'I read'.
पठथ is second person plural, 'you read'.
Right: 3rd sg. present of √पठ् ends in -अति.
questions.explain: पठति (he reads) : पठन्ति (they read).
questions.teaches: Present tense of √पठ्: पठति (he reads), पठन्ति (they read).

questions.q: In verse 47, what does क्रमात् mean?
optionExplain: Right: क्रमात् (abl. as ind.) = in order, in sequence.
At once would be सद्यः; क्रमात् is in sequence.
Separately is पृथक्, in verse 48.
Night is निशा; nothing of night here.
questions.explain: शुद्धाम्बुनिःक्वाथस्वरसैः क्रमात्: with water, decoction and juice, in order.

questions.q: Put the liquids of verse 47 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: शुद्धाम्बु-निःक्वाथ-स्वरसैः क्रमात्.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 47 to its meaning.
questions.explain: निःक्वाथ is a synonym of क्वाथ; स्वरस is expressed juice; अंश is a portion.
questions.rule: अम्बु = water; निःक्वाथ = decoction; स्वरस = juice; अंश = portion.
questions.teaches: Verse 47's words: अम्बु (water), निःक्वाथ (decoction), स्वरस (expressed juice), अंश (portion).

questions.q: By verse 47, what is added in a fourth, a sixth and an eighth part?
optionExplain: The water is one of the liquids, not the fractioned thing.
Right: कल्कस्य योजयेदंशम्: one should add the portion of the kalka.
The sneha is being cooked; the kalka is added.
Honey is not named in verse 47.
questions.explain: कल्कस्य अंशम्: the kalka's portion.

questions.q: A physician adds the kalka portions in the order of verse 47. Which comes right after the fourth?
optionExplain: The eighth comes last, after the sixth.
No fifth is named.
Right: चतुर्थं षष्ठमष्टमम्: fourth, sixth, eighth.
No third is named.
questions.explain: Fourth → sixth → eighth.

questions.q: चतुर्थम् (a fourth) is an ordinal in the m. acc. sg., like अंशम्. Which form means a third, built the same way?
optionExplain: त्रय is 'a triad', as in पलत्रयम् (three palas), not 'a third'.
तृतीयः is nominative; with अंशम् the accusative is needed.
त्रिः means 'thrice', an adverb.
Right: तृतीय is the ordinal 'third'; m. acc. sg. तृतीयम्, like चतुर्थम्.
questions.explain: Ordinal + case agreeing with अंशम्.
questions.teaches: Ordinal numbers agree with their noun: अंशं चतुर्थम् (a fourth part), अंशं तृतीयम् (a third part).

questions.q: In verse 48, what does कल्कीकुर्यात् mean?
options: Should dry it into a powder
Should soak it in cold water
optionExplain: Right: कल्की-कुर्यात् = should make into kalka.
Decoction would be क्वाथ or निर्यूह, not कल्क.
Powder is चूर्ण, not कल्क.
Soaking in cold water makes a śīta, not a kalka.
questions.explain: भेषजं कल्कीकुर्यात्: one should make the drug into kalka.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 48 to its meaning.
questions.explain: पृथक् स्नेहसममेवावपेत्; अनिरूपितकल्पं भेषजं कल्कीकुर्यात्.
questions.rule: पृथक् = separately; स्नेहसम = equal to sneha; अनिरूपित = not specified; भेषज = drug.

questions.q: Put the phrases of verse 48 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: पञ्चप्रभृति तु द्रवं पृथक्स्नेहसममेवावपेत् । अनिरूपितकल्पं भेषजं कल्कीकुर्यात् ॥
questions.rule: Liquid · equal to sneha · unspecified drug · make into kalka.
questions.teaches: Verse 48: liquid equal to the sneha, added separately; a drug of unspecified preparation becomes kalka.

questions.q: By verse 48, how much liquid is to be added separately?
optionExplain: A quarter is the measure of unit 45, not verse 48.
Right: स्नेहसमम् एव: just equal to the sneha.
Four times is not what स्नेहसम says.
सम means equal, not half.
questions.explain: स्नेहसम = equal to the sneha.

questions.q: A recipe names a drug but not how to prepare it. What does verse 48 say to do?
options: Leave it out of the recipe
optionExplain: Svarasa is not the default named here.
Decoction is not the default named here.
Right: अनिरूपितकल्पं भेषजं कल्कीकुर्यात्: an unspecified drug is made into kalka.
The verse keeps the drug and makes it kalka.
questions.explain: Default form: kalka.

questions.q: Join एव + आनयेत् (should indeed bring) by the rule of एव + आवपेत्. Which is right?
optionExplain: The long आ of आनयेत् cannot shorten.
ए would come from अ + इ, not अ + आ.
औ comes from अ + ओ or औ, not अ + आ.
Right: अ + आ → आ: एव + आवपेत् = एवावपेत्; एव + आनयेत् = एवानयेत्.
questions.explain: Same rule as एवावपेत्.
questions.teaches: अ before आ merges into आ: एव + आवपेत् = एवावपेत्; एव + आनयेत् = एवानयेत्.

questions.q: In unit 49, what does एकध्यम् mean?
optionExplain: Right: एकध्यम् (ind.) = together, into one.
Separately is पृथक्; एकध्यम् is the opposite.
Nothing in एकध्यम् speaks of speed.
Twice is द्विः, not एकध्यम्.
questions.explain: अथैकध्यं प्रतिसंसृज्य: then, having mixed together.

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 49 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: प्रतिसंसृज्याधिश्रित्य च निर्यूहवत्साधयेत्.
questions.rule: Mix → put on the fire → prepare like a decoction.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 49 to its meaning.
questions.explain: अथैकध्यं प्रतिसंसृज्याधिश्रित्य च निर्यूहवत्साधयेत्.
questions.rule: अथ = then; प्रतिसंसृज्य = having mixed; अधिश्रित्य = having put on the fire; साधयेत् = should prepare.
questions.teaches: Unit 49: अथ (then), प्रतिसंसृज्य (having mixed), अधिश्रित्य (on the fire), साधयेत् (should prepare).

questions.q: By unit 49, the mixture is prepared like what?
optionExplain: Śīta is soaked cold; the line says niryūha.
Right: निर्यूहवत् = like a decoction.
Kalka is ground, not cooked like this.
Cūrṇa is sifted, not cooked.
questions.explain: निर्यूहवत् साधयेत्: prepare it like a decoction.

questions.q: A physician has mixed the things together. What is his next step, by unit 49?
optionExplain: Straining comes after cooking (line 05.08.65).
Storing comes at the end (line 05.08.65).
Right: प्रतिसंसृज्य अधिश्रित्य च: having mixed, and having put it on the fire.
Grinding is not named here.
questions.explain: Mix, then put on the fire, then prepare like a decoction.

questions.q: निर्यूहवत् means 'like a decoction'. Which word means like a paste (kalka)?
optionExplain: कल्कात् is ablative: 'from the paste'.
कल्केन is instrumental: 'with the paste'.
कल्कस्य is genitive: 'of the paste'.
Right: The suffix -वत् means 'like': कल्क + वत् = कल्कवत्.
questions.explain: Same suffix as निर्यूहवत्.
questions.teaches: The suffix -वत् means 'like': निर्यूहवत् (like a decoction), कल्कवत् (like a paste).

questions.q: In unit 50, what is the first sign named for taking the sneha down?
optionExplain: Right: यदा विरमति शब्दः: when the sound stops.
Froth is the sign of verse 52, not the first sign here.
Its own colour should arise, not fade.
Boiling is not named as a sign.
questions.explain: शब्द = sound; विरमति = ceases.

questions.q: Put the signs of unit 50 in the order of the text.
items: Its own colour, smell and taste arise
Held between two fingers, it does not stick
questions.explain: Sound, clarity, colour-smell-taste, then the finger test.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 50 to its meaning.
questions.explain: विरमति शब्दः; यथास्ववर्णगन्धरसोपपत्तिः: its own colour, smell and taste arise.
questions.rule: शब्द = sound; वर्ण = colour; गन्ध = smell; रस = taste.
questions.teaches: Unit 50's signs use शब्द (sound), वर्ण (colour), गन्ध (smell) and रस (taste).

questions.q: How is the medicine judged between two fingers, by unit 50?
options: It should feel hot to the fingers
It should not stick to the fingers
It should stain the fingers yellow
It should melt between the fingers
optionExplain: Heat is not named as the test.
Right: अनङ्गुलिग्राहिता: not sticking to the fingers.
No staining is named.
Melting is not named; not sticking is.
questions.explain: Finger test: it does not stick.

questions.q: A cook's sneha is still making a sound in the pot. By unit 50, what should he do?
optionExplain: The sound has not stopped, so the time has not come.
Adding kalka is not said here.
Right: The time for taking down comes when the sound stops (विरमति).
Pouring into a jar comes after taking down and cooling.
questions.explain: Sound still going = not yet done.
questions.rule: Take down only when the signs appear.

questions.q: अवतारणाय (dative) means 'for taking down'. Which form of पान (drinking) means for drinking?
optionExplain: पानेन is instrumental: 'by drinking'.
पानात् is ablative: 'from drinking'.
पानस्य is genitive: 'of drinking'.
Right: The dative of purpose ends in -आय: अवतारणाय, पानाय.
questions.explain: Same ending as अवतारणाय.
questions.teaches: The dative of an -अ noun (-आय) gives a purpose: स कालः तस्य अवतारणाय (that is the time for taking it down); पानाय (for drinking).

questions.q: What does अपि च in unit 51 mean?
optionExplain: Right: अपि (also) + च (and) = moreover.
Therefore is अतः; अपि च adds a point.
Enough is अलम्, as in unit 41.
No negative is in अपि च.
questions.explain: अपि च: moreover.

questions.q: What follows unit 51, by the card?
optionExplain: The chapter goes on.
Right: The card: the formula introduces a further rule; a verse follows.
A verse follows, not a drug list.
The quoted saying on dose was in unit 40; here a further rule follows.
questions.explain: अपि च → a verse with more signs.

questions.q: Unit 51 reads ____ च, 'moreover'. Type the word for 'also' in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: अपि च = also and = moreover.
questions.teaches: अपि = also.

questions.q: Which are true of unit 51, by the card?
optionExplain: Wrong: a further rule follows.
Right: अपि = also.
Right: च = and.
Wrong: the line gives no rule or dose.
questions.explain: अपि च = moreover; it only links.
questions.rule: अपि च links to a further rule.

questions.q: A teacher finishes one rule and says 'अपि च'. What is he signalling?
options: That the topic is now closed
That he is quoting some people
optionExplain: Closing would be इत्यलम्, as in unit 41.
That would be अन्ये पुनः पठन्ति, as in unit 46.
Right: अपि च = moreover: more is coming.
That would be तथा च केचिदाहुः, as in unit 39.
questions.explain: अपि च adds; इत्यलम् closes; अन्ये पठन्ति gives others' reading.

questions.q: Using अपि as in unit 51, which phrase means the oil also?
optionExplain: अलम् means 'enough': 'enough oil'.
इति means 'thus', marking a quotation.
पुनः means 'again'.
Right: अपि after a word means 'also': तैलम् अपि = the oil also.
questions.explain: अपि = also.
questions.teaches: अपि means 'also' and follows the word it adds: अपि च (and also); तैलम् अपि (the oil also).

questions.q: In verse 52, what is the sign for ghee (घृत)?
optionExplain: Right: घृतस्य फेनोपशमः: of ghee, the subsiding of the froth.
Froth arising is the sign for oil.
Threads are the sign for a leha.
Sinking is a sign for a leha.
questions.explain: Ghee: froth subsides.

questions.q: Match each preparation of verse 52 to its sign.
pairs: threads, sinking in water, no spreading
questions.explain: घृतस्य फेनोपशमः, तैलस्य तु तदुद्भवः, लेहस्य तन्तुमत्ताप्सु मज्जनं सरणं न च.
questions.rule: Ghee: froth down; oil: froth up; leha: threads, sinks, does not spread.

questions.q: Put the signs of a leha in verse 52 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: लेहस्य तन्तुमत्ताप्सु मज्जनं सरणं न च.
questions.rule: Threads · sinks in water · does not spread.
questions.teaches: A leha is ready (verse 52) when it has threads, sinks in water and does not spread.

questions.q: Which is the right split of फेनोपशमस्तैलस्य in verse 52?
optionExplain: स्तैलस्य is not a word; the स् comes from the visarga.
Right: A visarga before त becomes स्: फेनोपशमः + तैलस्य = फेनोपशमस्तैलस्य.
That would print फेनोपशमं तैलस्य.
That would print फेनोपशमात्तैलस्य.
questions.explain: फेनोपशमः (froth-subsiding) + तैलस्य (of oil).

questions.q: A cook drops a little of his leha into water. Which result does verse 52 look for?
options: It floats and stays on the surface
It spreads into a thin film
It sinks and does not spread
It froths up and then subsides
optionExplain: The verse asks for sinking, not floating.
The verse says no spreading (सरणं न).
Right: अप्सु मज्जनं सरणं न च: sinking in water, and no spreading.
Froth is the sign for ghee and oil, not leha.
questions.explain: Leha: sinks, does not spread.

questions.q: तदुद्भवः = तत् + उद्भवः, 'the arising of that'. Which form joins तत् + उपशमः (the subsiding of that)?
optionExplain: The त् does not stay unvoiced before a vowel.
That is 'the arising of that', the oil's sign.
No rule turns उ into ओ here.
Right: A final त् before a vowel becomes द्: तत् + उपशमः = तदुपशमः.
questions.explain: Same rule as तदुद्भवः.
questions.teaches: A final त् before a vowel becomes द्: तत् + उद्भवः = तदुद्भवः; तत् + उपशमः = तदुपशमः.

questions.q: In unit 53, through what is the cooled preparation strained?
optionExplain: Right: अहतेन वाससा परिपूय: having strained it through a new cloth.
No sieve is named; a cloth is.
The thread ties the cover; it is not for straining.
No pot is named for straining; a jar holds it after.
questions.explain: अहत वासस् = new, unused cloth.

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 53 in the order of the text.
items: Pour into a clean, firm jar (समासिच्य)
Close with a lid or cover with cloth
Keep it in a clean place (स्थापयेत्)
questions.explain: अवतार्य … शीतीभूतम् … परिपूय … कलशे समासिच्य … पिधाय / अवच्छाद्य … स्थापयेत्.
questions.rule: Down → cool → strain → jar → cover → store.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 53 to its meaning.
questions.explain: अहतेन वाससा; शुचौ दृढे कलशे; अपिधानेन; सूत्रेण सुबद्धम्.
questions.rule: अहत = new; कलश = jar; अपिधान = lid; सूत्र = thread.
questions.teaches: Unit 53's storage words: अहत (new cloth), कलश (jar), अपिधान (lid), सूत्र (thread).

questions.q: By unit 53, what must the jar be like?
optionExplain: Neither heat nor width is named.
Right: शुचौ दृढे कलशे: in a clean, firm jar.
The jar must be firm (दृढ), not cracked.
Size and paint are not named.
questions.explain: शुचि = clean; दृढ = firm.

questions.q: No lid is at hand. What does unit 53 allow instead?
options: Leaving the jar uncovered in the open air
Covering the jar with a layer of fresh leaves
Covering with a white strip of cloth
optionExplain: The jar is always closed or covered.
Leaves are not named.
Right: अपिधानेन वा पिधाय शुक्लेन वस्त्रपट्टेनावच्छाद्य: with a lid, or covered with a white cloth strip.
Clay is not named.
questions.explain: Lid, or white cloth strip.

questions.q: अहत is अ + हत (not struck), i.e. new. With the same negative अ, which word means not clean?
optionExplain: सु- means 'well': 'very clean'.
-तर makes a comparative: 'cleaner'.
प्र- is not a negative prefix.
Right: The negative prefix अ- before a consonant: अ + शुचि = अशुचि, 'not clean'.
questions.explain: Same prefix as अहत.
questions.teaches: The negative prefix अ- (before a consonant) means 'not': अहत (not struck, new), अशुचि (not clean).

questions.q: In unit 54, what does परिमाणम् mean?
optionExplain: Right: परिमाणम् (n. nom. sg.) = measure: the topic the unit opens.
Medicine is औषध; परिमाणम् is measure.
No season is named; परिमाणम् is measure.
Nothing is mixed here; परिमाणम् is measure.
questions.explain: परिमाणं पुनः: as for measure, again.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 54 to its meaning.
questions.explain: परिमाणं पुनः … मरीचिः: as for measure, again: … a marīci.
questions.rule: परिमाण = measure; पुनः = again; मरीचि = a minute unit of measure.

questions.q: Put the clear words of unit 54 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: परिमाणं पुनः षडंश्यो मरीचिः: the topic word, then पुनः, then the equation that ends in मरीचिः.
questions.teaches: Unit 54 runs: परिमाणम् (the topic) · पुनः (again) · an equation ending in मरीचिः, the first named unit.

questions.q: What is मरीचि in unit 54, by the card?
optionExplain: The card says it is not the pepper (मरिच) here.
Right: The card: here मरीचि is a tiny unit of measure, the first of the scale.
It is a minute unit, at the very bottom of the scale.
No vessel is meant; it is a unit of measure.
questions.explain: षडंश्यो मरीचिः: … are a marīci (a minute unit).
questions.rule: मरीचि here = a tiny unit, not pepper.

questions.q: A reader meets परिमाणं पुनः at the head of unit 54. What should he expect to follow?
optionExplain: The topic word is measure, not drugs.
Those came before (line 05.08.63); measure follows here.
Right: परिमाणम् = measure: the text now lists units, starting with marīci.
Storing in a jar ended in line 05.08.65.
questions.explain: परिमाणं पुनः opens the account of measures.
questions.rule: परिमाणं पुनः = here begins the account of measure.

questions.q: Unit 54 opens a topic with परिमाणं पुनः. Which new phrase says, the same way, as for time (काल), again?
optionExplain: कालात् is ablative, 'from time'; not a topic word.
कालेन is instrumental, 'by time'; not a topic word.
कालस्य is genitive, 'of time'; not a topic word.
Right: The topic word stands in the nominative, followed by पुनः, as परिमाणं पुनः.
questions.explain: Topic in the nominative + पुनः.
questions.rule: Topic word (nominative) + पुनः = 'as for X, again'.
questions.teaches: A new topic is set out by a nominative noun with पुनः: परिमाणं पुनः (as for measure, again); कालः पुनः (as for time, again).

questions.q: In unit 55, what does सर्षप mean?
optionExplain: Right: सर्षप = mustard seed (Brassica species, standard), here used as a unit of measure.
Rice grain is तण्डुल, the next step (line 05.08.68).
Barley is यव, later in the scale (line 05.08.70).
Pepper is not named; सर्षप is mustard seed.
questions.explain: ताः षट् सर्षपः: those six are a sarṣapa (mustard seed).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 55 to its meaning.
questions.explain: ताः षट् सर्षपः: those six are a sarṣapa.
questions.rule: ताः = those (f. pl.); षट् = six; सर्षप = mustard seed.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 55 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: ताः षट् सर्षपः: pronoun, number, then the unit they make.
questions.teaches: Unit 55 runs pronoun · number · new unit: ताः (those) षट् (six) सर्षपः (are a sarṣapa).

questions.q: To what does ताः refer in unit 55, by the card?
optionExplain: The rice grain (तण्डुल) comes next and is masculine; ताः looks back.
Right: ताः (f. nom. pl.) points back to marīci, the unit named just before.
The sarṣapa is what they make, not what ताः refers to.
No drug is named; ताः refers to the marīcis.
questions.explain: ताः = those (marīcis); षट् = six; सर्षपः = a sarṣapa.

questions.q: A student must make up one sarṣapa from marīcis. How many marīcis does unit 55 call for?
optionExplain: Eight is the number of the next step: eight sarṣapas make a taṇḍula.
Two belongs to later steps (taṇḍula to dhānyamāṣa, and on to yava).
Right: ताः षट् सर्षपः: those six (marīcis) are a sarṣapa.
Fourfold steps come only later, from unit 59 on.
questions.explain: षट् = six.

questions.q: ताः agrees with the feminine marīci. Which pronoun would refer back to several neuter पलानि when saying those six are a unit?
optionExplain: ताः is feminine plural, as for marīci; पलानि is neuter.
ते (as nominative plural) is masculine; पलानि is neuter.
तौ is masculine dual, 'those two'; not neuter plural.
Right: तानि is neuter nominative plural, agreeing with पलानि.
questions.explain: The pronoun takes the gender and number of the noun it points back to.
questions.rule: Pronoun = gender and number of what it refers to.
questions.teaches: A pronoun takes the gender and number of the noun it refers to: ताः for feminine marīcis; तानि for neuter पलानि.

questions.q: In unit 56, what does तण्डुल mean?
optionExplain: Right: तण्डुल = rice grain (Oryza sativa, standard), here a unit of measure.
Mustard seed is सर्षप, the unit just below.
Barley is यव, two steps higher (line 05.08.70).
A bean name (माष) appears only inside धान्यमाष, the next step.
questions.explain: ते ऽष्टौ तंडुलः: those eight are a taṇḍula (rice grain).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 56 to its meaning.
questions.explain: ते ऽष्टौ तंडुलः: those eight are a taṇḍula.
questions.rule: ते = those (m. pl.); अष्टौ = eight; तण्डुल = rice grain.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 56 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: ते ऽष्टौ तंडुलः: pronoun (the sarṣapas, by the unit's note), number, then the unit they make.
questions.teaches: Unit 56 runs pronoun · number · new unit: ते (those, the sarṣapas) अष्टौ (eight) तण्डुलः (are a taṇḍula).

questions.q: Which is the right split of ते ऽष्टौ in unit 56?
optionExplain: ष्टौ is not a word; the ऽ stands for a dropped अ.
Right: After a final ए, an initial अ is dropped and marked by ऽ: ते + अष्टौ = ते ऽष्टौ.
ऽ is not part of ते; it marks the lost अ of अष्टौ.
The word is अष्टौ with short अ; आष्टौ is not 'eight'.
questions.explain: ते (those) + अष्टौ (eight).
questions.rule: Final ए + अ → ए ऽ (the अ drops).

questions.q: A student has a heap of sarṣapas and wants one taṇḍula. How many sarṣapas does unit 56 call for?
optionExplain: Six is the step before: six marīcis make a sarṣapa.
Two is the next step: two taṇḍulas make a dhānyamāṣa.
Right: ते ऽष्टौ तंडुलः: those eight (sarṣapas) are a taṇḍula.
Ten is not in this unit; अष्टौ is eight.
questions.explain: अष्टौ = eight.

questions.q: Join वने + अस्ति (it is in the forest) by the rule of ते + अष्टौ. Which is right?
optionExplain: आ would come from अ + अ; the word ends in ए.
ऐ comes from अ + ए, not ए + अ.
ओ has no source here; the ए stays and the अ drops.
Right: After a final ए, an initial अ is dropped and shown by ऽ, as in ते ऽष्टौ.
questions.explain: Same rule as ते ऽष्टौ.
questions.teaches: After a word-final ए an initial अ is dropped and written ऽ: ते + अष्टौ = ते ऽष्टौ; वने + अस्ति = वनेऽस्ति.

questions.q: In unit 57, what does तौ mean?
optionExplain: Right: तौ = those two (m. nom. du.): the two taṇḍulas.
Six was ताः षट् (line 05.08.67); तौ is dual.
That one would be सः; तौ is dual.
Eight was ते ऽष्टौ (line 05.08.68); तौ is dual.
questions.explain: तौ धान्यमाषः: those two are a dhānyamāṣa.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 57 to its meaning.
questions.explain: तौ धान्यमाषः: those two are a dhānyamāṣa ('grain-māṣa').
questions.rule: तौ = those two; धान्य = grain; धान्यमाष = a small unit of weight.

questions.q: Put unit 57 in the order of the text, word by word and member by member.
questions.explain: तौ धान्य-माषः: the pronoun (the two taṇḍulas, by the unit's note), then the compound धान्य-माष.
questions.teaches: Unit 57 runs तौ (those two, the taṇḍulas) · धान्य-माषः, a unit name literally 'grain-māṣa'.

questions.q: What is माष in धान्यमाष, unit 57, by the card?
options: A bean added as a drug
optionExplain: No drug is added; the card says it is a name only.
Right: The card: माष also names a bean, but here it is only part of a unit name.
No pot is meant; धान्यमाष is a unit of weight.
The line has no verb; 'are' is understood.
questions.explain: धान्यमाषः = 'grain-māṣa', a small unit of weight.
questions.rule: माष here = part of a unit name.

questions.q: How many taṇḍulas make one dhānyamāṣa, by unit 57?
optionExplain: Eight sarṣapas make a taṇḍula; that is the step before.
Six marīcis make a sarṣapa; that is two steps before.
Right: तौ (those two, dual) धान्यमाषः: two taṇḍulas are a dhānyamāṣa.
Fourfold steps begin only in unit 59.
questions.explain: तौ is dual: exactly two.

questions.q: तौ is the masculine dual 'those two'. Which nominative form of तण्डुल means two rice grains?
optionExplain: -आः is the plural, for more than two.
-अः is the singular, one grain.
-अम् is the accusative singular.
Right: -औ is the nominative dual of masculine a-stems, matching तौ.
questions.explain: Masculine a-stem: -अः (one), -औ (two), -आः (many).
questions.rule: Masculine a-stem nominative dual ends in -औ.
questions.teaches: A masculine a-stem takes -औ in the nominative dual, like the pronoun तौ: तण्डुल → तण्डुलौ (two rice grains). Not every -औ is dual: अष्टौ is the numeral eight.

questions.q: In unit 58, what does यव mean?
optionExplain: Right: यव = barley (Hordeum vulgare, standard), here a unit of measure.
Rice grain is तण्डुल, two steps lower.
Mustard seed is सर्षप, lower in the scale.
No sack is meant; यव is the grain used as a unit.
questions.explain: तौ यवः: those two are a yava (barley).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 58 to its meaning.
questions.explain: तौ यवः: those two (dhānyamāṣas, by the unit's note) are a yava (barley).
questions.rule: तौ = those two; यव = barley; तौ points back to the dhānyamāṣas.

questions.q: Which English rendering of unit 58 is right?
options: Those eight are a yava (barley, as a unit).
Those two are a yava (barley, as a unit).
That one is a yava (barley, as a unit).
Those two are a yava (barley, as a sack).
optionExplain: Eight is अष्टौ (unit 56); तौ is 'those two'.
Right: तौ = those two (m. du.); यवः = a yava, barley used as a unit; 'are' understood.
That one would be सः; तौ is dual, 'those two'.
No sack is meant; यव is barley used as a unit.
questions.explain: तौ यवः: those two (dhānyamāṣas) are a yava.
questions.rule: तौ = those two; यव = barley, here a unit.
questions.teaches: Unit 58 reads तौ यवः: those two (the dhānyamāṣas) are a yava (barley, here a unit of measure).

questions.q: To what does तौ refer in unit 58, by the card?
optionExplain: Two taṇḍulas make a dhānyamāṣa (line 05.08.69), not a yava.
Yava is what they make, not what तौ refers to.
Right: The unit just before is dhānyamāṣa; तौ (those two) points back to it.
Sarṣapas go eight to a taṇḍula; they are not meant here.
questions.explain: तौ यवः: those two (dhānyamāṣas) are a yava.
questions.rule: तौ looks back to the unit just named.

questions.q: Two dhānyamāṣas make one ____ (unit 58). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: तौ यवः: those two (dhānyamāṣas) are a yava.
questions.teaches: 2 dhānyamāṣa = 1 yava, the top of the small scale.

questions.q: तौ means 'those two' for masculine things. Which phrase means those two physicians (वैद्य)?
optionExplain: ते वैद्याः is plural, 'those physicians', more than two.
ताः is feminine plural; it does not agree with वैद्यौ.
तम् is accusative singular; it does not agree with वैद्यौ.
Right: Pronoun and noun both masculine dual: तौ वैद्यौ.
questions.explain: Pronoun agrees in gender, number and case: तौ (m. du.) + वैद्यौ (m. du.).
questions.teaches: तौ is the masculine nominative dual 'those two'; a noun with it also stands in the dual: तौ वैद्यौ (those two physicians).

questions.q: In unit 59, what does चतुर्गुणवृद्ध्या mean?
optionExplain: Right: चतुर्-गुण-वृद्ध्या (f. inst. sg.) = by fourfold increase.
Two would be द्वि-; the text has चतुर्, four.
वृद्धि is increase, not decrease.
Ten would be दश-; the text has चतुर्, four.
questions.explain: अतः परं चतुर्गुणवृद्ध्या …: after this, by fourfold increase.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 59 to its meaning.
questions.explain: अतः परं चतुर्गुणवृद्ध्या … कल्प्यंते: after this, by fourfold increase, … are reckoned.
questions.rule: अतः परम् = after this; चतुर्गुण = fourfold; वृद्धि = increase; कल्प्यन्ते = are reckoned.

questions.q: Put these units of unit 59 in the order of the text's list.
questions.explain: …कर्षपलकुडवप्रस्थाढकद्रोणवहाः: karṣa, pala, kuḍava, prastha, āḍhaka, droṇa (then vaha).
questions.rule: कर्ष · पल · कुडव · प्रस्थ · आढक · द्रोण.
questions.teaches: The clear middle of the list of unit 59 runs karṣa, pala, kuḍava, prastha, āḍhaka, droṇa.

questions.q: Which of these units is NOT in the list of unit 59?
optionExplain: कुडव is in the list, after pala.
Right: Dharaṇa is given apart, in the next line (05.08.72), not in this list.
आढक is in the list, after prastha.
द्रोण is in the list, before vaha.
questions.explain: The list: aṇḍikā, (māṣaka, śāṇa), karṣa, pala, kuḍava, prastha, āḍhaka, droṇa, vaha.
questions.rule: धरण is not in the fourfold list.

questions.q: A student says the units after yava go on doubling, like the last steps of the small scale. What does unit 59 say?
options: They also go up by two each time
No rule is given for them
optionExplain: Doubling ended with yava; the text now says fourfold.
Eight was one step of the small scale (sarṣapa to taṇḍula).
Right: चतुर्गुणवृद्ध्या: by fourfold increase, not doubling.
A rule is given: fourfold increase.
questions.explain: अतः परं चतुर्गुणवृद्ध्या … कल्प्यन्ते.

questions.q: Built like चतुर्गुणवृद्ध्या (by fourfold increase), which form means by threefold increase?
optionExplain: -इः is nominative 'increase', not 'by increase'.
-ये is dative 'for increase'.
-एः is ablative or genitive, 'from / of increase'.
Right: त्रि (three) + गुण + वृद्ध्या, the instrumental 'by', as in चतुर्गुणवृद्ध्या.
questions.explain: Number + गुण + वृद्ध्या (instrumental).
questions.teaches: Number + गुण + वृद्ध्या states the step of a scale: चतुर्गुणवृद्ध्या 'by fourfold increase'; त्रिगुणवृद्ध्या 'by threefold increase'.

questions.q: In unit 60, what is the धरण?
optionExplain: Right: धरणम् = dharaṇa, a unit of weight.
No vessel is meant; dharaṇa is a unit of weight.
No drug is named; dharaṇa is a unit.
It is a weight, defined from the pala.
questions.explain: धरणं तु पलदशभागः: the dharaṇa is a part of a pala.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 60 to its meaning.
questions.explain: धरणं तु पलदशभागः: the dharaṇa, however, is a … part of a pala.
questions.rule: धरणम् = dharaṇa (unit of weight); तु = however; भाग = part.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 60, and the members of its compound, in the order of the text.
questions.explain: धरणं तु पल-दश-भागः.
questions.teaches: Unit 60 runs धरणम् · तु · then the compound पल-दश-भागः, whose head is भागः (part).

questions.q: From which unit is the dharaṇa defined in unit 60?
optionExplain: Karṣa is in the list of unit 59; it is not named here.
Right: पलदशभागः: the compound starts from पल; dharaṇa is a part of it.
Prastha is in the list of unit 59; it is not named here.
Yava closes the small scale; it is not named here.
questions.explain: धरणं तु पलदशभागः.
questions.rule: धरण is reckoned from the pala.

questions.q: A reader looks for dharaṇa in the fourfold list of unit 59. What does unit 60 show?
options: It is the very last item of that list
It is a larger unit than the droṇa
It is given apart, as a part of pala
It is another name of the yava
optionExplain: The list ends with वह; dharaṇa is not in it.
Unit 60 ties it to the pala, as a part of it.
Right: धरणं तु: 'the dharaṇa, however' is set out apart, as a part (भाग) of a pala.
No synonym is given; it is defined from the pala.
questions.explain: तु marks the dharaṇa as a separate case.
questions.rule: धरण stands outside the fourfold list.

questions.q: पलदशभागः names a part (भाग) of a pala. Built the same way, what does प्रस्थभागः mean?
optionExplain: The head is भाग (part), not प्रस्थ.
Not a dvandva: the members are not 'and'-joined.
भागः is one part; nothing says many.
Right: The first member says whose part it is; the last member, भाग, is the head.
questions.explain: Genitive tatpuruṣa: X-भाग = a part of X.
questions.rule: In a tatpuruṣa the last member is the head.
questions.teaches: In a tatpuruṣa compound the last member is the head and the first says 'of what': पल-…-भाग = a part of a pala; प्रस्थभाग = a part of a prastha.

questions.q: In verse 61, what does पर्यायः mean?
optionExplain: Right: पर्यायः (m. nom. sg.) = synonym: another name of the same measure.
Double is द्विगुण; पर्यायः is synonym.
Portion is भाग; पर्यायः is synonym.
Vessel is पात्र; पर्यायः is synonym.
questions.explain: माषकस्य पर्यायः: the synonym(s) of the māṣaka.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each term of verse 61 to its meaning.
questions.explain: माषकस्य पर्यायो हेमो धानकश्च; शाणद्वयस्य क्षुद्रः कोलो वटकश्च.
questions.rule: हेम = a māṣaka name; कोल = a name of two śāṇas; पर्याय = synonym; शाणद्वय = two śāṇas.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put the three names for two śāṇas in the order of verse 61.
questions.explain: शाणद्वयस्य क्षुद्रः कोलो वटकश्च: kṣudra, kola, then vaṭaka.
questions.teaches: Two śāṇas have three names, in this order: kṣudra, kola, vaṭaka.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Why is हेमः printed हेमो in verse 61?
options: -अः becomes -ओ at the end of a line
The word हेम ends in ओ by itself
optionExplain: At a pause the visarga stays; हेमो stands before धानकः.
Right: हेमः + धानकः: after अ, the visarga becomes ओ before a voiced consonant.
The gloss gives हेमः (m. nom. sg.); ओ comes from sandhi.
Before unvoiced च it becomes श्: धानकश्च.
questions.explain: हेमो धानकश्च = हेमः + धानकः + च.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: A recipe gives a powder by the kola. What measure is that, by verse 61?
optionExplain: The māṣaka's names are hema and dhānaka.
The card says kola is here a unit name only.
Right: शाणद्वयस्य … कोलः: kola is a name of two śāṇas.
The verse pairs kola with two śāṇas, not two māṣakas.
questions.explain: कोल = two śāṇas.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: धानकः + च gives धानकश्च. By the same rule, how are रामः and च joined?
optionExplain: -ओ is used before voiced sounds; च is unvoiced.
Before च (a palatal) the visarga becomes the palatal श्, not स्.
-र् does not arise after अ here; the visarga becomes श्.
Right: Before च the visarga becomes श्, as in धानकश्च and वटकश्च.
questions.explain: Visarga + च → श्च.
questions.teaches: Before च a visarga becomes श्: धानकः + च = धानकश्च; रामः + च = रामश्च.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 62, what does पाणितल mean literally?
optionExplain: Right: पाणि-तलम् = hand; palm: the palm of the hand, here a name of the karṣa.
Foot is पाद; पाणि is the hand.
Cupped hands is अञ्जलि; पाणितल is the palm.
Fist is मुष्टि, a name of the pala.
questions.explain: पाणितलम्: palm of the hand (a name of the karṣa).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each name of the karṣa in unit 62 to its literal meaning.
questions.explain: The card gives these literal senses; here all are names of the karṣa.
questions.rule: बिडालपदक = cat's-foot; पाणितल = palm; कवलग्रह = mouthful-grasp; सुवर्ण = gold; पिचु = cotton.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put these names of the karṣa in the order of unit 62.
questions.explain: कर्षस्य सुवर्णमक्षं पिचुर्बिडालपदकं पाणितलं तिंदुकं …
questions.rule: सुवर्ण · अक्ष · पिचु · बिडालपदक · पाणितल · तिन्दुक (then कवलग्रह, षोडशिका).
questions.teaches: The karṣa list opens suvarṇa, akṣa, picu, biḍālapadaka, pāṇitala, tinduka, and ends kavalagraha, ṣoḍaśikā.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a name of the karṣa in unit 62?
optionExplain: अक्ष is the second name in the karṣa list.
Right: Muṣṭi (fist) is a name of the pala, in line 05.08.77.
तिन्दुक is in the karṣa list, after pāṇitala.
षोडशिका closes the karṣa list.
questions.explain: Karṣa: suvarṇa, akṣa, picu, biḍālapadaka, pāṇitala, tinduka, kavalagraha, ṣoḍaśikā.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: A recipe says take one picu of a drug. Which measure is meant, by unit 62?
optionExplain: The card: picu means cotton, but here it is a unit name only.
The pala's names are muṣṭi, prakuñca and others (line 05.08.77).
Right: पिचु is a name of the karṣa in this list.
Two karṣas are śukti and aṣṭamikā (line 05.08.76).
questions.explain: पिचु = karṣa.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: पिचुः + बिडाल… gives पिचुर्बिडाल…. By the same rule, how are गुरुः and गच्छति joined?
optionExplain: After उ the visarga is not dropped; before a voiced sound it becomes र्.
श् comes before च/छ, not before ग.
स् comes before त/थ, not before ग.
Right: After उ, the visarga becomes र् before a voiced sound, as in पिचुर्बिडाल….
questions.explain: Visarga after उ (or इ) + voiced sound → र्.
questions.teaches: After इ or उ a visarga becomes र् before a voiced sound: पिचुः + बिडाल = पिचुर्बिडाल; गुरुः + गच्छति = गुरुर्गच्छति.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 63, what does कर्षद्वयस्य mean?
optionExplain: Right: कर्ष-द्वयस्य (gen. sg. of द्वय, a pair) = of two karṣas.
Half would be अर्ध; द्वय is a pair.
That would be कर्षस्य; द्वय adds 'two'.
-स्य is genitive 'of', not instrumental 'by'.
questions.explain: कर्षद्वयस्य शुक्तिरष्टमिका च: of two karṣas, śukti and aṣṭamikā.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 63 to its meaning.
questions.explain: कर्षद्वयस्य शुक्तिरष्टमिका च.
questions.rule: कर्षद्वय = two karṣas; शुक्ति = shell, here a unit name; अष्टमिका = a unit name; च = and.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put these measures in the order in which the text gives their names (lines 05.08.75 to 05.08.77).
questions.explain: Karṣa (line 05.08.75), two karṣas (this unit), then pala (line 05.08.77).
questions.teaches: The synonym list climbs: karṣa, then two karṣas (śukti, aṣṭamikā), then pala.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Which split of शुक्तिरष्टमिका in unit 63 is right?
optionExplain: रष्टमिका is not a word; the र् comes from the visarga.
Right: After इ, a visarga becomes र् before a vowel: शुक्तिः + अष्टमिका = शुक्तिरष्टमिका.
ष्टमिका is not a word; the vowel अ belongs to अष्टमिका.
Long ई + अ would give य: शुक्त्यष्टमिका.
questions.explain: शुक्तिः (śukti) + अष्टमिका.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: A recipe asks for a śukti of oil. How much is that, by unit 63?
optionExplain: The karṣa's own names are suvarṇa, akṣa, picu and the rest.
The card: śukti is here a unit name, not a shell.
Right: कर्षद्वयस्य शुक्तिः: śukti is a name of two karṣas.
Two palas are prasṛta and aṣṭamāna (line 05.08.78).
questions.explain: शुक्ति = two karṣas.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: शुक्तिः + अष्टमिका gives शुक्तिरष्टमिका. By the same rule, how are हरिः and अत्र joined?
optionExplain: Without a visarga इ + अ would give हर्यत्र; here the visarga gives र्.
ओ and ऽ arise only from -अः; this word ends in -इः.
Lengthening joins इ + इ; the next vowel is अ.
Right: After इ, the visarga becomes र् before a vowel, as in शुक्तिरष्टमिका.
questions.explain: Visarga after इ + vowel → र्.
questions.teaches: After इ or उ a visarga becomes र् before a vowel: शुक्तिः + अष्टमिका = शुक्तिरष्टमिका; हरिः + अत्र = हरिरत्र.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 64, what does मुष्टि mean literally?
optionExplain: Right: मुष्टिः = fist, here a name of the pala.
Palm is पाणितल, a name of the karṣa.
A cup is कंस, a name of the āḍhaka.
Shell is शुक्ति, a name of two karṣas.
questions.explain: पलस्य मुष्टिः: of the pala, muṣṭi (fist).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 64 to its meaning.
questions.explain: पलस्य मुष्टिः प्रकुंचश्चतुर्थिका बिल्वमात्रं च.
questions.rule: पल = unit of weight; मुष्टि = fist; बिल्व = bael; मात्र = extent.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put the four names of the pala in the order of unit 64.
questions.explain: पलस्य मुष्टिः प्रकुंचश्चतुर्थिका बिल्वमात्रं च.
questions.teaches: The pala's names run muṣṭi, prakuñca, caturthikā, bilvamātra.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: What does बिल्वमात्रम् say in unit 64, by the card?
optionExplain: No root is named; mātra means extent.
Right: बिल्व-मात्रम्: bilva (bael) + mātra (extent); the card says the text does not add 'fruit'.
No juice is named; this is a measure.
No leaf is named; mātra means extent.
questions.explain: बिल्वमात्रम् = the extent of a bilva.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: A recipe says take a muṣṭi of a drug. Which measure is meant, by unit 64?
optionExplain: The karṣa's names are suvarṇa, picu and the rest.
Two palas are prasṛta and aṣṭamāna (line 05.08.78).
Right: पलस्य मुष्टिः: muṣṭi is a name of the pala.
Muṣṭi is listed under the pala, not the kuḍava.
questions.explain: मुष्टि = pala.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: बिल्वमात्रम् means 'as much as a bilva'. Built the same way, what does अङ्गुष्ठमात्रम् mean?
optionExplain: Here मात्र is the extent; 'only' is not meant.
No material is meant; मात्र gives extent.
Half is अर्ध; मात्र is extent.
Right: -मात्र after a noun gives 'the extent of / as much as' that thing.
questions.explain: X-मात्र = as much as X.
questions.teaches: X-मात्र gives a measure by comparison: बिल्वमात्र = as much as a bilva; अङ्गुष्ठमात्र = as much as a thumb.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 65, which measure is called प्रसृत?
optionExplain: Right: पलद्वयस्य प्रसृतः: prasṛta is a name of two palas.
Two karṣas are śukti and aṣṭamikā.
The pala's names are muṣṭi, prakuñca and others.
Prasṛta stands under two palas, not the kuḍava.
questions.explain: पलद्वयस्य प्रसृतोऽष्टमानं च.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each measure to one of its names (lines 05.08.76 to 05.08.78).
questions.explain: Two karṣas: śukti; pala: muṣṭi; two palas: prasṛta.
questions.rule: कर्षद्वय = शुक्ति; पल = मुष्टि; पलद्वय = प्रसृत.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put these measures in the order of the text's synonym lines, up to unit 65.
questions.explain: Māṣaka (line 05.08.73), karṣa (05.08.75), pala (05.08.77), two palas (this unit).
questions.teaches: The synonym lines climb from the māṣaka through karṣa and pala to two palas.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Which split of प्रसृतोऽष्टमानम् in unit 65 is right?
optionExplain: ष्टमानम् is not a word; ऽ marks the lost अ.
Right: -अः before अ: the visarga becomes ओ and the next अ drops, shown by ऽ.
ओष्टमानम् is not a word; the ओ comes from -अः.
-म् would stay before अ: प्रसृतमष्टमानम्.
questions.explain: प्रसृतः (prasṛta) + अष्टमानम् (aṣṭamāna).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Two palas are called prasṛta and ____ (unit 65). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: पलद्वयस्य प्रसृतोऽष्टमानं च: prasṛta and aṣṭamāna.
questions.teaches: The two names of two palas are prasṛta and aṣṭamāna.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: प्रसृतः + अष्टमानम् gives प्रसृतोऽष्टमानम्. By the same rule, how are रामः and अत्र joined?
optionExplain: र् arises after इ or उ, not after अ.
The visarga is not simply dropped before अ; it gives ओ.
Right: -अः before अ: ओ, and the अ of अत्र drops (ऽ).
श् arises before च/छ, not before a vowel.
questions.explain: Same rule as प्रसृतोऽष्टमानम्.
questions.teaches: -अः before अ becomes ओ and the अ drops (written ऽ): प्रसृतः + अष्टमानम् = प्रसृतोऽष्टमानम्; रामः + अत्र = रामोऽत्र.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 66, what kind of measure is the कुडव?
optionExplain: Time is not measured here; kuḍava is volume.
No length is meant; kuḍava is volume.
No drug is named; kuḍava is a measure.
Right: The gloss: kuḍava, a unit of volume.
questions.explain: कुडवस्य …: of the kuḍava (a unit of volume).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each term of unit 66 to its meaning, by the card.
questions.explain: The line is 'of the kuḍava: (its synonym)…'; पर्याय is carried over from line 05.08.73.
questions.rule: कुडव = unit of volume; पर्याय = synonym; -स्य = of.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put these measures in the order of the list in line 05.08.71, in which the kuḍava stands.
questions.explain: …कर्षपलकुडवप्रस्थाढक…: karṣa, pala, kuḍava, prastha.
questions.teaches: In the fourfold list the kuḍava comes after the pala and before the prastha.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Which of these is a unit of volume, by the cards?
optionExplain: Right: The gloss of unit 66: kuḍava, a unit of volume.
The pala is a unit of weight (line 05.08.77).
The karṣa is a unit of weight (line 05.08.75).
The tulā is a unit of weight (line 05.08.84).
questions.explain: कुडव = a unit of volume; कर्ष, पल, तुला = units of weight.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In this list a line opens with कुडवस्य. What should the words after it give?
options: The weight of a kuḍava in grams
A drug cooked in a kuḍava
The number of palas in it
optionExplain: The text gives no grams; it gives names.
Right: Each line of this list is 'of X: (synonyms)'; पर्याय is understood from line 05.08.73.
