No drug is named; the list gives names of measures.
These lines give names, not counts.
questions.explain: X-स्य + name(s) = the synonym(s) of X.
questions.rule: Genitive measure + nominative names = its synonyms.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Each line names a measure in the genitive, then its names. Which form would open a line for the prastha?
optionExplain: -एन is instrumental 'by'.
-म् here is accusative or nominative, not 'of'.
Right: -स्य is the genitive singular 'of', as in कुडवस्य, पलस्य.
-ए is locative 'in'.
questions.explain: Measure in the genitive (-स्य) + its names.
questions.teaches: Each synonym line puts the measure in the genitive (-स्य, 'of'): कर्षस्य, पलस्य, कुडवस्य; for prastha, प्रस्थस्य.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 67, what is मानिका?
options: A name of the single pala
A name of a pair of palas
A name of the single karṣa
optionExplain: The pala's names are muṣṭi and the rest.
Two palas are prasṛta and aṣṭamāna.
The karṣa's names are suvarṇa and the rest.
Right: कुडवद्वयस्य मानिका: mānikā is a name of two kuḍavas.
questions.explain: कुडवद्वयस्य मानिका.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 67 to its meaning.
questions.explain: कुडवद्वयस्य मानिका: of two kuḍavas, mānikā.
questions.rule: कुडव = unit of volume; द्वय = pair; मानिका = unit name.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put these measures in the order of the text's synonym lines.
questions.explain: Two karṣas (line 05.08.76), two palas (05.08.78), two kuḍavas (this unit).
questions.teaches: The pair lines run in this order: two karṣas, two palas, two kuḍavas.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Which measure does unit 67 name, as against unit 66?
optionExplain: Right: द्वय (a pair) is added: कुडवद्वयस्य, of two kuḍavas.
One kuḍava is the line before (05.08.79).
Half would be अर्ध; द्वय is two.
Four is not named; द्वय is a pair.
questions.explain: कुडवस्य (05.08.79) vs कुडवद्वयस्य (this line).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: A measure of two kuḍavas is called ____ (unit 67). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: कुडवद्वयस्य मानिका.
questions.teaches: Two kuḍavas = mānikā.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Like कुडवद्वयस्य (of two kuḍavas), which form means of two prasthas?
optionExplain: -म् is nominative/accusative, not 'of'.
Right: X + द्वय, then the genitive -स्य: 'of two X'.
-एन is instrumental 'by'.
-एषु is locative plural 'in'.
questions.explain: X-द्वयस्य = of two X.
questions.teaches: X-द्वय-स्य means 'of two X': कर्षद्वयस्य, पलद्वयस्य, कुडवद्वयस्य; for prastha, प्रस्थद्वयस्य.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 68, what does पात्र mean literally?
optionExplain: Fist is मुष्टि, a pala name.
Shell is शुक्ति, a name of two karṣas.

A winnowing basket is शूर्प, a name of two droṇas.
questions.explain: आढकस्य पात्रं कंसश्च.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 68 to its meaning.

questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put the words of unit 68 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: आढकस्य पात्रं कंसश्च.
questions.teaches: Unit 68 runs: the measure in the genitive (आढकस्य), then its names पात्रम्, कंसः, closed by च.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Which of these is a name of the āḍhaka, by unit 68?
optionExplain: Kalaśa is a name of the droṇa (line 05.08.82).
Mānikā is two kuḍavas (line 05.08.80).
Śukti is two karṣas (line 05.08.76).
Right: आढकस्य पात्रं कंसश्च: kaṃsa is one of its two names.
questions.explain: āḍhaka = pātra, kaṃsa.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: A recipe says take a kaṃsa of milk. What measure is meant, by unit 68?
optionExplain: Right: कंस is a name of the āḍhaka.
The droṇa's names are nalvaṇa, ghaṭa and others.
The card: kaṃsa is here a measure name, not any cup.
Two kuḍavas are mānikā.
questions.explain: कंस = āḍhaka.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: कंसः + च gives कंसश्च. By the same rule, how are घटः and च joined?
optionExplain: -ओ arises before voiced sounds; च is unvoiced.
Right: Before च the visarga becomes श्, as in कंसश्च.
Before the palatal च the visarga becomes श्, not स्.
र् arises after इ or उ, not after अ.
questions.explain: Visarga + च → श्च.
questions.teaches: Before च a visarga becomes श्: कंसः + च = कंसश्च; घटः + च = घटश्च.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 69, what kind of measure is the द्रोण?
optionExplain: Weights are the karṣa, pala and the like; droṇa is volume.
Its names mean pot, but droṇa itself is a measure.
Right: The gloss: droṇa, a unit of volume.
No method is named; it is a measure.
questions.explain: द्रोणस्य …: of the droṇa (a unit of volume).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each measure to one of its names (lines 05.08.77 to 05.08.82).
questions.explain: Pala: muṣṭi; āḍhaka: pātra; droṇa: kalaśa; two kuḍavas: mānikā.
questions.rule: पल = मुष्टि; आढक = पात्र; द्रोण = कलश; कुडवद्वय = मानिका.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put these names of the droṇa in the order of unit 69.

questions.teaches: The droṇa's clear names run nalvaṇa, unmāna, ghaṭa, kumbha, kalaśa (armaṇa, unverified, stands second).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Which names of the droṇa in unit 69 also mean 'pot', by the card?
optionExplain: Wrong: the card gives nalvaṇa as a unit name only.
Right: kalaśa also means pot.
Wrong: the card gives unmāna as a unit name only.
Right: kumbha also means pot.
Right: ghaṭa also means pot.
questions.explain: The gloss: ghaṭa, kumbha and kalaśa also mean 'pot'.
questions.rule: घट, कुम्भ, कलश = pot names used for the droṇa.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: A recipe says boil the drugs in a kumbha of water. What measure is meant, by unit 69?
optionExplain: The āḍhaka's names are pātra and kaṃsa.
Two droṇas are śūrpa (line 05.08.83).
Kumbha stands under the droṇa, not the kuḍava.
Right: कुम्भ is in the list of the droṇa's names.
questions.explain: कुम्भ = droṇa.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: नल्वण…कलशाः ends in plural -आः because it joins many names. Which form joins Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa and Bharata the same way?
optionExplain: Right: A dvandva of more than two masculine names takes the plural, -आः, as in …कलशाः.
-औ is dual, for two only; here there are three.
-अः is singular; it does not fit three people.
-एन is instrumental singular, 'by'.
questions.explain: Dvandva of three or more: plural ending.
questions.teaches: A dvandva compound of three or more members takes the plural: नल्वण…कलशाः; रामलक्ष्मणभरताः (Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa and Bharata).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 70, what does शूर्प mean literally?
optionExplain: Metal cup is कंस, an āḍhaka name.
Right: शूर्पः = winnowing basket, here a name of two droṇas.
Pot names (ghaṭa, kumbha, kalaśa) belong to the droṇa.
Cupped hands is अञ्जलि, the restored kuḍava name.
questions.explain: द्रोणद्वयस्य शूर्पः.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each measure to its name (lines 05.08.80 to 05.08.83).
questions.explain: Two kuḍavas: mānikā; āḍhaka: kaṃsa; two droṇas: śūrpa.
questions.rule: कुडवद्वय = मानिका; आढक = कंस; द्रोणद्वय = शूर्प.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put these measures in the order of the text's volume synonym lines.
questions.explain: Two kuḍavas (05.08.80), āḍhaka (05.08.81), droṇa (05.08.82), two droṇas (this unit).
questions.teaches: The volume synonyms run kuḍava, two kuḍavas, āḍhaka, droṇa, two droṇas.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Which measure is called शूर्प in unit 70?
optionExplain: The droṇa's names are nalvaṇa to kalaśa.
No name is given for two āḍhakas.
Right: द्रोणद्वयस्य शूर्पः: of two droṇas, śūrpa.
Two kuḍavas are mānikā.
questions.explain: शूर्प = two droṇas.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Two droṇas are called ____ (unit 70). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: द्रोणद्वयस्य शूर्पः.
questions.teaches: The largest volume name in this list: two droṇas = śūrpa.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: शूर्पः is masculine nominative singular. Which form would mean two śūrpas (as subject)?
optionExplain: -आः is the plural, for more than two.
-अम् is the accusative singular.
-ए is the locative singular, 'in a śūrpa'.
Right: -औ is the nominative dual of masculine a-stems.
questions.explain: Masculine a-stem: -अः (one), -औ (two), -आः (many).
questions.teaches: A masculine a-stem takes -औ in the nominative dual: शूर्पः (one śūrpa) → शूर्पौ (two śūrpas).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 71, what does तुला mean literally?
optionExplain: Right: तुला = balance (scales), here a unit of weight.
Basket is शूर्प; तुला is balance.
Handful is near मुष्टि; तुला is balance.
Load is भार, in the next line.
questions.explain: तुला पुनः पलशतम्.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 71 to its meaning.
questions.explain: तुला पुनः पल-शतम्: the tulā, again, is a hundred palas.
questions.rule: तुला = balance; पुनः = again; पल = unit of weight; शतम् = hundred.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put the words of unit 71 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: तुला पुनः पल-शतम्.
questions.teaches: Unit 71 runs तुला · पुनः · पल-शतम् (a hundred palas).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Of which unit is the tulā made, by unit 71?
optionExplain: The karṣa is not named here.
Right: पलशतम्: a hundred of palas.
The droṇa is a volume, not named here.
The bhāra is made of tulās, in the next line.
questions.explain: तुला = पलशतम्.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: A recipe calls for a tulā of a drug. How many palas is that, by unit 71?
optionExplain: Twenty is the count of the next line (twenty make a bhāra).
Two palas are prasṛta, not tulā.
Right: पलशतम्: a hundred palas.
Four is the step of the fourfold list.
questions.explain: शतम् = hundred.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: पलशतम् means a hundred palas. Built the same way, what does गोशतम् mean?
optionExplain: That would need a word for a part; शतम् is a hundred.
The first member is what is counted; the head is शतम्.
Not a dvandva; X-शतम् is 'a hundred of X'.
Right: X-शतम् = a hundred of X, as in पलशतम्.
questions.explain: X-शतम् = a hundred of X.
questions.teaches: X-शतम् is 'a hundred of X': पलशतम् = a hundred palas; गोशतम् = a hundred cows.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 72, what does भार mean literally?
optionExplain: Right: भारः = load, here a unit of weight.
Balance is तुला, the line before.
Shell is शुक्ति, a name of two karṣas.
Pot names belong to the droṇa.
questions.explain: तानि विंशतिर्भारः: twenty of those are a bhāra (a load).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 72 to its meaning.
questions.explain: तानि विंशतिर्भार इति.
questions.rule: तानि = those; विंशतिः = twenty; भारः = load.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: Put these weights in rising order, by units 71 and 72.
questions.explain: A hundred palas are a tulā; twenty of those are a bhāra.
questions.teaches: Pala, then tulā (a hundred palas), then bhāra (twenty tulās).
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: To what does तानि refer in unit 72, by the card?
optionExplain: द्रोण is masculine and a volume; not meant.
Right: तानि is neuter plural; it points to पलशतम् (neuter), the hundred-pala tulā.
शूर्प is masculine; तानि is neuter.
The bhāra is what they make, not what तानि refers to.
questions.explain: तानि (n. pl.) ← पलशतम् (n.).
questions.rule: तानि looks back to the hundred-pala units.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: A student has tulās of a drug. How many tulās make one bhāra, by unit 72?
optionExplain: A hundred palas make a tulā; that is the line before.
Four is the step of the fourfold list.
Right: तानि विंशतिः: twenty of those (hundred-pala units) are a bhāra.
Two is the count of the pair lines (two karṣas, two palas).
questions.explain: विंशतिः = twenty.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: विंशतिः + भारः gives विंशतिर्भारः. By the same rule, how are अग्निः and भवति joined?
optionExplain: The visarga does not drop after इ; it becomes र्.
श् arises before च/छ, not before भ.
स् arises before त/थ, not before भ.
Right: After इ, the visarga becomes र् before a voiced sound, as in विंशतिर्भारः.
questions.explain: इः + voiced sound → इर्.
questions.rule: Visarga after इ before a voiced sound → र्.
questions.teaches: After इ or उ a visarga becomes र् before a voiced sound: विंशतिः + भारः = विंशतिर्भारः; अग्निः + भवति = अग्निर्भवति.
questions.section: मानों के पर्याय, तुला और भार

questions.q: In unit 73, what does अत्र mean?
optionExplain: Right: अत्र (ind.) = here.
There is तत्र; अत्र is here.
Now is अथ or अधुना; अत्र is here.
Again is पुनः; अत्र is here.
questions.explain: भवति चात्र: and here there is (this).
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 73 to its meaning.
questions.explain: भवति च अत्र: and here there is (this).
questions.rule: भवति = there is; च = and; अत्र = here.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: Put the words of unit 73, split, in the order of the text.
questions.explain: भवति चात्र = भवति · च · अत्र.
questions.teaches: Unit 73 splits as भवति · च · अत्र, 'and here there is'.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: Which split of चात्र in unit 73 is right?
optionExplain: त्र is not a word; the आ comes from अ + अ.
Right: अ + अ → आ: च + अत्र = चात्र.
आत्र is not a word here; अत्र is 'here'.
चात् is not a word; the split is च + अत्र.
questions.explain: च (and) + अत्र (here).
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: A reader meets भवति चात्र after the measure lines. What should he expect next, by the card?
options: A rule stated by the formula
optionExplain: The synonym lines have ended; a verse follows.
Not a colophon; it introduces verse.
Right: The formula introduces the verse of the next units (74 and 75).
The card: the formula states no rule itself.
questions.explain: भवति चात्र introduces the verse that follows.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: च + अत्र gives चात्र. By the same rule, how are तत्र and अपि joined?
optionExplain: ए would come from अ + इ.
ओ would come from अ + उ.
ऐ would come from अ + ए.
Right: अ + अ → आ, as in चात्र.
questions.explain: अ + अ → आ.
questions.rule: Like vowels join long: अ + अ = आ.
questions.teaches: Two like vowels join into one long vowel: च + अत्र = चात्र; तत्र + अपि = तत्रापि.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: In verse 74, what does शुष्क mean?
optionExplain: Right: शुष्क = dry: 'what is to be measured dry'.
Moist is आर्द्र, in the same line.
Liquid is द्रव, in the same line.
Grinding is पेषण, in the second line.
questions.explain: शुष्कमेये त्विदं मानम्: in what is measured dry, this is the measure.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: Match each word of verse 74 to its meaning.
questions.explain: शुष्कमेये … द्विगुणं तु द्रवार्द्रयोः … निर्द्रवे.
questions.rule: शुष्क = dry; द्रव = liquid; आर्द्र = moist; द्विगुण = double; निर्द्रव = without liquid.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: Put the four quarter-lines of verse 74 in order.
questions.explain: शुष्कमेये त्विदं मानं द्विगुणं तु द्रवार्द्रयोः । पेषणालोडने वारि स्नेहपाके च निर्द्रवे.
questions.rule: dry measure · double for liquid and moist · water in grinding and stirring · and in sneha-cooking without liquid.
questions.teaches: Verse 74 runs: the dry measure, doubled for liquid and moist things; then water for grinding and stirring and in sneha-cooking without liquid.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: Which split of त्विदं in verse 74 is right?
optionExplain: अ + इ would give ए: त्वेदम्.
Right: उ before a different vowel becomes व्: तु + इदम् = त्विदम्.
That would print तूविदम्; there is no long ऊ.
That would print तिवदम्; the word is इदम् (this).
questions.explain: तु (but) + इदम् (this).
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: A recipe gives a quantity of a fresh (moist) herb. How much should be taken, by verse 74?
optionExplain: The plain measure holds for what is measured dry.
No half is named; moist things take double.
Right: द्विगुणं तु द्रवार्द्रयोः: double in the liquid and the moist.
The verse says double (द्विगुण), not fourfold.
questions.explain: Dry: this measure; liquid and moist: double.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: द्रवार्द्रयोः is a locative dual: in liquid and moist things. Which form means in milk and ghee the same way?
optionExplain: -आभ्याम् is dual for 'with / for / from', not 'in'.
-एषु is locative plural; two things take the dual.
Not built like द्रवार्द्रयोः: that is a locative dual in -योः, and -ए is not that ending.
Right: -योः ends the locative dual of a two-member dvandva, as in द्रवार्द्रयोः.
questions.explain: Two-member dvandva in the locative: -योः.
questions.teaches: A dvandva of two things in the locative takes the dual -योः: द्रवार्द्रयोः (in liquid and moist); क्षीरघृतयोः (in milk and ghee).
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: In verse 75, what does प्रमाणम् mean?
optionExplain: Right: प्रमाणम् (n. nom. sg.) = quantity: 'where the quantity is not stated'.
Root is मूलम्, in the second line.
Portion is भाग; प्रमाणम् is the quantity.
Not in this verse; here प्रमाणम् is the quantity.
questions.explain: प्रमाणं यत्र नोदितम्: where the quantity is not stated.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: Match each word of the first line of verse 75 to its meaning.
questions.explain: कल्पयेत्सदृशान् भागान्प्रमाणं यत्र नोदितम्.
questions.rule: कल्पयेत् = should make; सदृश = equal; भाग = portion; यत्र = where; उदितम् = stated.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: Put the words of the first line of verse 75, split, in order.
questions.explain: कल्पयेत्सदृशान् भागान्प्रमाणं यत्र नोदितम्.
questions.rule: कल्पयेत् · सदृशान् · भागान् · प्रमाणम् · यत्र · न उदितम्.
questions.teaches: Line 1 of verse 75: should make (कल्पयेत्) equal (सदृशान्) portions (भागान्) where (यत्र) the quantity (प्रमाणम्) is not stated (न उदितम्).
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: Which split of नोदितं in verse 75 is right?
optionExplain: दितम् is not 'stated'; the ओ is from अ + उ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: न + उदितम् = नोदितम्.
अ + ओ would give औ: नौदितम्.
That would print नदितम्; the ओ shows a lost उ.
questions.explain: न (not) + उदितम् (stated).
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: Where a recipe states no quantity, what does verse 75 say one should make?
optionExplain: Double (verse 74) is for liquid and moist things.
Nothing says one portion; the portions are made equal.
Right: कल्पयेत्सदृशान् भागान्: make equal portions where the quantity is not stated.
No fixed measure is given; the portions are made equal.
questions.explain: No quantity stated → equal portions.
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: न + उदितम् gives नोदितम्. By the same rule, how are न and उचितम् (proper) joined?
optionExplain: औ comes from अ + ओ or अ + औ, not अ + उ.
ऊ comes from उ + उ; the first vowel is अ.
The उ does not vanish; it joins with अ into ओ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ, as in नोदितम्.
questions.explain: अ + उ → ओ.
questions.teaches: अ + उ join into ओ: न + उदितम् = नोदितम्; न + उचितम् = नोचितम् (not proper).
questions.section: द्रव में द्विगुण मान; अनुक्त मात्रा

questions.q: In verse 76, what does त्रिधा mean?
optionExplain: Right: त्रिधा (ind.) = in three ways, of three kinds: sneha-cooking is of three kinds.
The verse does not say to cook three times; त्रिधा = of three kinds.
No days are named; त्रिधा = of three kinds.
No liquids are listed here; त्रिधा = of three kinds.
questions.explain: स्नेहपाकस्त्रिधा: sneha-cooking is of three kinds.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 76 to its meaning.
questions.explain: मंदः कल्कसमे किट्टे चिक्कणो मदनोपमे: manda when the residue is like the paste; cikkaṇa when like madana.
questions.rule: मन्द = mild; चिक्कण = smooth; किट्ट = residue; कल्क = paste; मदन = probably wax.

questions.q: Put the three kinds of sneha-cooking in the order of verse 76.
questions.explain: मंदश्चिक्कणः खरचिक्कणः: manda, cikkaṇa, khara-cikkaṇa.
questions.teaches: Verse 76 names the three kinds of sneha-cooking in this order: manda (mild), cikkaṇa (smooth), khara-cikkaṇa (hard-smooth).

questions.q: Which split is right for स्नेहपाकस्त्रिधा?
optionExplain: स्त्रिधा is not a word; the स् comes from the visarga of स्नेहपाकः.
Right: A visarga before त becomes स्: स्नेहपाकः + त्रिधा = स्नेहपाकस्त्रिधा.
A plural स्नेहपाकाः would give स्नेहपाकास्त्रिधा, with long आ.
म् before त would stay as anusvara: स्नेहपाकं त्रिधा.
questions.explain: स्नेहपाकः (sneha-cooking) + त्रिधा (of three kinds).

questions.q: A cook sees that the residue in the pan has become like madana (probably wax). Which kind of cooking is it, by verse 76?
optionExplain: Manda is when the residue is still like the kalka (paste).
Dagdha (burnt) is named only in the next verse, beyond the last kind.
Right: चिक्कणो मदनोपमे: cikkaṇa when the residue is like madana.
Svarasa is an expressed juice, not a kind of sneha-cooking.
questions.explain: Residue like kalka → manda; residue like madana → cikkaṇa.

questions.q: कल्कसमे किट्टे means when the residue is like the kalka. By the same pattern, what does मधुसमे किट्टे mean?
options: When honey is added to the residue
The residue left by the honey
When the honey has no residue
When the residue is like honey
optionExplain: No adding is said; -सम means like, equal to.
That would need a genitive; मधुसमे says like honey.
Nothing is denied; the residue is said to be like honey.
Right: X-same in the locative with किट्टे = when the residue is like X; मधु = honey.
questions.explain: -सम = like; the locative pair gives the condition: when the residue is like X.
questions.rule: X-समे किट्टे = when the residue is like X.
questions.teaches: A locative pair like कल्कसमे किट्टे gives the condition 'when the residue is like X': मधुसमे किट्टे = when the residue is like honey.

questions.q: In verse 77, what does दग्ध mean?
optionExplain: Right: दग्धः (ppp. √दह्) = burnt: beyond the last kind the sneha is burnt.
Cooling is not named here; दग्ध = burnt.
Straining is not named here; दग्ध = burnt.
Mixing is not named here; दग्ध = burnt.
questions.explain: दग्धोऽतऊर्ध्वम्: beyond this it is burnt.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 77 to its meaning.
questions.explain: किंचित्सीदति कृष्णे च वर्त्तमाने तु पश्चिमः । दग्धोऽतऊर्ध्वम्.
questions.rule: किंचित् = a little; सीदति = sinks; कृष्ण = black; पश्चिम = the last; दग्ध = burnt.

questions.q: Put the phrases of verse 77 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: किंचित्सीदति · कृष्णे च वर्त्तमाने · तु पश्चिमः · दग्धोऽतऊर्ध्वम्: two signs, the kind they mark, then what lies beyond.
questions.rule: Signs (sinks a little, black) · the last kind · beyond it, burnt.
questions.teaches: Verse 77 gives two signs (the residue sinks a little, it is black), names the kind they mark (the last), then says that beyond it the sneha is burnt.

questions.q: Which split is right for दग्धोऽतऊर्ध्वम्?
optionExplain: अ + अ would merge into आ: दग्धातऊर्ध्वम्.
Right: -अः + अ → -ओऽ (दग्धोऽ); -अः before ऊ drops the visarga and the vowels stay apart (अत ऊर्ध्वम्).
ततः would leave its त in the print; the word is अतः.
म् before a vowel would give दग्धमतऊर्ध्वम्.
questions.explain: दग्धः (burnt) + अतः (from this) + ऊर्ध्वम् (beyond).

questions.q: A cook sees the residue sink a little and turn black. Which kind of sneha-cooking has been reached, by verse 77?
optionExplain: Manda is when the residue is like the kalka (verse 76).
Cikkaṇa is when the residue is like madana (verse 76).
Right: किंचित्सीदति कृष्णे च … पश्चिमः: these signs mark the last kind, khara-cikkaṇa of verse 76.
Burnt is what comes after these signs, not these signs themselves.
questions.explain: Sinks a little and black → the last kind (khara-cikkaṇa).

questions.q: Join ततः + ऊर्ध्वम् (after that) by the rule seen in अतऊर्ध्वम्. Which is right?
optionExplain: -अः → -ओ only before अ or a voiced consonant, not before ऊ.
After the visarga is dropped no further joining takes place; the vowels stay apart.
-ः → र् only after vowels other than अ/आ; here अ precedes.
Right: After अ, a visarga before a vowel other than अ is dropped and the two vowels stay apart, as in अत ऊर्ध्वम्.
questions.explain: Same rule as अतः + ऊर्ध्वम् = अत ऊर्ध्वम्.
questions.teaches: After अ, a visarga before a vowel other than अ is dropped and no more sandhi follows: अतः + ऊर्ध्वम् = अत ऊर्ध्वम्; ततः + ऊर्ध्वम् = तत ऊर्ध्वम्.

questions.q: Which two mountains does verse 78 name?
optionExplain: Right: हिमवद्विंध्यशैलाभ्याम्: by the mountains Himavat and Vindhya.
Meru is not named; the pair is Himavat and Vindhya.
Malaya is not named; the pair is Himavat and Vindhya.
Neither is named; the pair is Himavat and Vindhya.
questions.explain: हिमवत् + विन्ध्य + शैल: the Himavat and Vindhya mountains.

questions.q: Match each use in verse 78 to its meaning.
questions.explain: मृदुर्नस्ये खरोऽभ्यंगे पाने बस्तौ च चिक्कणः.
questions.rule: नस्य = nasal administration; अभ्यङ्ग = oil massage; पान = drinking; बस्ति = enema.

questions.q: Put the four uses of cooked sneha in the order of verse 78.
questions.explain: नस्ये · अभ्यंगे · पाने · बस्तौ: nasya, then abhyaṅga, then drinking and basti.
questions.teaches: Verse 78 lists the uses in this order: nasya (mild), abhyaṅga (hard), drinking and basti (cikkaṇa).

questions.q: Which cooked sneha does verse 78 give for abhyaṅga (oil massage)?
optionExplain: Mild is for nasya, not for abhyaṅga.
Right: खरोऽभ्यंगे: hard for abhyaṅga.
Cikkaṇa is for drinking and basti.
Burnt sneha is to be taken out (verse 77), not used.
questions.explain: मृदुः → nasya; खरः → abhyaṅga; चिक्कणः → drinking, basti.

questions.q: Which uses take the cikkaṇa sneha, by verse 78? Choose all that apply.
optionExplain: Wrong: abhyaṅga takes the hard (खर) one.
Wrong: nasya takes the mild (मृदु) one.
Right: बस्तौ च चिक्कणः.
Right: पाने … चिक्कणः.
questions.explain: पाने बस्तौ च चिक्कणः: cikkaṇa for drinking and for basti.

questions.q: हिमवत् + विन्ध्य gives हिमवद्विन्ध्य. By the same rule, which is right for भगवत् + गीता?
optionExplain: त् does not stay voiceless before the voiced ग.
त् becomes न् only before a nasal; ग is not a nasal.
Right: Final त् becomes द् before a voiced consonant: त् + ग → द्ग, as त् + व → द्व in हिमवद्विन्ध्य.
त् is not made into the next letter here; it only becomes voiced, द्.
questions.explain: त् + voiced consonant → द्.
questions.rule: Final त् → द् before a voiced consonant.
questions.teaches: Final त् becomes द् before a voiced consonant: हिमवत् + विन्ध्य = हिमवद्विन्ध्य; भगवत् + गीता = भगवद्गीता.

questions.q: In verse 79, what does औषध mean?
optionExplain: Mountain is शैल (verse 78); औषध = medicine.
No word for region is used here; औषध = medicine.
No season is named; औषध = medicine.
Right: औषधम् (n.) = medicine; distinct from ओषधि, herb.
questions.explain: आग्नेयं वैंध्यमौषधम्: the Vindhya medicine is āgneya.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 79 to its meaning.
questions.explain: सौम्यं पथ्यं च तत्राद्यमाग्नेयं वैंध्यमौषधम् । इति भेषजकल्पो नामाष्टमोऽध्यायः.
questions.rule: सौम्य = of Soma's nature; पथ्य = wholesome; आग्नेय = of Agni's nature; वैन्ध्य = of the Vindhya; अष्टम = eighth.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 79 in the order of the text.
questions.explain: First the nature of the first (saumya, pathya), then the Vindhya medicine (āgneya), then the colophon.
questions.rule: सौम्यं पथ्यं च · तत्राद्यम् · आग्नेयं वैंध्यमौषधम् · इति … अध्यायः.
questions.teaches: Verse 79 states the nature of the first region's medicine (saumya, pathya), then the Vindhya medicine (āgneya); the colophon closing chapter eight follows.

questions.q: Which medicine does verse 79 call āgneya (of Agni's nature)?
optionExplain: Right: आग्नेयं वैंध्यमौषधम्: the Vindhya medicine is āgneya.
The first is called saumya and pathya, not āgneya.
The verse sets the two apart; only the Vindhya one is āgneya.
Burnt sneha is in verse 77; āgneya is said of the Vindhya medicine.
questions.explain: आद्यम् → saumya, pathya; वैन्ध्यम् औषधम् → āgneya.

questions.q: A student translates सौम्यं पथ्यं च तत्राद्यम् as: among these, the first is āgneya and wholesome. Which word is wrong?
options: among these: it should be thus
optionExplain: पथ्यम् = wholesome; this word is right.
Right: सौम्यं … आद्यम्: the first is saumya; āgneya is said of the Vindhya medicine.
आद्यम् = the first; this word is right.
तत्र = among these; this word is right.
questions.explain: सौम्यं पथ्यं च तत्राद्यम्: among these, the first is saumya and wholesome; āgneya belongs to the Vindhya medicine.
questions.rule: The first = saumya and pathya; Vindhya = āgneya.

questions.q: अष्टमः + अध्यायः gives अष्टमोऽध्यायः. By the same rule, which is right for षष्ठः + अध्यायः?
optionExplain: That is अ + अ → आ, which needs षष्ठ without visarga.
The visarga drops with a gap only before vowels other than अ.
Right: -अः before अ becomes -ओ and the अ drops, marked ऽ: षष्ठोऽध्यायः.
-ः → र् only after vowels other than अ/आ.
questions.explain: Same rule as अष्टमः + अध्यायः.
questions.teaches: -अः before अ becomes -ओ and the अ drops (ऽ): अष्टमः + अध्यायः = अष्टमोऽध्यायः; षष्ठः + अध्यायः = षष्ठोऽध्यायः.

questions.q: By unit 80, who composed the Aṣṭāṅgasaṅgraha?
optionExplain: Siṃhagupta is named as the author's father, not as the author.
The colophon does not name Caraka.
The colophon does not name Suśruta.
Right: श्रीमद्वाग्भटाचार्यविरचिते: composed by the venerable teacher Vāgbhaṭa.
questions.explain: …सूनुश्रीमद्वाग्भटाचार्यविरचिते: composed by Vāgbhaṭa, son of Siṃhagupta.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 80 to its meaning.
questions.explain: श्रीसिंहगुप्तसूनुश्रीमद्वाग्भटाचार्यविरचिते … पंचमं कल्पसिद्धिस्थानं संपूर्णम्.
questions.rule: सूनु = son; आचार्य = teacher; विरचित = composed; पञ्चम = fifth; सम्पूर्ण = complete.

questions.q: Put the members of the author's compound in unit 80 in their order.
questions.explain: श्रीसिंहगुप्त-सूनु-श्रीमद्वाग्भट-आचार्य-विरचिते: father, son, the name, the title, composed.
questions.teaches: The compound runs father (Siṃhagupta) · son (sūnu) · Vāgbhaṭa · teacher (ācārya) · composed (viracita): 'composed by the teacher Vāgbhaṭa, son of Siṃhagupta'.

questions.q: How is Siṃhagupta related to Vāgbhaṭa, by unit 80?
optionExplain: Right: सिंहगुप्त-सूनु: the son (सूनु) of Siṃhagupta is Vāgbhaṭa, so Siṃhagupta is his father.
सूनु stands after Siṃhagupta: Vāgbhaṭa is the son, not Siṃhagupta.
No pupil is named; सूनु means son.
आचार्य (teacher) is said of Vāgbhaṭa himself.
questions.explain: X-सूनु = son of X.

questions.q: Which part of the work ends with unit 80, by its own title?
optionExplain: Bheṣajakalpa is the eighth chapter, closed in unit 79.
Right: पंचमं कल्पसिद्धिस्थानं संपूर्णम्: the fifth section, Kalpasiddhisthāna, is complete.
पंचमम् is fifth, not sixth.
The title given is Kalpasiddhisthāna.
questions.explain: पञ्चमम् = fifth; कल्पसिद्धिस्थानम् = the part's name.

questions.q: विरचिते + अष्टाङ्ग gives विरचितेऽष्टाङ्ग. By the same rule, which is right for ग्रन्थे + अस्मिन् (in this book)?
optionExplain: आ would come from अ + अ; the word ends in ए.
ऐ comes from अ + ए, not ए + अ.
Right: After a final ए, an initial अ drops and is shown by ऽ, as in विरचितेऽष्टाङ्ग.
ओ would come from -अः; the word ends in ए, which stays.
questions.explain: Final ए + अ → एऽ.
questions.rule: Final ए + अ → एऽ (the अ drops).
questions.teaches: After a word-final ए an initial अ drops and is written ऽ: विरचिते + अष्टाङ्ग = विरचितेऽष्टाङ्ग; ग्रन्थे + अस्मिन् = ग्रन्थेऽस्मिन्.

questions.q: In unit 81, what does अस्तु mean?
optionExplain: A past form is not used; अस्तु is the imperative.
A future form is not used; अस्तु is the imperative.
No verb of giving is used; अस्तु = let it be.
Right: अस्तु (3 sg. imp. √अस्) = let it be, may it be.
questions.explain: श्रीकृष्णार्पणमस्तु: may it be an offering to Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

questions.q: Match each part of unit 81 to its meaning.
questions.explain: श्री-कृष्ण-अर्पणम् अस्तु: may it be an offering to Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
questions.rule: श्री = venerable; कृष्ण = Kṛṣṇa; अर्पण = offering; अस्तु = let it be.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 81 in their order.
questions.explain: श्री · कृष्ण · अर्पणम् · अस्तु = श्रीकृष्णार्पणमस्तु.
questions.teaches: The formula is one compound and a verb: श्री-कृष्ण-अर्पणम् (an offering to Śrī Kṛṣṇa) + अस्तु (let it be).

questions.q: Which split is right for कृष्णार्पणम्?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ: कृष्ण + अर्पणम् = कृष्णार्पणम्.
-अः + अ would give कृष्णोऽर्पणम्.
म् before a vowel would give कृष्णमर्पणम्.
ए + अ would give कृष्णेऽर्पणम्.
questions.explain: कृष्ण (Kṛṣṇa) + अर्पणम् (offering).

questions.q: A reader asks what kind of line unit 81 is, by the card. What is the answer?
optionExplain: No rule is given; it is a dedication.
Right: The card: a dedication formula, not a verse and not part of the teaching.
The chapter title came in unit 79; this is a dedication.
The author was named in unit 80; this line names Kṛṣṇa as receiver.
questions.explain: श्रीकृष्णार्पणमस्तु = may it be an offering to Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

questions.q: By the pattern of अर्पणमस्तु (= अर्पणम् + अस्तु), what does a new phrase शुभमस्तु mean?
optionExplain: अस्तु is an imperative, not a past form.
अस्तु is an imperative, not a future form.
Right: शुभम् + अस्तु: अस्तु = let it be; final म् joins the vowel, as in अर्पणमस्तु.
No verb of offering is in शुभमस्तु.
questions.explain: -म् + अस्तु → -मस्तु; अस्तु = let it be.
questions.rule: X-म् अस्तु = may it be X.
questions.teaches: अस्तु (imperative of √अस्) means 'let it be'; a final म् joins the next vowel: अर्पणम् + अस्तु = अर्पणमस्तु; शुभम् + अस्तु = शुभमस्तु.
